SELECT
        T1."WhsName" AS "Warehouse Name",
        T0."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
        T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
        T2."U_BRND",
        T4."OnHand" AS "In Hand",
        CASE 
            WHEN T4."OnHand" = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE SUM(T0."TransValue") / NULLIF(T4."OnHand", 0) 
        END AS "Avg Price",
        SUM(T0."TransValue") AS "Amount",
        T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group Name"
    FROM OINM T0
    INNER JOIN OWHS T1 ON T1."WhsCode" = T0."Warehouse"
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T2."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T3."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
    INNER JOIN OITW T4 ON T4."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode" AND T4."WhsCode" = T0."Warehouse"
    WHERE T0."TransValue" <> 0 AND T4."OnHand" > 0 AND T0."DocDate" <= ?
    GROUP BY T1."WhsName", T0."ItemCode", T2."ItemName", T2."U_BRND", T3."ItmsGrpNam", T4."OnHand"
    HAVING SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty") > 0;

description: Get invoice details for non-INR, non-canceled documents by item and warehouse
sql:
SELECT
            T0."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
            T1."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
            T2."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
            T0."WhsCode" AS "Warehouse",
            T3."DocNum" AS "Invoice Number",
            T3."DocDate" AS "Invoice Date",
            T3."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
            T3."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
            T4."Quantity" AS "Invoice Quantity",
            T4."PriceBefDi",
            T4."Price" AS "Invoice Price",
            T3."DocCur",
            SUM(T4."Quantity" * T4."Price") AS "Total",
            T1."U_OLDERPCOD",
            T1."U_CUSTITMCOD",
            T1."U_PKGDEC",
            T5."GroupCode"
            FROM
                "OITM" T1
                INNER JOIN "OITB" T2 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
                INNER JOIN "OITW" T0 ON T1."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
                LEFT JOIN "INV1" T4 ON T0."ItemCode" = T4."ItemCode" AND T0."WhsCode" = T4."WhsCode"
                LEFT JOIN "OINV" T3 ON T4."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN "OCRD" T5 ON T3."CardCode" = T5."CardCode"
            WHERE
                T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
                AND T3."DocCur" <> 'INR'
            GROUP BY
                T0."ItemCode",
                T1."ItemName",
                T2."ItmsGrpNam",
                T0."WhsCode",
                T3."DocNum",
                T3."DocDate",
                T3."CardCode",
                T3."CardName",
                T4."Quantity",
                T4."Price",
                T3."DocCur",
                T1."U_OLDERPCOD",
                T1."U_CUSTITMCOD",
                T1."U_PKGDEC",
                T5."GroupCode",
                T4."PriceBefDi"
            ORDER BY
                T0."ItemCode" ASC,
                T0."WhsCode" ASC,
                T3."DocDate" DESC;

description: Get multi-level BOM components and stock levels for a sales order
sql:
SELECT
        T8."DocNum",
        T7."DocEntry",
        T0."Father" AS "ParentItem",
        T20."ItemName" AS "ParentItemName",
        T7."Quantity" AS "OrderQuantity",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T20."ItemCode") AS "ParentStock",
        T0."Code" AS "Component1",
        T10."ItemName" AS "Description1",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T10."ItemCode") AS "Stock1",
        T0."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T31."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty1",
        T1."Code" AS "Component2",
        T11."ItemName" AS "Description2",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T11."ItemCode") AS "Stock2",
        T1."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T32."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty2",
        T2."Code" AS "Component3",
        T12."ItemName" AS "Description3",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T12."ItemCode") AS "Stock3",
        T2."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T33."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty3",
        T3."Code" AS "Component4",
        T13."ItemName" AS "Description4",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T13."ItemCode") AS "Stock4",
        T3."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T34."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty4",
        T4."Code" AS "Component5",
        T14."ItemName" AS "Description5",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T14."ItemCode") AS "Stock5",
        T4."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T35."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty5",
        T5."Code" AS "Component6",
        T15."ItemName" AS "Description6",
        (SELECT SUM("OnHand") FROM OITW WHERE "ItemCode" = T15."ItemCode") AS "Stock6",
        T5."Quantity" * T7."Quantity" / T35."Qauntity" AS "RequiredQty6"
    FROM
        ITT1 T0
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T1 ON T0."Code" = T1."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T2 ON T1."Code" = T2."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T3 ON T2."Code" = T3."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T4 ON T3."Code" = T4."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T5 ON T4."Code" = T5."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN ITT1 T6 ON T5."Code" = T6."Father"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN RDR1 T7 ON T7."ItemCode" = T0."Father"
        INNER JOIN ORDR T8 ON T7."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T20 ON T0."Father" = T20."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T10 ON T0."Code" = T10."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T11 ON T1."Code" = T11."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T12 ON T2."Code" = T12."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T13 ON T3."Code" = T13."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T14 ON T4."Code" = T14."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T15 ON T5."Code" = T15."ItemCode"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T32 ON T0."Code" = T32."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T33 ON T1."Code" = T33."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T34 ON T2."Code" = T34."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T35 ON T3."Code" = T35."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T36 ON T4."Code" = T36."Code"
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OITT T37 ON T5."Code" = T37."Code"
    WHERE
        T8."DocNum" = ?
    ORDER BY
        T0."Father",
        T1."Father",
        T2."Father",
        T3."Father",
        T4."Father",
        T5."Father",
        T6."Father",
        T8."DocNum",
        T7."DocEntry",
        T10."ItmsGrpCod",
        T11."ItmsGrpCod",
        T12."ItmsGrpCod",
        T13."ItmsGrpCod",
        T14."ItmsGrpCod",
        T15."ItmsGrpCod";

SELECT 
    T0."DocEntry" as "DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum" as "Inv No.", 
    T0."DocDate" as "Inv Date",
    T0."CardName" as "Consignee", 
    T0."DocTotalFC" as "Invoice Amt.",
    T0."DocCur",
    T0."DocRate" as "Exchange Rate", 
    T0."DocTotal" as "Amt. (In Rs.)", 
    T0."U_FCLC" as "Terms/Type", 
    T1."PymntGroup" as "Payment Terms", 
    T0."U_CRDT" as "CRTNS.", 
    T0."U_PRLD" as "Shpt. from", 
    T0."U_PODSC" as "FNL. DSTN.", 
    T0."U_CSNMAG" as "Shipping Agent/Forwarder", 
    T0."U_ADDATE" as "Actul Deivery Date",
    T0."U_SPBLNO" as "Shipping Bill No. & Date", 
    T0."U_BLNO", 
    T0."U_BLDT", 
    T0."U_BNKREF",
    T0."U_BNKDT", 
    T0."U_COMPAY", 
    T0."U_COMPAID", 
    T0."U_DBKSCHNM" as "Shipping Bill Incentive" 
FROM 
OINV T0  INNER JOIN OCTG T1 ON T0."GroupNum" = T1."GroupNum" INNER JOIN OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"
WHERE 
T0."CANCELED" = 'N' and T2."GroupCode" = '100' 
AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 'X'
        FROM 
        "ORIN" T3
        INNER JOIN "RIN1" T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE 
            T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry" -- Exclude credit memos
            )
ORDER BY 
    "DocNum";

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
        ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "Financial Year",

    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") - 3
        ELSE MONTH(OINV."DocDate") + 9
    END AS "Financial Month",
    
    WEEK(OINV."DocDate") AS "Week",
    OINV."CardCode"       AS "Customer Code",
    OINV."CardName"       AS "Customer Name",
    OCRG."GroupName"      AS "Customer Group",
    INV1."ItemCode"       AS "Item Code",
    INV1."Dscription"     AS "Item Description",
    
    SUM(INV1."Quantity")  AS "Total Quantity",
    OINV."DocCur"         AS "Currency Code",
    SUM(INV1."TotalFrgn") AS "Total Amount FC",
    SUM(INV1."LineTotal") AS "Total Amount INR"
    
FROM "OINV" OINV
INNER JOIN "INV1" INV1 ON OINV."DocEntry" = INV1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN "OCRD" CRD ON OINV."CardCode" = CRD."CardCode"
INNER JOIN "OCRG" OCRG ON CRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"

WHERE
OINV."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND OCRG."GroupType" = 'C'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "ORIN" T3
        INNER JOIN "RIN1" T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE
            T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
            AND T4."BaseType" = 13
            AND T4."BaseEntry" = OINV."DocEntry"
            AND T4."BaseLine" = INV1."LineNum"
            )
            AND (
                CASE
            WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
            END
    ) IN (
        CASE
            WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
            ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
            END,
            CASE
            WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
            ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
            END
    )

GROUP BY
    CASE
    WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
    ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
    END,
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") - 3
        ELSE MONTH(OINV."DocDate") + 9
    END,
    WEEK(OINV."DocDate"),
    OINV."CardCode",
    OINV."CardName",
    OCRG."GroupName",
    INV1."ItemCode",
    INV1."Dscription",
    OINV."DocCur"

    ORDER BY
    "Financial Year" ASC,
    "Financial Month" ASC,
    "Week" ASC,
    "Customer Code" ASC,
    "Item Code" ASC;

WITH
    OpeningStock AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty"), 0) AS "OpenQty",
            COALESCE(SUM(T0."TransValue"), 0) AS "OpenValue"
        FROM
            OINM T0
            WHERE
            T0."ItemCode" = /*SELECT FROM OITM X WHERE X.ItemCode = */ ?
            AND T0."DocDate" < ?
    ),
    Ledger AS (
        SELECT
            T0."DocDate" AS "Posting Date",
            T0."DocDueDate" AS "Due Date",
            CASE TO_VARCHAR (T0."TransType")
            WHEN '13' THEN 'A/R Invoice'
                WHEN '14' THEN 'A/R Credit Memo'
                WHEN '15' THEN 'Delivery'
                WHEN '16' THEN 'Return'
                WHEN '18' THEN 'A/P Invoice'
                WHEN '19' THEN 'A/P Credit Memo'
                WHEN '20' THEN 'Goods Receipt PO'
                WHEN '21' THEN 'Goods Return'
                WHEN '59' THEN 'Goods Receipt'
                WHEN '60' THEN 'Goods Issue'
                WHEN '67' THEN 'Inventory Transfer'
                WHEN '68' THEN 'Inventory Stock Take'
                WHEN '69' THEN 'Inventory Posting'
                WHEN '162' THEN 'Inventory Revaluation'
                WHEN '202' THEN 'Production Order'
                ELSE TO_VARCHAR (T0."TransType")
            END AS "Doc Type",
            T0."BASE_REF" AS "Doc Number",
            T0."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
            T0."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
            T0."Warehouse" AS "Whse",
            T0."InQty" AS "Qty In",
            T0."OutQty" AS "Qty Out",
            (T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty") AS "Net Qty",
            T0."Price" AS "Price",
            T0."TransValue" AS "Transaction Value",
            T0."CalcPrice" AS "Calculated Cost",
            T0."TransSeq" AS "TransSeq"
            FROM
            OINM T0
            INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
            WHERE
            T0."ItemCode" = /*SELECT FROM OITM X WHERE X.ItemCode = */ ?
            AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )
            SELECT
    "Posting Date",
    "Due Date",
    "Doc Type",
    "Doc Number",
    "Item Code",
    "Item Description",
    "Whse",
    "Qty In",
    "Qty Out",
    "Net Qty",
    SUM("Net Qty") OVER (
        ORDER BY
            "Posting Date",
            "TransSeq" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS "Balance Qty",
    "Price",
    "Transaction Value",
    SUM("Transaction Value") OVER (
        ORDER BY
        "Posting Date",
            "TransSeq" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS "Balance Value",
    "Calculated Cost"
FROM
    (
        -- Opening Stock Row
        SELECT
            ? AS "Posting Date",
            NULL AS "Due Date",
            'Opening Stock' AS "Doc Type",
            NULL AS "Doc Number",
            ? AS "Item Code",
            'Opening Balance' AS "Item Description",
            NULL AS "Whse",
            NULL AS "Qty In",
            NULL AS "Qty Out",
            OS."OpenQty" AS "Net Qty",
            NULL AS "Price",
            OS."OpenValue" AS "Transaction Value",
            NULL AS "Calculated Cost",
            -1 AS "TransSeq"
        FROM
            OpeningStock OS
        UNION ALL
        -- Ledger Transactions
        SELECT
            "Posting Date",
            "Due Date",
            "Doc Type",
            "Doc Number",
            "Item Code",
            "Item Description",
            "Whse",
            "Qty In",
            "Qty Out",
            "Net Qty",
            "Price",
            "Transaction Value",
            "Calculated Cost",
            "TransSeq"
            FROM
            Ledger
    ) T
ORDER BY
    "Posting Date",
    "TransSeq";

SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."ItemName",
    T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
    T1."WhsCode",
    T1."OnHand" AS "InStock",
    T1."IsCommited" AS "Committed",
    T1."OnOrder",
    LastMvt."MaxDocDate" AS "LastMovementDate",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(LastMvt."MaxDocDate", T0."CreateDate"), CURRENT_DATE) AS "DaysWithoutMovement"
FROM OITM T0
INNER JOIN OITW T1 
    ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
INNER JOIN OITB T3 
    ON T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        "ItemCode", 
        MAX("DocDate") AS "MaxDocDate"
    FROM OINM
    GROUP BY "ItemCode"
) LastMvt ON T0."ItemCode" = LastMvt."ItemCode"
WHERE 
    T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'
    AND T0."validFor" = 'Y'
    AND T1."OnHand" > 0
    AND (? = '' OR T3."ItmsGrpNam" = ?)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM OINM sub 
        WHERE sub."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
            AND sub."DocDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -0)
    )
    AND DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(LastMvt."MaxDocDate", T0."CreateDate"), CURRENT_DATE) > 0
ORDER BY 
    "DaysWithoutMovement" DESC,
    T0."ItemCode",
    T1."WhsCode";

SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode", 
    T0."ItemName", 
    T0."ItmsGrpCod", 
    T1."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
    T0."OnHand", 
    T0."AvgPrice" AS "ItemCost",
    (T0."OnHand" * T0."AvgPrice") AS "TotalInventoryValue",
    MAX(T2."DocDate") AS "LastMovementDate",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(MAX(T2."DocDate"), CURRENT_DATE) AS "DaysSinceLastMovement",
    CASE 
        WHEN MAX(T2."DocDate") IS NULL THEN 'No Movement Ever'
        ELSE 'Has Movement History'
    END AS "MovementStatus"
FROM "OITM" T0
INNER JOIN "OITB" T1 ON T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T1."ItmsGrpCod"
LEFT JOIN "OINM" T2 ON T0."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
WHERE 
    T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'
    AND T0."OnHand" > 0.0000
    AND (? = '' OR T1."ItmsGrpNam" = ?)
GROUP BY 
    T0."ItemCode", 
    T0."ItemName", 
    T0."ItmsGrpCod", 
    T1."ItmsGrpNam", 
    T0."OnHand", 
    T0."AvgPrice"
ORDER BY 
    "LastMovementDate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

description: Inventory Not Movement report SubGroup wise
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode" AS "Item No.",
    IFNULL(T0."U_SUBGRP", 'UNASSIGNED') AS "Sub Group",
    T2."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
    MAX(T0."OnHand") AS "Sum of InStock",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(MAX(T1."DocDate"), T0."CreateDate"), CURRENT_DATE) AS "Sum of DaysWithoutMovement"
FROM "OITM" T0 
LEFT JOIN "OINM" T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
INNER JOIN "OITB" T2 ON T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE T0."OnHand" > 0
    AND (? = '' OR T2."ItmsGrpNam" = ?)
GROUP BY 
    T0."U_SUBGRP",
    T2."ItmsGrpNam",
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."CreateDate"
HAVING 
    DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(MAX(T1."DocDate"), T0."CreateDate"), CURRENT_DATE) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    T0."U_SUBGRP",
    T2."ItmsGrpNam",
    T0."ItemCode";

SELECT
    ITM."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
    ITM."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
    OITB."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
    A."WhsCode" AS "Warehouse",
    ITW."OnHand" AS "Quantity On Hand",
    TO_NVARCHAR (MIN(A."ReceiptDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Oldest Stock Date (Current OnHand)",
    TO_NVARCHAR (MAX(L_PUR."LastPurDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Last Purchase Date",
    TO_NVARCHAR (MAX(L_ISS."LastIssDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Last Issue Date",
    DAYS_BETWEEN (MIN(A."ReceiptDate"), CURRENT_DATE) AS "Days in Inventory",
    CASE
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN (MIN(A."ReceiptDate"), CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN '0-30 Days'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN (MIN(A."ReceiptDate"), CURRENT_DATE) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN (MIN(A."ReceiptDate"), CURRENT_DATE) <= 90 THEN '61-90 Days'
        ELSE '90+ Days'
    END AS "Aging Category",
    ROUND(SUM(A."LayerValue") / ITW."OnHand", 4) AS "Calculated Layer Price",
    ROUND(SUM(A."LayerValue"), 2) AS "Inventory Value"
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            W."ItemCode",
            W."WhsCode",
            CASE
                WHEN L."RunningInQty" <= W."OnHand" THEN L."InQty"
                ELSE GREATEST (0, W."OnHand" - (L."RunningInQty" - L."InQty"))
            END AS "LayerQty",
            CASE
                WHEN L."RunningInQty" <= W."OnHand" THEN (L."InQty" * L."Price")
                ELSE GREATEST (0, W."OnHand" - (L."RunningInQty" - L."InQty")) * L."Price"
            END AS "LayerValue",
            L."DocDate" AS "ReceiptDate"
        FROM
            OITW W
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT
                    V."ItemCode",
                    V."LocCode" AS "WhsCode",
                    V."DocDate",
                    V."InQty",
                    V."Price",
                    V."TransSeq",
                    SUM(V."InQty") OVER (
                        PARTITION BY
                            V."ItemCode",
                            V."LocCode"
                        ORDER BY
                            V."DocDate" DESC,
                            V."TransSeq" DESC
                    ) AS "RunningInQty"
                FROM
                    OIVL V
                WHERE
                    V."InQty" > 0
            ) L ON W."ItemCode" = L."ItemCode"
            AND W."WhsCode" = L."WhsCode"
        WHERE
            W."OnHand" > 0
    ) A
    INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON A."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITW ITW ON A."ItemCode" = ITW."ItemCode"
    AND A."WhsCode" = ITW."WhsCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            "ItemCode",
            "LocCode",
            MAX("DocDate") AS "LastPurDate"
        FROM
            OIVL
        WHERE
            "TransType" IN (20, 18)
        GROUP BY
            "ItemCode",
            "LocCode"
    ) L_PUR ON A."ItemCode" = L_PUR."ItemCode"
    AND A."WhsCode" = L_PUR."LocCode"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            "ItemCode",
            "LocCode",
            MAX("DocDate") AS "LastIssDate"
        FROM
            OIVL
        WHERE
            "OutQty" > 0
        GROUP BY
            "ItemCode",
            "LocCode"
    ) L_ISS ON A."ItemCode" = L_ISS."ItemCode"
    AND A."WhsCode" = L_ISS."LocCode"
WHERE
    A."LayerQty" > 0
GROUP BY
    ITM."ItemCode",
    ITM."ItemName",
    OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
    A."WhsCode",
    ITW."OnHand"
ORDER BY
    "Days in Inventory" DESC;

description: INVENTORY OPENING AND CLOSING REPORT QTY AND VALUE WISE
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."ItemName",
    T1."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
    T0."InvntryUom" AS "UOM",

    -- Opening Balance (before start date)
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" < ? THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "OpeningQty",

    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" < ? THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "OpeningValue",

    -- Purchases/Goods Receipt (during period)
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND A."TransType" IN (18,20) THEN A."InQty"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "PurchaseQty",

    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND A."TransType" IN (18,20) THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "PurchaseValue",

    -- Goods Issues (during period)
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND A."TransType" IN (60,21) THEN A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "IssueQty",

    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND A."TransType" IN (60,21) THEN -A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "IssueValue",

    -- Closing Balance (as of end date)
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" <= ? THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "ClosingQty",

    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN A."DocDate" <= ? THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "ClosingValue"

FROM OITM T0
INNER JOIN OITB T1 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T0."ItmsGrpCod"
LEFT JOIN OINM A ON A."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode" AND A."DocDate" <= ?
WHERE T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'

GROUP BY 
    T0."ItemCode", T0."ItemName", T1."ItmsGrpNam", T0."InvntryUom"

HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN A."DocDate" <= ? THEN IFNULL(A."InQty",0) - IFNULL(A."OutQty",0) ELSE 0 END) <> 0
    OR SUM(CASE WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

ORDER BY T0."ItemCode";

SELECT
                T0."DocNum",
                T0."DocDate",
                T1."ItemCode",
                T1."Dscription",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam",
                T1."Quantity",
                T1."unitMsr",
                T1."Price",
                (T1."Quantity" * T1."Price") AS "Gross Amount",
                T4."OcrName" as "Cost Center"
            FROM
                OIGE T0
                INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
                LEFT OUTER JOIN OOCR T4 ON T4."OcrCode" = T1."OcrCode"
            WHERE
                T1."BaseType" = -1
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            ORDER BY
                T0."DocDate",
                T0."DocNum";

WITH InventoryData AS (
                SELECT 
                    T1."ItemCode" AS "Item",
                    T1."ItemName",
                    T2."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
                    T1."OnHand" AS "On Hand",
                    SUM(T0."OutQty") AS "Consumed 90",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T0."DocDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -30) 
                            THEN T0."OutQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Last 30",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -60) 
                        AND ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -31) 
                            THEN T0."OutQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Previous 30"
                FROM 
                    OIVL T0
                INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB T2 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
                WHERE 
                    T0."DocDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -90)
                    AND T0."TransType" NOT IN (67, 68, -1)
                    AND T1."InvntItem" = 'Y'
                GROUP BY 
                    T1."ItemCode", 
                    T1."ItemName",
                    T2."ItmsGrpNam",
                    T1."OnHand"
                HAVING 
                    T1."OnHand" > 0
            )
            , TrendData AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Item",
                    "ItemName",
                    "ItemGroup",
                    "On Hand",
                    "Consumed 90",
                    "Last 30",
                    "Previous 30",
                    ("Consumed 90" / 90.0) AS "Avg Daily Consumption",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN "Previous 30" = 0 AND "Last 30" = 0 THEN 'Stable'
                        WHEN "Previous 30" = 0 AND "Last 30" > 0 THEN 'Upward'
                        WHEN "Last 30" > "Previous 30" * 1.1 THEN 'Upward'
                        WHEN "Last 30" < "Previous 30" * 0.9 THEN 'Downward'
                        ELSE 'Stable'
                    END AS "Trend"
                FROM 
                    InventoryData
            )
            SELECT 
                "Item",
                "ItemName",
                "ItemGroup",
                "On Hand",
                "Consumed 90",
                "Last 30",
                "Previous 30",
                "Trend",
                ROUND("Avg Daily Consumption" * 1, 0) AS "Forecast (1 Day)",
                ROUND("Avg Daily Consumption" * 30, 0) AS "Forecast (1 Month)",
                ROUND("Avg Daily Consumption" * 60, 0) AS "Forecast (2 Months)",
                ROUND("Avg Daily Consumption" * 90, 0) AS "Forecast (3 Months)",
                -- Safely handles stock cover string output
                CASE 
                    WHEN "Avg Daily Consumption" = 0 THEN 'N/A'
                    ELSE CAST(ROUND("On Hand" / NULLIF("Avg Daily Consumption", 0), 0) AS VARCHAR) || ' Days'
                END AS "Stock Cover",
                -- Safely handles evaluation logic using NULLIF to prevent HANA Engine crashes
                CASE 
                    WHEN "On Hand" / NULLIF("Avg Daily Consumption", 0) < 30 THEN 'Increase Purchase'
                    WHEN "On Hand" / NULLIF("Avg Daily Consumption", 0) > 90 AND "Trend" IN ('Downward', 'Stable') THEN 'Reduce Purchase'
                    WHEN "On Hand" / NULLIF("Avg Daily Consumption", 0) BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN 'Normal Purchase'
                    ELSE 'Normal Purchase'
                END AS "Action"
            FROM 
                TrendData
            ORDER BY 
                "Item";

    SUM(CASE

    SUM(CASE

    SUM(CASE

            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Weekly Total Amount",

    -- Consolidated Monthly Metrics
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."Quantity"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Monthly Quantity",
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN (T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice")
            ELSE 0

description: Total Exports and Domestic Sales This Year
sql:
-- Step 1: Base Data from Invoices and Credit Notes
            WITH BaseData AS (
                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum" AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                FROM OINV T0
                INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    -(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                FROM ORIN T0
                INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
            ),

            -- Step 2: Get current fiscal year and month
            CurrentPeriod AS (
                SELECT 
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS "Current_FY",
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 3 ELSE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) + 9 END AS "Current_FY_Month_Num"
                FROM DUMMY
            ),

            -- Step 3: Current YTD Sales
            CurrentYTDSales AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Customer_Group",
                    "FY_Year",
                    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year"
            ),

            -- Step 4: Previous Year Full Sales (not YTD)
            PreviousYearSales AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Customer_Group",
                    "FY_Year",
                    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Full_Year_Sales"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
                GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year"
            ),

            -- Step 5: Previous Year YTD Sales (for comparison)
            PreviousYTDSales AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Customer_Group",
                    "FY_Year",
                    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
                AND "FY_Month_Num" <= (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year"
            ),

            -- Step 6: Final Growth Calculation
            Growth_Calc AS (
                SELECT 
                    curr."Customer_Group",
                    curr."FY_Year" AS "Current_FY",
                    curr."YTD_Sales" AS "Current_YTD",
                    prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" AS "Previous_Full_Year",
                    prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" AS "Previous_YTD",
                    (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod) AS "Months_Upto_Current",
                    
                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Sales" - prev_ytd."YTD_Sales") / prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" * 100, 2)
                    END AS "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent",
                    
                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Sales" / prev_full."Full_Year_Sales") * 100, 2)
                    END AS "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",

                    ROUND(curr."YTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Avg_Monthly_Sales"

                FROM CurrentYTDSales curr
                LEFT JOIN PreviousYearSales prev_full
                    ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev_full."Customer_Group"
                LEFT JOIN PreviousYTDSales prev_ytd
                    ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev_ytd."Customer_Group"
            )

            -- Final Output
            SELECT 
                "Customer_Group",
                "Current_FY",
                "Current_YTD",
                "Previous_Full_Year",
                "Previous_YTD",
                "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent",
                "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",
                "Avg_Monthly_Sales",
                CASE 
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent" > 25 THEN 'High Growth'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent" > 20 THEN 'Normal Growth'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent" < -10 THEN 'Declining'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent" IS NULL THEN 'New/No Previous Data'
                    ELSE 'Stable'
                END AS "Growth_Category"
            FROM Growth_Calc
            ORDER BY "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_Percent" DESC NULLS LAST, "Customer_Group";

WITH Base AS (
            /* ---------- Invoices ---------- */
            SELECT 
                OCRG."GroupName"              AS "Customer_Group",
                T0."CardCode",
                T0."CardName",
                T0."DocCur",
                CRD1."Country"                AS "ShipToCountry",
                OCRY."Name"                   AS "Country_Name",
                CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                    ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END       AS "FY_Year",
                T0."DocEntry",
                (T1."LineTotal"  - (T1."LineTotal"  * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                (T1."TotalFrgn"  - (T1."TotalFrgn"  * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
                T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"
            FROM OINV T0
            INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
            INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
            INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
            LEFT  JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
                AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
                AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
            LEFT  JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
            WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Credit Notes as negative ---------- */
            SELECT 
                OCRG."GroupName"              AS "Customer_Group",
                T0."CardCode",
                T0."CardName",
                T0."DocCur",
                CRD1."Country"                AS "ShipToCountry",
                OCRY."Name"                   AS "Country_Name",
                CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                    ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END       AS "FY_Year",
                T0."DocEntry",
                -(T1."LineTotal"  - (T1."LineTotal"  * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                -(T1."TotalFrgn"  - (T1."TotalFrgn"  * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
                -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"
            FROM ORIN T0
            INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
            INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
            INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
            LEFT  JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
                AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
                AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
            LEFT  JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
            WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        )

        /* ---------- Group by Customer ---------- */
        SELECT
            B."FY_Year",
            B."Customer_Group",
            B."CardCode"        AS "Customer_Code",
            B."CardName"        AS "Customer_Name",
            B."DocCur"          AS "Currency",
            B."ShipToCountry",
            B."Country_Name",
            SUM(B."Net_Sales_LC") AS "Total_Net_Sales_LC",
            SUM(B."Net_Sales_FC") AS "Total_Net_Sales_FC",
            COUNT(DISTINCT B."DocEntry") AS "Invoice_Count",
            SUM(B."Quantity")     AS "Total_Quantity"
        FROM Base B
        GROUP BY
            B."FY_Year",
            B."Customer_Group",
            B."CardCode",
            B."CardName",
            B."DocCur",
            B."ShipToCountry",
            B."Country_Name"
        ORDER BY
            B."FY_Year",
            B."Customer_Group",
            "Customer_Name";

-- Step 1: Base data from Invoices and Credit Memos
            WITH BaseData AS (
                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    (SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                FROM OINV T0
                INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    -1 * (SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                FROM ORIN T0
                INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
            ),

            -- Step 2: Monthly Aggregation
            MonthlyAgg AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Customer_Group",
                    "FY_Year",
                    "FY_Month_Num",
                    "Month_Name",
                    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Monthly_Sales_LC"
                FROM BaseData
                GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num", "Month_Name"
            ),

            -- Step 3: YTD Aggregation
            YTDAgg AS (
                SELECT 
                    "Customer_Group",
                    "FY_Year",
                    SUM("Monthly_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales_LC"
                FROM MonthlyAgg
                GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year"
            ),

            -- Step 4: Combine MTD and Previous Year MTD for Growth %
            MTD_Growth AS (
                SELECT 
                    curr."Customer_Group",
                    curr."FY_Year",
                    curr."FY_Month_Num",
                    curr."Month_Name",
                    curr."Monthly_Sales_LC" AS "Current_MTD",
                    prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" AS "Previous_MTD",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND((curr."Monthly_Sales_LC" - prev."Monthly_Sales_LC") / prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" * 100, 2)
                    END AS "MTD_Growth_Percent"
                FROM MonthlyAgg curr
                LEFT JOIN MonthlyAgg prev
                    ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev."Customer_Group"
                    AND curr."FY_Month_Num" = prev."FY_Month_Num"
                    AND curr."FY_Year" = prev."FY_Year" + 1
            ),

            -- Step 5: Combine YTD and Previous YTD
            YTD_Growth AS (
                SELECT 
                    curr."Customer_Group",
                    curr."FY_Year",
                    curr."YTD_Sales_LC" AS "Current_YTD",
                    prev."YTD_Sales_LC" AS "Previous_YTD",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev."YTD_Sales_LC" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Sales_LC" - prev."YTD_Sales_LC") / prev."YTD_Sales_LC" * 100, 2)
                    END AS "YTD_Growth_Percent"
                FROM YTDAgg curr
                LEFT JOIN YTDAgg prev
                    ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev."Customer_Group"
                    AND curr."FY_Year" = prev."FY_Year" + 1
            )

            -- Final Output
            SELECT 
                M."Customer_Group",
                M."FY_Year",
                M."FY_Month_Num",
                M."Month_Name",
                M."Current_MTD",
                M."Previous_MTD",
                M."MTD_Growth_Percent",
                Y."Current_YTD",
                Y."Previous_YTD",
                Y."YTD_Growth_Percent"
            FROM MTD_Growth M
            LEFT JOIN YTD_Growth Y
                ON M."Customer_Group" = Y."Customer_Group"
                AND M."FY_Year" = Y."FY_Year"
            ORDER BY 
                M."Customer_Group", M."FY_Year", M."FY_Month_Num";

SELECT TOP 10
                -- T1."Customer",
                T1."ItemCode",
                T2."ItemName",
                CAST(SUM(T1."Quantity") AS DECIMAL) AS "Quantity Sold",
                SUM(T1."LineTotal" - T1."VatSum") AS "Total Net Value",
                SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Gross Value"
            FROM
                "INV1" T1
            INNER JOIN
                "OINV" T3
            ON
                T1."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
            LEFT OUTER JOIN
                "OITM" T2
            ON
                T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
            WHERE
                T1."ItemCode" IS NOT NULL
                AND T3."DocDate" >= ?
                AND T3."DocDate" <= ? 
                AND T3."DocCur" <> 'INR'
            GROUP BY
                T1."ItemCode",
                T2."ItemName"
            ORDER BY
                SUM(T1."Quantity") DESC;

SELECT 
                "Customer_Group",
                "DocNum" AS "Invoice_Number",
                "DocDate",
                "FY_Year",
                "FY_Month_Num",
                "Month_Name",
                "CardCode" AS "Customer_Code",
                "CardName" AS "Customer_Name",
                "ItemCode",
                "ItemName",
                "ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
                "DocCur" AS "Currency",
                "ShipToCountry",
                "Country_Name",
                
                SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                SUM("Net_Sales_FC") AS "Net_Sales_FC",
                COUNT(DISTINCT "DocEntry") AS "Invoice_Count",
                SUM("Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"

            FROM (
                -- Invoices
                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    T0."CardCode",
                    T0."CardName",
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
                    OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."DocCur",
                    CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
                    OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",

                    MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                    (T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
                ---   -(T1."LineTotal"" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) / COALESCE(NULLIF(T0."DocRate", 0), 1) AS "Net_Sales_FC",

                    T1."Quantity"

                FROM 
                    OINV T0
                INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
                LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
                LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
                    AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
                    AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
                LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
                WHERE 
                    T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                UNION ALL

                -- Credit Notes (as negative)
                SELECT 
                    OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                    T0."CardCode",
                    T0."CardName",
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
                    OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."DocCur",
                    CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
                    OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
                    END AS "FY_Year",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
                        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
                    END AS "FY_Month_Num",

                    MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                    -(T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) / COALESCE(NULLIF(T0."DocRate", 0), 1) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
                    -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"

                FROM 
                    ORIN T0
                INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
                LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
                LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
                LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
                    AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
                    AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
                LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
                WHERE 
                    T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            ) T

            GROUP BY 
                "Customer_Group", "CardCode", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "ItmsGrpNam",
                "CardName", "DocDate", "DocNum", "DocCur", "ShipToCountry", "Country_Name",
                "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num", "Month_Name"

            ORDER BY 
                "Customer_Group", "Customer_Code", "Item_Group", "ItemCode", "ItemName",
                "DocDate", "Country_Name", "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num";

SELECT  
                T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
                T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
                T1."Currency",
                COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Order Count",
                Sum (T1."OpenQty"*T1."Price"*T0."DocRate") AS  "Total LC", 
                Sum(T1."OpenQty"*T1."Price") AS "Total FC"

            FROM 
                ORDR T0
                INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 
                    ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
            WHERE 
                T0."DocStatus" = 'O'    -- Order open
                AND T1."LineStatus" = 'O' -- Line open
            GROUP BY 
                T0."CardCode",
                T0."CardName",
                T1."Currency"
            ORDER BY 
                "Total LC" DESC;

description: Sales Order Wise Bom Tree with Stock
sql:
WITH SO AS (
            SELECT 
                T8."DocNum"    AS "SO_No",
                T8."DocEntry"  AS "SOEntry",
                T7."ItemCode"  AS "SOItem",
                T7."OpenQty"   AS "SOQty"
            FROM ORDR T8
            JOIN RDR1 T7 ON T8."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
            WHERE 
                T8."DocNum" = '25000127'
            AND T7."LineStatus" = 'O'
            ),

            BOM AS (
            /* ---------- Level 1 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                S."SOItem"                                  AS "ParentItem",
                S."SOItem"                                  AS "ComponentItem",
                P."ItemName"                                AS "ComponentName",
                1                                           AS "Level",
                P."U_VMS"                                   AS "ItemVMS",
                P."U_SUBGRP"                                AS "Sub-Group",
                CAST(S."SOQty" AS DECIMAL(19,6))            AS "RequiredQty",
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = S."SOItem") AS "Stock",
                P."InvntryUom"                              AS "UoM"
            FROM SO S
            LEFT JOIN OITM P ON S."SOItem" = P."ItemCode"
            WHERE P."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND {{ITMSGRPCOD}}

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Level 2 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                S."SOItem",
                T0."Code",
                C."ItemName",
                2,
                C."U_VMS",
                C."U_SUBGRP",
                CAST( (T0."Quantity" * S."SOQty") / NULLIF(IFNULL(T31."Qauntity", 1), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = T0."Code"),
                C."InvntryUom"
            FROM SO S
            JOIN ITT1 T0   ON S."SOItem" = T0."Father"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITM C  ON T0."Code"   = C."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OITM P  ON T0."Father" = P."ItemCode"
            WHERE P."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C."ItmsGrpCod" <> 191

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Level 3 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                T0."Code",
                T1."Code",
                C1."ItemName",
                3,
                C1."U_VMS",
                C1."U_SUBGRP",
                CAST( (T1."Quantity" * T0."Quantity" * S."SOQty")
                    / NULLIF(IFNULL(T31."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T32."Qauntity",1), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = T1."Code"),
                C1."InvntryUom"
            FROM SO S
            JOIN ITT1 T0 ON S."SOItem" = T0."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T1 ON T0."Code"  = T1."Father"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T32 ON T1."Father" = T32."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITM C1 ON T1."Code"   = C1."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OITM P1 ON T1."Father" = P1."ItemCode"
            WHERE P1."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C1."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C1."ItmsGrpCod" <> 191

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Level 4 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                T1."Code",
                T2."Code",
                C2."ItemName",
                4,
                C2."U_VMS",
                C2."U_SUBGRP",
                CAST( (T2."Quantity" * T1."Quantity" * T0."Quantity" * S."SOQty")
                    / NULLIF(IFNULL(T31."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T32."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T33."Qauntity",1), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = T2."Code"),
                C2."InvntryUom"
            FROM SO S
            JOIN ITT1 T0 ON S."SOItem" = T0."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T1 ON T0."Code"  = T1."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T2 ON T1."Code"  = T2."Father"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T32 ON T1."Father" = T32."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T33 ON T2."Father" = T33."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITM C2 ON T2."Code"   = C2."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OITM P2 ON T2."Father" = P2."ItemCode"
            WHERE P2."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C2."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C2."ItmsGrpCod" <> 191

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Level 5 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                T2."Code",
                T3."Code",
                C3."ItemName",
                5,
                C3."U_VMS",
                C3."U_SUBGRP",
                CAST( (T3."Quantity" * T2."Quantity" * T1."Quantity" * T0."Quantity" * S."SOQty")
                    / NULLIF(IFNULL(T31."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T32."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T33."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T34."Qauntity",1), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = T3."Code"),
                C3."InvntryUom"
            FROM SO S
            JOIN ITT1 T0 ON S."SOItem" = T0."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T1 ON T0."Code"  = T1."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T2 ON T1."Code"  = T2."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T3 ON T2."Code"  = T3."Father"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T32 ON T1."Father" = T32."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T33 ON T2."Father" = T33."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T34 ON T3."Father" = T34."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITM C3 ON T3."Code"   = C3."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OITM P3 ON T3."Father" = P3."ItemCode"
            WHERE P3."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C3."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C3."ItmsGrpCod" <> 191

            UNION ALL

            /* ---------- Level 6 ---------- */
            SELECT 
                S."SO_No",
                T3."Code",
                T4."Code",
                C4."ItemName",
                6,
                C4."U_VMS",
                C4."U_SUBGRP",
                CAST( (T4."Quantity" * T3."Quantity" * T2."Quantity" * T1."Quantity" * T0."Quantity" * S."SOQty")
                    / NULLIF(IFNULL(T31."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T32."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T33."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T34."Qauntity",1) * IFNULL(T35."Qauntity",1), 0) AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
                (SELECT SUM(W."OnHand") FROM OITW W WHERE W."ItemCode" = T4."Code"),
                C4."InvntryUom"
            FROM SO S
            JOIN ITT1 T0 ON S."SOItem" = T0."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T1 ON T0."Code"  = T1."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T2 ON T1."Code"  = T2."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T3 ON T2."Code"  = T3."Father"
            JOIN ITT1 T4 ON T3."Code"  = T4."Father"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T31 ON T0."Father" = T31."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T32 ON T1."Father" = T32."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T33 ON T2."Father" = T33."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T34 ON T3."Father" = T34."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITT T35 ON T4."Father" = T35."Code"
            LEFT JOIN OITM C4 ON T4."Code"   = C4."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OITM P4 ON T4."Father" = P4."ItemCode"
            WHERE P4."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C4."PrcrmntMtd" = 'M'
                AND C4."ItmsGrpCod" <> 191
            ),

            BOM2 AS (
                SELECT 
                    B.*,
                    CASE 
                    WHEN B."RequiredQty" > IFNULL(B."Stock",0) 
                    THEN B."RequiredQty" - IFNULL(B."Stock",0)
                    ELSE 0
                    END AS "ShortageRow"
                FROM BOM B
            )   

            /*   ---------- Pivot with Required, Stock, Shortage per stage + totals ---------- */
            SELECT
                COALESCE(B2."ItemVMS",'(blank)') AS "Row Labels",

                /* Level 1: COMBINATION SPANNER */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 1 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "COMBINATION SPANNER - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 1 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "COMBINATION SPANNER - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 1 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "COMBINATION SPANNER - Shortage",

                /* Level 2: SPANNERS */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 2 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "SPANNERS - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 2 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "SPANNERS - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 2 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "SPANNERS - Shortage",

                /* Level 3: ELECTROPLATING */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 3 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "ELECTROPLATING - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 3 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "ELECTROPLATING - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 3 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "ELECTROPLATING - Shortage",

                /* Level 4: QUALITY INSPECTION */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 4 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "QUALITY INSPECTION - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 4 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "QUALITY INSPECTION - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 4 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "QUALITY INSPECTION - Shortage",

                /* Level 5: BROACHING */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 5 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "BROACHING - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 5 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "BROACHING - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 5 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "BROACHING - Shortage",

                /* Level 6: FORGING */
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 6 THEN B2."RequiredQty" END)            AS "FORGING - Req",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 6 THEN IFNULL(B2."Stock",0) END)        AS "FORGING - Stock",
                SUM(CASE WHEN B2."Level" = 6 THEN B2."ShortageRow" END)            AS "FORGING - Shortage",

                /* Totals across all stages */
                SUM(B2."RequiredQty")                                              AS "Total Required",
                SUM(IFNULL(B2."Stock",0))                                          AS "Total Stock",
                SUM(B2."ShortageRow")                                              AS "Total Shortage"

            FROM BOM2 B2
            GROUP BY COALESCE(B2."ItemVMS",'(blank)')
            ORDER BY "Row Labels";

WITH
            BaseData AS (
                -- AP Invoices
                SELECT 
                    OITB."U_ITMTYP"  AS "Item_Group",
                    
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
                    SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum" AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
                FROM OPCH T0
                INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OITB."U_ITMTYP" , T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

                UNION ALL

                -- AP Credit Notes
                SELECT 
                    OITB."U_ITMTYP"  AS "Item_Group",
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
                    T0."DocEntry",
                    T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
                    -(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
                FROM ORPC T0
                INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
                WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                GROUP BY OITB."U_ITMTYP" , T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
            ),
            CurrentPeriod AS (
                SELECT 
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS "Current_FY",
                    CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 3 ELSE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) + 9 END AS "Current_FY_Month_Num",
                    ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1) AS "Month_Start",
                    ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AS "Prev_Year_Today",
                    ADD_MONTHS(ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1), -12) AS "Prev_Month_Start",
                    DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AS "MTD_Days",
                    DAYOFMONTH(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12)) AS "Prev_MTD_Days"
                FROM DUMMY
            ),
            CurrentYTDPurchase AS (
                SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
            ),
            PreviousYearPurchase AS (
                SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "Full_Year_Purchase"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
                GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
            ),
            PreviousYTDPurchase AS (
                SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
                    AND "FY_Month_Num" <= (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
            ),
            CurrentMTD AS (
                SELECT "Item_Group", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                    AND "DocDate" <= CURRENT_DATE
                GROUP BY "Item_Group"
            ),
            PreviousMTD AS (
                SELECT "Item_Group", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
                FROM BaseData
                WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Prev_Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                    AND "DocDate" <= (SELECT "Prev_Year_Today" FROM CurrentPeriod)
                GROUP BY "Item_Group"
            ),
            Growth_Calc AS (
                SELECT 
                    curr."Item_Group",
                    curr."FY_Year" AS "Current_FY",
                    curr."YTD_Purchase" AS "Current_YTD",
                    prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" AS "Previous_Full_Year",
                    prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_YTD",
                    (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod) AS "Months_Upto_Current",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Purchase" - prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase") / prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" * 100, 2)
                    END AS "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" * 100, 2)
                    END AS "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",

                    ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
                    ROUND(COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",

                    CASE 
                        WHEN COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND(
                            (
                                (curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                                - (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                            )
                            / (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0)) * 100, 2
                        )
                    END AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",

                    cm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Current_MTD_Purchase",
                    pm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
                    ROUND(cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
                    ROUND(pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
                    CASE 
                        WHEN pm."MTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR (SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod) = 0 OR pm."MTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
                        ELSE ROUND(
                            (
                                (cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                                - (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                            )
                            / (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0)) * 100, 2
                        )
                    END AS "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%"
                FROM CurrentYTDPurchase curr
                LEFT JOIN PreviousYearPurchase  prev_full ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_full."Item_Group"
                LEFT JOIN PreviousYTDPurchase   prev_ytd  ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_ytd."Item_Group"
                LEFT JOIN CurrentMTD            cm        ON curr."Item_Group" = cm."Item_Group"
                LEFT JOIN PreviousMTD           pm        ON curr."Item_Group" = pm."Item_Group"
            )

            SELECT 
                "Item_Group",
                "Current_FY",
                "Current_YTD",
                "Previous_Full_Year",
                "Previous_YTD",
                "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",
                "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",
                "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
                "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
                "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
                "Current_MTD_Purchase",
                "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
                "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
                "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
                "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
                CASE 
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 25 THEN 'High Growth'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 20 THEN 'Normal Growth'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" < -10 THEN 'Declining'
                    WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 'New/No Previous Data'
                    ELSE 'Stable'
                END AS "Growth_Category"
            FROM Growth_Calc
            ORDER BY 
                CASE WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" DESC,
                "Item_Group";

description: Proudction Summary - Yesterday and MTD with Date Filter
sql:
SELECT 
    'SUBGROUP' AS "LEVEL",
    T1."U_ITMSECTION",
    T1."U_BRND",

    -- Yesterday Data
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."PlannedQty"
            WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."PlannedQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Yesterday Planned Qty",
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."CmpltQty"
            WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."CmpltQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Yesterday Production",
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."RjctQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Yesterday Rejection",

    -- MTD Data (Current Month)
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."PlannedQty"
            WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."PlannedQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Planned Qty", 
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."RjctQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Rejection",  
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."CmpltQty"
            WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."CmpltQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Production",

    -- Parameter Date Range
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."PlannedQty"
            WHEN T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."PlannedQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Planned Qty",
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."CmpltQty"
            WHEN T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND T0."Type" = 'D' THEN -T0."CmpltQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Production",
    
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P') THEN T0."RjctQty"
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Rejection"

FROM OWOR T0
INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE 
    {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
    AND IFNULL(T1."U_SUBGRP", '') <> 'REWORK'
    AND T0."Type" IN ('S', 'P', 'D')
    AND T0."Status" IN ('C', 'L') -- Restrict to Closed and Released orders
    AND T0."PostDate" >= LEAST(ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1), NEXT_DAY(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -1))), ?)
GROUP BY 
    T1."U_ITMSECTION",
    T1."U_BRND"
ORDER BY 
    T1."U_BRND";
