description: Get BOM Allocation Results Level 0 and 1
Sales Order to Invoice Allocation Report Open and Closed last X days
sql:
WITH InvoiceMap AS (
    -- Map Sales Order lines to Invoice lines (via Delivery)
    SELECT
        T0_P1."DocEntry" AS "SO_DocEntry",
        T0_P1."LineNum" AS "SO_LineNum",
        T5."DocNum" AS "Inv_No",
        T5."DocDate" AS "Inv_Date",
        T5."DocStatus" AS "Inv_Status",
        T4."Quantity" AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM OINV T5
    INNER JOIN INV1 T4
        ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN DLN1 T2
        ON T4."BaseEntry" = T2."DocEntry"
        AND T4."BaseLine" = T2."LineNum"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 15
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0_P1
        ON T2."BaseEntry" = T0_P1."DocEntry"
        AND T2."BaseLine" = T0_P1."LineNum"
        AND T2."BaseType" = 17
    WHERE T5."CANCELED" = 'N'

    UNION ALL

    -- Map Sales Order lines to Invoice lines (Direct Invoice)
    SELECT
        T0_P2."DocEntry" AS "SO_DocEntry",
        T0_P2."LineNum" AS "SO_LineNum",
        T5."DocNum" AS "Inv_No",
        T5."DocDate" AS "Inv_Date",
        T5."DocStatus" AS "Inv_Status",
        T4."Quantity" AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM OINV T5
    INNER JOIN INV1 T4
        ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0_P2
        ON T4."BaseEntry" = T0_P2."DocEntry"
        AND T4."BaseLine" = T0_P2."LineNum"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 17
    WHERE T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
),

SalesOrderLines AS (
    SELECT
        T1."DocNum" AS "SO_No",
        T1."DocDate" AS "SO_Date",
        T1."DocStatus" AS "SO_Status",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."LineNum" AS "SO_Line",
        T0."Quantity" AS "SO_Qty",
        T0."OpenQty" AS "Open_Qty",
        M."Inv_No",
        M."Inv_Date",
        M."Inv_Status",
        COALESCE(M."Inv_Qty", 0) AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM ORDR T1
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0
        ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceMap M
        ON T0."DocEntry" = M."SO_DocEntry"
        AND T0."LineNum" = M."SO_LineNum"
    WHERE
        T1."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND (
            T1."DocStatus" = 'O'
            OR (
                T1."DocStatus" = 'C'
                AND M."Inv_Date" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -(?))
            )
        )
),

SplitRows AS (
    -- Rows having invoices
    SELECT
        "SO_No",
        "SO_Date",
        "SO_Status",
        CAST("Inv_No" AS VARCHAR(50)) AS "Group_Inv_No",
        "Inv_Date",
        "Inv_Status",
        "Inv_Qty" AS "Allocated_SO_Qty",
        0 AS "Allocated_Open_Qty",
        "Inv_Qty" AS "Allocated_Inv_Qty"
    FROM SalesOrderLines
    WHERE "Inv_No" IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Open balance / No invoice rows
    SELECT
        "SO_No",
        "SO_Date",
        "SO_Status",
        'No Invoice' AS "Group_Inv_No",
        NULL AS "Inv_Date",
        NULL AS "Inv_Status",
        "Open_Qty" AS "Allocated_SO_Qty",
        "Open_Qty" AS "Allocated_Open_Qty",
        0 AS "Allocated_Inv_Qty"
    FROM SalesOrderLines
    WHERE
        "Open_Qty" > 0
        OR "Inv_No" IS NULL
)

SELECT
    "SO_No" AS "orderId",
    "SO_Date" AS "soDate",
    "SO_Status" AS "soStatus",

    SUM("Allocated_SO_Qty") AS "totalSOQty",
    SUM("Allocated_Open_Qty") AS "totalOpenQty",

    CASE
        WHEN "Group_Inv_No" = 'No Invoice'
            THEN NULL
        ELSE "Group_Inv_No"
    END AS "invoiceNo",

    "Inv_Date" AS "invoiceDate",
    "Inv_Status" AS "invoiceStatus",

    SUM("Allocated_Inv_Qty") AS "invoicedQty"

FROM SplitRows

GROUP BY
    "SO_No",
    "SO_Date",
    "SO_Status",
    "Group_Inv_No",
    "Inv_Date",
    "Inv_Status"

ORDER BY
    "SO_No",
    CASE WHEN "Group_Inv_No" = 'No Invoice' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    "Group_Inv_No";

WITH OrderDeliveryDates AS (
    SELECT 
        T4."BaseEntry",
        MAX(T5."DocDate") AS "MaxDeliveryDate"
    FROM DLN1 T4
    INNER JOIN ODLN T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
    WHERE T4."BaseType" = 17 -- 17 is the object type for Sales Orders (ORDR)
    GROUP BY T4."BaseEntry"
)
SELECT
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T2."U_BRAND",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    DEL."MaxDeliveryDate" AS "ActualDeliveryClosingDate",
    SUM(T1."OpenQty") AS "TotalOpenQuantity",
    SUM(T1."OpenQty" * COALESCE(T3."SWeight1", 0)) AS "TotalOpenNetWeight",
    SUM(T1."OpenQty" / NULLIF(T3."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * T3."U_GRSWT") AS "TotalOpenGrossWeight",
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(T3."U_MSTRCTN", 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                (T1."OpenQty" / T3."U_MSTRCTN")
                * (
                    COALESCE(T3."SLength1", 0)
                    * COALESCE(T3."SWidth1", 0)
                    * COALESCE(T3."SHeight1", 0)
                )
                / 1000000.0
        END
    ) AS "TotalOpenCBM",
    T0."DocStatus"
FROM ORDR T0
INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"
INNER JOIN OITM T3 ON T1."ItemCode" = T3."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN OrderDeliveryDates DEL ON T0."DocEntry" = DEL."BaseEntry"
WHERE
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND (
        T1."LineStatus" = 'O'
        OR (
            T0."DocStatus" = 'C'
            AND DEL."MaxDeliveryDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -(?))
        )
    )
GROUP BY
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T2."U_BRAND",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    DEL."MaxDeliveryDate",
    T0."DocStatus"
ORDER BY
    T0."DocDate" DESC;

SELECT 
        T0."ItemCode", 
        T0."OnHand" 
        FROM OITM T0 
        INNER JOIN OITB T1 ON T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T1."ItmsGrpCod"
        WHERE T0."OnHand" > 0 
            AND T1."ItmsGrpNam" IN (
                'AB BELTS',
                'CHEMICALS',
                'ELECTROPLATING',
                'FUEL & GAS',
                'RAW MATERIAL',
                'STEEL SHOTS/GRITS',
                'RATCHET SPANNER PARTS',
                'RATCHET SPARE PARTS'
            )

SELECT
    B."VMS",

    /* BOM / Tool Master */
    MAX(O."U_Hammer") AS "Hammer",
    MAX(O."U_Die")    AS "Die",
    MAX(O."U_DieCap") AS "DieCapacity",
    MAX(O."U_Prodhr") AS "ProdHr_Per_Die"

FROM "BOM_ALLOCATION_RESULTS_V5" B
INNER JOIN "OITT" O
    ON O."Code" = B."ChildItem"

WHERE
    B."ChildItem" LIKE '%FRG%'
    AND "Parent_Procurement" = 'M'

GROUP BY
    B."VMS";

SELECT "OrderNo",
    "ChildItem","ChildDesc","ItemGroup",
    MAX("SubGroup")              AS "SubGroup",
    --- SUM("SO_RemainingQty")       AS "SO_RemainingQty",
    SUM("RequiredQty")           AS "RequiredQty",
    SUM("InStock")               AS "InStock",
    SUM("AllocatedQty")          AS "AllocatedQty",
    SUM("Shortage")              AS "Shortage",
    SUM("Remaining")             AS "Remaining"
FROM "BOM_ALLOCATION_RESULTS_V5"

where 

"ChildItem" LIKE '%FRG%' 

GROUP BY
    "ChildItem", "ChildDesc","ItemGroup" , "OrderNo"
ORDER BY
    "ChildItem";

description: Customer Open Sales Order Details Item Wise
sql:
SELECT 
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocDate",
        T0."DocDueDate",
        WEEK(T0."DocDueDate") AS "WeekNo",
        T0."U_ADDATE",
        T0."CardName",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T0."NumAtCard" AS "Cust Ref",
        T1."Dscription",
        T1."Currency",
        T2."U_OLDERPCOD",
        T2."U_CUSTITMCOD",

        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "TotalQuantity",
        SUM(T1."OpenQty") AS "OpenQuantity",
        
        AVG(T1."Price") AS "AveragePrice",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total INR",
        SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") AS "TotalForeign",

        /* WEIGHTS */
        SUM(T1."Quantity" * COALESCE(T2."SWeight1", 0)) AS "TotalWeight",
        SUM(T1."OpenQty" * COALESCE(T2."SWeight1", 0)) AS "OpenWeight",

        /* VOLUMES / CBM */
        SUM(
            T1."Quantity"
            / NULLIF(T2."U_MSTRCTN", 0)
            * COALESCE(T2."SVolume", 0)
        ) AS "TotalVolume_CBM",

        SUM(
            T1."OpenQty"
            / NULLIF(T2."U_MSTRCTN", 0)
            * COALESCE(T2."SVolume", 0)
        ) AS "OpenVolume_CBM"

FROM ORDR T0
INNER JOIN RDR1 T1
    ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN OITM T2
    ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"

WHERE
        T0."DocStatus" = 'O'
        AND T1."LineStatus" = 'O'

GROUP BY
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocDate",
        T0."DocDueDate",
        T0."U_ADDATE",
        T0."NumAtCard",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription",
        T1."Currency",
        T2."U_OLDERPCOD",
        T2."U_CUSTITMCOD"

ORDER BY
        T0."DocNum";

description: Open Sales Order Report With Ageing Due Days
sql:
SELECT 
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY') AS "Month",
    T0."BPLName", 
    (CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' AND T0."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'Canceled' 
        ELSE 'Closed' 
    END) AS "Status",
    NNM1."Indicator" AS "Period Ind", 
    NNM1."SeriesName", 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate" AS "Posting Date", 
    T0."NumAtCard" AS "Customer Ref No", 
    T0."TaxDate" AS "Document Date", 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    REPLACE(T0."Address", CHAR(13), ' ') AS "BillingAddress", 
    (SELECT "TaxId0" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "PANNo", 
    (SELECT V1."Name" FROM RDR12 V0 INNER JOIN OCST V1 ON V1."Code" = V0."StateB" AND V1."Country" = V0."CountryB" WHERE V0."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry") AS "State", 
    (SELECT V0."CityS" FROM RDR12 V0 WHERE V0."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry") AS "City", 
    REPLACE(T0."Address2", CHAR(13), ' ') AS "ShippingAddress", 
    (SELECT "TaxId11" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "TINNo", 
    (SELECT "TaxId3" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "ServiceTaxNo", 
    (SELECT "TaxId1" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "CSTNo", 
    T1."GSTRegnNo" AS "GSTNumber", 
    (IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) + T0."DiscSum" AS "Before Dis Amount", 
    T0."DiscSum" AS "Discount Amount", 
    (IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) AS "Taxable Amount", 
    T0."TotalExpns" AS "Freight Amount", 
    T0."VatSum" AS "Tax Amount", 
    T0."RoundDif", 
    T0."DocTotal", 
    T0."DocDueDate" AS "Due Date", 
    (DAYS_BETWEEN(NOW(), T0."DocDueDate")) * -1 AS "Overdue days"

    FROM ORDR T0
        INNER JOIN OBPL T9 ON T0."BPLId" = T9."BPLId"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CRD1 T1 ON T1."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" 
        AND T1."Address" = T0."ShipToCode" AND T1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN NNM1 ON NNM1."Series" = T0."Series" 
        AND IFNULL(T0."Indicator", '') <> '76'
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" IN ('Y','N') 
        AND T0."DocStatus" <> 'C'
    ORDER BY T0."DocDueDate";

SELECT 
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY') AS "Month",
    COUNT(T0."DocNum") AS "Total Orders",
    SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0))) AS "Total Doc Amount",
    SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) + T0."DiscSum") AS "Before Discount Amount",
    SUM(T0."DiscSum") AS "Discount Amount",
    SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0)) AS "Taxable Amount"
    --- SUM(T0."VatSum") AS "Tax Amount"
    -- SUM(T0."TotalExpns") AS "Freight Amount",
    --- SUM(T0."RoundDif") AS "RoundOff Amount"
    FROM ORDR T0
        INNER JOIN OBPL T9 ON T0."BPLId" = T9."BPLId"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CRD1 T1 ON T1."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" 
        AND T1."Address" = T0."ShipToCode" AND T1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN NNM1 ON NNM1."Series" = T0."Series" 
        AND IFNULL(T0."Indicator", '') <> '76'
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" IN ('Y','N') 
        AND T0."DocStatus" <> 'C'
    GROUP BY TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY')
    ORDER BY MIN(T0."DocDueDate");

SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."Currency",
    COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Order Count",
    SUM(T1."OpenSum") AS  "Total LC",
    SUM( T1."OpenSumFC") AS "Total FC"

    FROM 
        ORDR T0
        INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 
            ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."DocStatus" = 'O'    -- Order open
        AND T1."LineStatus" = 'O' -- Line open
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T1."Currency"
    ORDER BY 
        "Total LC" DESC;

SELECT 
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T2."U_BRAND",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    WEEK(T0."DocDueDate") AS "WeekNo",
    T0."DocRate",
    T0."DocCur",
    SUM(T1."OpenQty") AS "TotalOpenQuantity",
    SUM  (T1."OpenQty"*T1."Price"*T0."DocRate") AS "TotalOpenSumLC",
    SUM (T1."OpenQty"*T1."Price") As "TotalOpenSumFC"

    FROM ORDR T0
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 
        ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T2 
        ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"
    WHERE T1."LineStatus" = 'O'
    GROUP BY 
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."NumAtCard",
        T2."U_BRAND",
        T0."DocDate",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocDueDate",
        T0."DocRate",
        T0."DocCur"

    ORDER BY T0."DocDate" DESC;

SELECT 
    T0."DocNum" AS "Sales Order",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."OpenQty",T1."ShipDate",
    T0."U_ADDATE" AS "Scheduled Delivery Date",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    WEEK(T0."DocDueDate") AS "WeekNo"
FROM 
    ORDR T0
INNER JOIN 
    RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
WHERE 
    T1."OpenQty" > 0 
    AND T1."ShipDate" >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY 
    T1."ShipDate";

SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode", 
    T1."ItemName", 
    T0."Price", 
    T0."Currency",
    T0."CreateDate", 
    T0."UpdateDate", 
    T0."ListNum" 
        FROM OSPP T0 INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"  
        WHERE T0."CardCode" = ? ;

        T0."U_SEMICTN",

        T0."SHeight1",     
        T0."SWidth1",

        CASE 
        WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") > 0 THEN 28 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") 
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Master Carton 20' ",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") > 0 THEN (28 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume")) * T0."U_MSTRCTN"
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Qty 20' ",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") > 0 THEN 18000 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") 
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Master Carton Qty 20' ",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") > 0 THEN (18000 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT")) * T0."U_MSTRCTN"
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Qty As per Weight 20' ",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") > 0 THEN 54 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") 
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Master Carton 40 Ft",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume") > 0 THEN (54 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."SVolume")) * T0."U_MSTRCTN"
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Qty 40 FT",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") > 0 THEN 26000 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") 
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Master Carton Qty 40Ft",
            CASE 
            WHEN TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT") > 0 THEN (26000 / TO_DECIMAL(T0."U_GRSWT")) * T0."U_MSTRCTN"
            ELSE NULL 
            END AS "Total Qty As per Weight 40 Ft",

            FROM 
            OITM T0  
            INNER JOIN 
            OITB T1 
            ON 
            T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T1."ItmsGrpCod"

        OSCN T2 
        ON 
        T0."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode" 
        INNER JOIN 
        OCRD T3

            T2."CardCode" = T3."CardCode" -- Join to fetch CardName

            T2."CardCode" = ? 
            AND T1."ItmsGrpCod" IN (
                172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 
                179, 180, 189, 182, 183, 
                184, 169, 162, 163, 186, 
                187, 188
                );

description: Sales order Wise item weight and Volume
sql:
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."TaxDate",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."U_ADDATE",
    T0."U_CDDATE",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."VisOrder",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T2."U_OLDERPCOD",
    T2."U_CUSTITMCOD",
    T1."Dscription",
    T2."U_PKGDEC",
    T2."U_SEMICTN",
    T2."U_MSTRCTN",
    T2."SHeight1",
    T2."SWidth1",
    T2."SLength1",
    T2."SVolume",
    T2."SWeight1",
    (T2."U_MSTRCTN" * T2."SWeight1") as "net WT",
    T2."CodeBars",
    T1."Price",
    T0."DocStatus",
    T1."PriceBefDi",
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."OpenQty",
    T1."WhsCode",
    T1."LineTotal",
    (T1."Quantity" / T2."U_MSTRCTN" * T2."SVolume") as "Total Volume",
    (T1."Quantity" / T2."U_MSTRCTN" * T2."U_GRSWT") as "Total Weight",
    (T1."Quantity" / T2."U_MSTRCTN") as "TL.CRTN",
    T2."U_GRSWT",
    ((T1."Quantity" / T2."U_MSTRCTN") * (T2."U_MSTRCTN" * T2."SWeight1")) as "Total net Weight",
    T2."PrcrmntMtd",
    T1."UomCode",
    T0."Comments"
FROM
    ORDR T0
INNER JOIN
    RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN
    OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
WHERE
    T0."DocNum" = ?;

SELECT 
    "Customer_Group",
    "DocNum" AS "Invoice_Number",
    "DocDate",
    "FY_Year",
    "FY_Month_Num",
    "Month_Name",
    "CardCode" AS "Customer_Code",
    "CardName" AS "Customer_Name",
    "ShipToAddress",
    "ItemCode",
    "ItemName",
    "ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
    "DocCur" AS "Currency",
    "ShipToCountry",
    "Country_Name",  
    
    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Net_Sales_LC",
    SUM("Net_Sales_FC") AS "Net_Sales_FC",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "DocEntry") AS "Invoice_Count",
    SUM("Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"

FROM (
    -- Invoices
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."Address2" AS "ShipToAddress",
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocCur",
        CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
        OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",

        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        (T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        T1."Quantity"

    FROM 
        OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
            AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
            AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes (as negative)
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."Address2" AS "ShipToAddress",
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocCur",
        CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
        OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",

        -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        -(T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"

    FROM 
        ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
            AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
            AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
) T

GROUP BY 
    "Customer_Group", "CardCode", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "ItmsGrpNam", "ShipToAddress",
    "CardName", "DocDate", "DocNum", "DocCur", "ShipToCountry", "Country_Name",

    (COALESCE(T0."DocTotalFC", 0) - (COALESCE(T0."U_BRSAMT", 0) + COALESCE(T0."U_BRSAMT2", 0) + COALESCE(T0."U_BRSAMT3", 0))) AS "INV TOTAL DIFF"

INNER JOIN INV12 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
WHERE

    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'

        FROM "VISHAL_LIVE"."ORIN" T3

        WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"

SELECT

        T0."U_AMTUND" AS "Amount UND",
        t0."U_AMTUND" - (t0."DocTotal"+(t0."DocTotal"*.1)) AS "Balance (Rs)"

sql:
SELECT 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate", 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    
    SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity", 
    SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") AS "Total Foreign Value", 
    SUM((T1."TotalFrgn" * T1."U_DBKF") / 100) AS "Total Freight Discount",
    SUM(T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T1."U_DBKF") / 100) AS "Total FOB Value",
    SUM(T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") AS "Total DBK Net Wt",
    SUM((T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100) AS "Total DBK % Value",
    SUM((T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV") AS "Total DBK Cap Value (New Wt)",
    SUM(T1."Quantity" * T1."U_DBKCV") AS "Total DBK Cap Value (Qty)",

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN ((T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100) < ((T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV") 
            THEN (T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100
            ELSE (T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV" 
        END
    ) AS "Total Less Applicable Value",


    T0."U_DBKDATE" AS "DBK Recipt Date", 
        T0."U_DBKCLAIM" AS "DBK Claim Amount", 
        T0."U_IGSTRECPTDT" AS "IGST Recipt Date", 
        T0."U_IGSTAMT" AS "IGST Recipt Amount", 
        T0."U_RDTDATE" AS "RODTEP Date", 
        T0."U_RTEPAMT" AS "RODTEP Recipt Amount"

    FROM OINV T0  
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T2 ON T2."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"

    WHERE T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? 
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'

    GROUP BY 
        T0."DocNum", 
        T0."DocDate", 
        T0."CardCode", 
        T0."CardName", 
        T0."U_DBKDATE", 
        T0."U_DBKCLAIM", 
        T0."U_IGSTRECPTDT", 
        T0."U_IGSTAMT", 
        T0."U_RDTDATE", 
        T0."U_RTEPAMT"
    ORDER BY T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate";

SELECT T0."DocEntry",T0."DocNum",T0."DocDate", T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription", T2."SalUnitMsr",T1."Quantity", 
    T1."Price" AS "Unit Price", 
    T1."TotalFrgn", 
    T1."U_DBKF" AS "DBK (%)", 
    T1."U_DBK" AS "DBK Value", 
    T1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value",
    (T1."TotalFrgn"*T1."U_DBKF")/100 AS "Freight Discount",
    T1."TotalFrgn"-(T1."TotalFrgn"*T1."U_DBKF")/100 AS "FOB Value",
    (T1."Quantity"*T2."U_ITMWT") AS "DBK Net Wt",
    T1."Quantity" AS "DBK Qty",
    T1."LineTotal" AS "INR Value",

    (T1."LineTotal"*T1."U_DBK")/100 AS "DBK % Value",
    (T1."Quantity"*T2."U_ITMWT")*T1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value (New wt)",

    T1."Quantity"*t1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value (Qty)",

    case when ((T1."LineTotal"*T1."U_DBK")/100) < ((T1."Quantity"*T2."U_ITMWT")*T1."U_DBKCV") then ((T1."LineTotal"*T1."U_DBK")/100)
    else ((T1."Quantity"*T2."U_ITMWT")*T1."U_DBKCV") end AS "Less Applicable Value"

    FROM OINV T0  
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T2 ON T2."ItemCode"=T1."ItemCode"

    Where T1."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? and T0."CANCELED" = 'N';

SELECT
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate", T4."GroupName",T0."U_SPBLNO",
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T0."DocDate") AS "Year",
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T0."DocDate") AS "Month",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    T2."SalUnitMsr",
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."Price" AS "Unit Price",
    T0."DocCur",
    T1."TotalFrgn",
    T1."U_DBKF" AS "DBK (%)",
    T1."U_DBK" AS "DBK Value",
    T1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value",
    (T1."TotalFrgn" * T1."U_DBKF") / 100 AS "Freight Discount",
    T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T1."U_DBKF") / 100 AS "FOB Value",
    (T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") AS "DBK Net Wt",
    T1."Quantity" AS "DBK Qty",
    T1."LineTotal" AS "INR Value",
    
    (T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100 AS "DBK % Value",
    (T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value (New wt)",
    T1."Quantity" * T1."U_DBKCV" AS "DBK Cap Value (Qty)",
    CASE
        WHEN ((T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100) < ((T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV")
            THEN ((T1."LineTotal" * T1."U_DBK") / 100)
        ELSE ((T1."Quantity" * T2."U_ITMWT") * T1."U_DBKCV")
    END AS "Less Applicable Value"
FROM

INNER JOIN

LEFT OUTER JOIN

INNER JOIN

INNER JOIN
