WHERE T4."GroupName" <> 'Domestic' and T0."CANCELED" = 'N';

description: Export Customer Consolidated AR sales report
sql:
SELECT 
    "CardCode" AS "BP Code",
    "CardName" AS "Consignee",
    TO_VARCHAR(SUM("Net_Sales_FC")) AS "Invoice Amount",
    "DocCur" AS "Document Currency",
    TO_VARCHAR(SUM("Net_Sales_LC")) AS "Amount In (Rs)",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "DocEntry") AS "Invoice Count"
FROM (
    -- Invoices
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocCur",
        T0."DocEntry",
        -- Adjusted for header discount % (if any)
        SUM(T1."LineTotal" * (1 - T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        SUM(T1."TotalFrgn" * (1 - T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC"
    FROM 
        OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."DocCur", T0."DocEntry", T0."DiscPrcnt"

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes (as negative)
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocCur",
        T0."DocEntry",
        -SUM(T1."LineTotal" * (1 - T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        -SUM(T1."TotalFrgn" * (1 - T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC"
    FROM 
        ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."DocCur", T0."DocEntry", T0."DiscPrcnt"
) T
GROUP BY 
    "CardCode", "CardName", "DocCur"
ORDER BY 
    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") DESC;

description: AR Invoice MIS Report Data YOY
sql:
SELECT 
    "Customer_Group",
    "DocNum" AS "Invoice_Number",
    "DocDate",
    "FY_Year",
    "FY_Month_Num",
    "Month_Name",
    "CardCode" AS "Customer_Code",
    "CardName" AS "Customer_Name",
    "ShipToAddress",
    "ItemCode",
    "ItemName",
    "ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
    "DocCur" AS "Currency",
    "ShipToCountry",
    "Country_Name",  
    
    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Net_Sales_LC",
    SUM("Net_Sales_FC") AS "Net_Sales_FC",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "DocEntry") AS "Invoice_Count",
    SUM("Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"

FROM (
    -- Invoices
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."Address2" AS "ShipToAddress",
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocCur",
        CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
        OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",

        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        (T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        T1."Quantity"

    FROM 
        OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
        AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
        AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes (as negative)
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."Address2" AS "ShipToAddress",
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITM."ItemName" AS "ItemName",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocCur",
        CRD1."Country" AS "ShipToCountry",
        OCRY."Name" AS "Country_Name",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",

        -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        -(T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"

    FROM 
        ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN CRD1 ON T0."CardCode" = CRD1."CardCode" 
        AND T0."ShipToCode" = CRD1."Address" 
        AND CRD1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT JOIN OCRY ON CRD1."Country" = OCRY."Code"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
) T

GROUP BY 
    "Customer_Group", "CardCode", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "ItmsGrpNam", "ShipToAddress",
    "CardName", "DocDate", "DocNum", "DocCur", "ShipToCountry", "Country_Name",
    "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num", "Month_Name"

ORDER BY 
    "Customer_Group", "Customer_Code", "Item_Group", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "ShipToAddress",
    "DocDate", "Country_Name", "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num";

SELECT 
    T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."U_ADDATE", T0."U_CDDATE",  
    T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", 
    T0."NumAtCard" AS "PO References",
    T0."DocCur", T0."DocRate",  T0."U_FCLC",
    T0."DiscSum", T0."DiscSumFC", T0."DocTotal", T0."DocTotalFC",  
    T0."U_CHBLDT" AS "CHB Date", 
    T0."U_CHBLNO", 
    T0."U_CHBAMT" AS "CHB Amount", 
    T0."U_CHBRMK",  
    T0."U_RTPBLNO", 
    T0."U_RTPBLDT" AS "RTPBL Date", 
    T0."U_RTPBLAMT"  AS "RTPBLD Amount",  
    T0."U_TPBLNO", 
    T0."U_TPBLDT" AS "TPBL Date", 
    T0."U_TPBLAMT" AS "TPBL Amount", 
    T0."U_TPBLRMK",  
    T0."U_FRBLNO", 
    T0."U_FRBLDT" AS "FRBL Date", 
    T0."U_FRBLAMT" AS "FRBL Amount", 
    T0."U_FRBLRMK",  
    T0."U_OTHBLNO", 
    T0."U_OTHBLDT" AS "OTHBL Date", 
    T0."U_OTHBLAMT" AS "OTHBL Amount", 
    T0."U_OTHBLRMK"
FROM OINV T0  
    INNER JOIN OCTG T1 ON T0."GroupNum" = T1."GroupNum"  
    INNER JOIN OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"
WHERE  
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  
    AND T2."GroupCode" = '100'  AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND NOT EXISTS (  
        -- Credit Note 
        SELECT 1  
        FROM ORIN T3  
        INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"  
        WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"  
    )  
    AND (T0."DocSubType" IS NULL OR T0."DocSubType" <> 'DN') 
ORDER BY T0."DocNum";

description: Export Register Customer and Item Wise
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T2."ItemName",
    SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
    T0."DocCur",

    -- Gross Value (before discounts)
    SUM(T1."Quantity" * T1."Price") AS "Gross Value FC",

    -- Net Value in Document Currency (after line + header discount)
    SUM(
        (T1."Quantity" * T1."Price")
        * (1 - T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        * (1 - COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt",0)/100)
    ) AS "Net Value FC",

    -- Net Value in Local Currency (using exchange rate)
    SUM(
        (T1."Quantity" * T1."Price")
        * (1 - T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        * (1 - COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt",0)/100)
        * T0."DocRate"
    ) AS "Net Value LC",

    T2."U_CUSTITMCOD", 
    T2."U_OLDERPCOD" 

FROM 
    OINV T0
INNER JOIN 
    INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN 
    OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"


WHERE 
    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR' 
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  -- Ensure documents are not canceled
    AND T0."CardCode" = ?  -- Parameter for CardCode-wise selection
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 'X'
        FROM 
            ORIN T3
            INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE 
            T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry" -- Exclude credit memos
    )
GROUP BY 
    T0."CardCode",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T2."ItemName",
    T2."U_CUSTITMCOD",
    T2."U_OLDERPCOD",
    T0."DocCur"
ORDER BY 
    T1."ItemCode";

preParams.name: Customer Code
preParams.sql:
SELECT 
        T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
        MAX(T0."CardName") AS "Customer Name"
            FROM OCRD T0
            WHERE T0."CardType" = 'C' AND T0."GroupCode"= '100' and T0."validFor" = 'Y'
            GROUP BY T0."CardCode"
            ORDER BY T0."CardCode";

description: Export sales Report With BL No
sql:
SELECT T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate",T0."CardName",
    T0."NumAtCard" AS "PO References",
    T0."DocTotalFC", 
    T2."PymntGroup" AS "Terms", 
    T0."U_FCLC", T0."U_CRDT", T0."U_PODSC", 
    T0."U_POFD", 
    T0."U_CSNMAG" AS "Shipping Agent", 
    T0."U_NMARL" AS "Forwarder",
    SUM((T3."U_ITMWT" * T3."U_MSTRCTN" + T3."U_MCWT") * (T1."Quantity" / T3."U_MSTRCTN")) AS "G Weight_Upd",

    SUM((T3."SVolume") * (T1."Quantity"/ T3."U_MSTRCTN")) AS "T CBM Volume",
    
    T0."U_ADDATE", 
    T0."U_STUFDT" AS "U_STUFDate", 
    T0."U_RAILOUT" AS "U_RAILOUT_Date", 
    T0."U_SPBLNO", 
    T0."U_ONBRD" AS "U_ONBOARD_Date", 
    T0."U_BLNO", 
    T0."U_BLDT"  AS "U_BLDate"
    ---SUM(CAST(T3."U_GRSWT" AS DECIMAL(19,3))) AS "Gross Wt",
    ---SUM(T3."SVolume") AS "Volume",

    FROM OINV T0 
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN OCTG T2 ON T2."GroupNum" = T0."GroupNum"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T3 ON T3."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T4 ON T0."CardCode" = T4."CardCode"
    WHERE T0."U_BLDT" <> '0' AND  T4."GroupCode" = 100 and  T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY 
        T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."CardName", T0."DocTotalFC", T2."PymntGroup", T0."NumAtCard",
        T0."U_FCLC", T0."U_CRDT", T0."U_PODSC", T0."U_POFD", T0."U_CSNMAG", T0."U_NMARL",
        T0."U_ADDATE", T0."U_STUFDT", T0."U_RAILOUT", T0."U_SPBLNO", T0."U_ONBRD", T0."U_BLNO", T0."U_BLDT"
    ORDER BY T0."DocNum";

SELECT 
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate", 
    T0."DocTotalFC",
    T0."DocCur", 
    T0."DocRate",  
    T0."DocTotal", 
    T2."PortCode", 
    T2."ImpExpDate", 
    T2."ImpExpNo", 
    T0."U_DBKDATE", 
    T0."U_IGSTRECPTDT" AS "IGST Recipt Date", 
    T0."U_RDTDATE" AS "RDT Date", 
    T0."U_DBKCLAIM", 
    T0."U_IGSTAMT" AS "IGST Amount", 
    T0."U_RTEPAMT" AS "RTEP Amount", 
    T0."U_SCRIPNO", 
    T0."U_SCRIPDT" AS "SCRIP Date", 
    T0."U_SCRIPVDT" AS "SCRIPV Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T2."ImpExpDate" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Done'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Status"
FROM 
    OINV T0  
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    INNER JOIN INV12 T2 ON T0."DocEntry" = T2."DocEntry" 
    INNER JOIN OITM T3 ON T1."ItemCode" = T3."ItemCode" 
    INNER JOIN OCTG T4 ON T0."GroupNum" = T4."GroupNum" 
WHERE 
    T0."DocCur" <> 'INR' 
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
GROUP BY 
    T0."DocEntry", 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate", 
    T0."DocTotalFC", 
    T0."DocCur", 
    T0."DocRate",  
    T0."DocTotal", 
    T2."PortCode", 
    T2."ImpExpDate", 
    T2."ImpExpNo", 
    T0."U_DBKDATE", 
    T0."U_IGSTRECPTDT", 
    T0."U_RDTDATE", 
    T0."U_DBKCLAIM", 
    T0."U_IGSTAMT", 
    T0."U_RTEPAMT", 
    T0."U_SCRIPNO", 
    T0."U_SCRIPDT", 
    T0."U_SCRIPVDT" 
ORDER BY 
    T0."DocNum";

SELECT 
        OCRD."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
        OCRD."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer Group",

        OINV."DocNum" AS "Invoice No",
        OINV."DocDate" AS "Invoice Date",
        OINV."DocDueDate" AS "Due Date",
        OINV."DocCur" AS "Currency",
        
        OINV."DocRate" AS "Exchange Rate Invoice",
        ORTT."Rate" AS "Exchange Rate AsOnDate",

        OINV."DocTotal"   AS "Total LC",
        OINV."DocTotalFC" AS "Total FC",

        ROUND(ORTT."Rate" * OINV."DocTotalFC", 2) AS "Revalued Amount LC",
        ROUND((ORTT."Rate" * OINV."DocTotalFC") - OINV."DocTotal", 2) AS "Revaluation Diff",

        OINV."PaidToDate" AS "Paid Amount LC",
        (OINV."DocTotal" - OINV."PaidToDate") AS "Open Amount LC"

    FROM 
        OINV
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON OINV."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN ORTT 
        ON ORTT."RateDate" = ?
        AND ORTT."Currency" = OINV."DocCur"

    WHERE 
        OINV."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND OINV."DocStatus" = 'O'
        AND OINV."DocDate" <= ?
        AND OINV."DocTotal" > OINV."PaidToDate"
        AND OINV."DocCur" <> 'INR'

    ORDER BY 
        OCRG."GroupName", 
        OCRD."CardName", 
        OINV."DocNum";

SELECT 
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    T0."NumAtCard", 
    T0."Address", 
    T0."DocRate", 
    T0."DocCur",
    ROUND(SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") - T0."DiscSumFC", 2) AS "FC Amount",
    ROUND(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum", 2) AS "LC Amount",
    'Invoice' AS "DocumentType"
FROM OINV T0
JOIN INV1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
WHERE 
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
GROUP BY 
    T0."DocNum", T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."NumAtCard", T0."Address",
    T0."DocRate", T0."DocCur", T0."DiscSum", T0."DiscSumFC", T0."DocDate"

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    T0."NumAtCard", 
    T0."Address", 
    T0."DocRate", 
    T0."DocCur",
    -ROUND(SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") - T0."DiscSumFC", 2) AS "FC Amount",
    -ROUND(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum", 2) AS "LC Amount",
    'CreditNote' AS "DocumentType"
FROM ORIN T0
JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
WHERE 
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
GROUP BY 
    T0."DocNum", T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."NumAtCard", T0."Address",
    T0."DocRate", T0."DocCur", T0."DiscSum", T0."DiscSumFC", T0."DocDate";

SELECT
    OCRD."CardCode"        AS "Customer_Code",
    OCRD."CardName"        AS "Customer_Name",
    OCRG."GroupName"       AS "Customer_Group",

    OINV."DocNum"          AS "Invoice_No",
    OINV."DocDate"         AS "Invoice_Date",
    OINV."DocDueDate"      AS "Due_Date",
    OINV."NumAtCard"       AS "Ref_No", 
    OINV."DocCur"          AS "Currency",
    OINV."DocRate"         AS "Exchange_Rate",

    -- Totals
    OINV."DocTotal"        AS "Invoice_Total_LC",
    OINV."DocTotalFC"      AS "Invoice_Total_FC",

    -- Paid
    OINV."PaidToDate"      AS "Paid_Amount_LC",
    (OINV."PaidToDate" / NULLIF(OINV."DocRate",0)) AS "Paid_Amount_FC",

    -- Remaining / Outstanding
    (OINV."DocTotal" - OINV."PaidToDate") AS "Remaining_LC",
    (OINV."DocTotalFC" - (OINV."PaidToDate" / NULLIF(OINV."DocRate",0))) AS "Remaining_FC"

FROM OINV
INNER JOIN OCRD ON OINV."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"

WHERE 
    OINV."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND OINV."DocStatus" = 'O'               
    AND (OINV."DocTotal" - OINV."PaidToDate") > 0
    AND OINV."DocCur" <> 'INR'                
ORDER BY 
    OCRG."GroupName",
    OCRD."CardName",
    OINV."DocDate",
    OINV."DocNum",
    OINV."NumAtCard";

description: Sales Invoice item with Weight and Pcs
sql:
SELECT
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Document Number",
    T0."DocDate" AS "Date",
    'Invoice' AS "Document Type",
    T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
    T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
    T6."GroupName",
    T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Description",
    T2."ItmsGrpCod" AS "Item Group Code",
    T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
    T4."Chapter" AS "HSN Code",
    T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity",
    T1."Price" AS "Unit Price",
    /* Original LineTotal minus its proportional discount */
    T1."LineTotal" - 
    (CASE 
        WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" > 0 THEN T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        WHEN T0."DiscSum" > 0 THEN (T1."LineTotal"/NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)) * T0."DiscSum"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "Net Amount",
    /* Discount Amount for this line item */
    (CASE 
        WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" > 0 THEN T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        WHEN T0."DiscSum" > 0 THEN (T1."LineTotal"/NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)) * T0."DiscSum"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "Discount Amount",
    T1."Quantity" * T2."SWeight1" AS "Item Weight",
    T1."Quantity" * COALESCE(T2."U_PC", 1) AS "T.PC",
    /* Original LineTotal before discount */
    T1."LineTotal" AS "Gross Amount"
FROM 
    OINV T0  
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode" 
    INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
    INNER JOIN OCHP T4 ON T2."ChapterID" = T4."AbsEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" 
    INNER JOIN OCRG T6 ON T5."GroupCode" = T6."GroupCode"
WHERE
    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocType" = 'I'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum" AS "Document Number",
    T0."DocDate" AS "Date",
    'Credit Memo' AS "Document Type",
    T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
    T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
    T6."GroupName",
    T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Description",
    T2."ItmsGrpCod" AS "Item Group Code",
    T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
    T4."Chapter" AS "HSN Code",
    -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity",
    T1."Price" AS "Unit Price",
    /* Negative Net Amount for credit memos */
    -(T1."LineTotal" - 
    (CASE 
        WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" > 0 THEN T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        WHEN T0."DiscSum" > 0 THEN (T1."LineTotal"/NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)) * T0."DiscSum"
        ELSE 0 
    END)) AS "Net Amount",
    /* Negative Discount Amount for credit memos */
    -(CASE 
        WHEN T0."DiscPrcnt" > 0 THEN T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)
        WHEN T0."DiscSum" > 0 THEN (T1."LineTotal"/NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)) * T0."DiscSum"
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "Discount Amount",
    -ABS(T1."Quantity" * T2."SWeight1") AS "Item Weight",
    -ABS(T1."Quantity" * COALESCE(T2."U_PC", 1)) AS "T.PC",
    /* Negative Gross Amount for credit memos */
    -T1."LineTotal" AS "Gross Amount"
FROM 
    ORIN T0  
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode" 
    INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod" 
    INNER JOIN OCHP T4 ON T2."ChapterID" = T4."AbsEntry" 
    INNER JOIN OCRD T5 ON T0."CardCode" = T5."CardCode" 
    INNER JOIN OCRG T6 ON T5."GroupCode" = T6."GroupCode"
WHERE
    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

ORDER BY
    "Date" DESC,
    "Document Number" ASC;

description: Sales Order to Invoice Allocation Report (Open and Closed last X months)
sql:
WITH InvoiceMap AS (
    -- Map Sales Order lines to Invoice lines (via Delivery)
    SELECT
        T0_P1."DocEntry" AS "SO_DocEntry",
        T0_P1."LineNum" AS "SO_LineNum",
        T5."DocNum" AS "Inv_No",
        T5."DocDate" AS "Inv_Date",
        T5."DocStatus" AS "Inv_Status",
        T4."Quantity" AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM OINV T5
    INNER JOIN INV1 T4
        ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN DLN1 T2
        ON T4."BaseEntry" = T2."DocEntry"
        AND T4."BaseLine" = T2."LineNum"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 15
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0_P1
        ON T2."BaseEntry" = T0_P1."DocEntry"
        AND T2."BaseLine" = T0_P1."LineNum"
        AND T2."BaseType" = 17
    WHERE T5."CANCELED" = 'N'

    UNION ALL

    -- Map Sales Order lines to Invoice lines (Direct Invoice)
    SELECT
        T0_P2."DocEntry" AS "SO_DocEntry",
        T0_P2."LineNum" AS "SO_LineNum",
        T5."DocNum" AS "Inv_No",
        T5."DocDate" AS "Inv_Date",
        T5."DocStatus" AS "Inv_Status",
        T4."Quantity" AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM OINV T5
    INNER JOIN INV1 T4
        ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0_P2
        ON T4."BaseEntry" = T0_P2."DocEntry"
        AND T4."BaseLine" = T0_P2."LineNum"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 17
    WHERE T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
),

SalesOrderLines AS (
    SELECT
        T1."DocNum" AS "SO_No",
        T1."DocDate" AS "SO_Date",
        T1."CardName" AS "Customer_Name",
        T1."DocStatus" AS "SO_Status",
        T1."DocCur" AS "Currency",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."LineNum" AS "SO_Line",
        T0."Quantity" AS "SO_Qty",
        T0."OpenQty" AS "Open_Qty",
        M."Inv_No",
        M."Inv_Date",
        M."Inv_Status",
        COALESCE(M."Inv_Qty", 0) AS "Inv_Qty"
    FROM ORDR T1
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T0
        ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceMap M
        ON T0."DocEntry" = M."SO_DocEntry"
        AND T0."LineNum" = M."SO_LineNum"
    WHERE
        T1."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND (
            -- Always show Open Sales Orders
            T1."DocStatus" = 'O'

            -- Show Closed Sales Orders only if invoice is within last 3 months
            OR (
                T1."DocStatus" = 'C'
                AND M."Inv_Date" >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -(?))
            )
        )
),

SplitRows AS (
    -- Rows having invoices
    SELECT
        "SO_No",
        "SO_Date",
        "Customer_Name",
        "SO_Status",
        "Currency",
        CAST("Inv_No" AS VARCHAR(50)) AS "Group_Inv_No",
        "Inv_Date",
        "Inv_Status",
        "Inv_Qty" AS "Allocated_SO_Qty",
        0 AS "Allocated_Open_Qty",
        "Inv_Qty" AS "Allocated_Inv_Qty"
    FROM SalesOrderLines
    WHERE "Inv_No" IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Open balance / No invoice rows
    SELECT
        "SO_No",
        "SO_Date",
        "Customer_Name",
        "SO_Status",
        "Currency",
        'No Invoice' AS "Group_Inv_No",
        NULL AS "Inv_Date",
        NULL AS "Inv_Status",
        "Open_Qty" AS "Allocated_SO_Qty",
        "Open_Qty" AS "Allocated_Open_Qty",
        0 AS "Allocated_Inv_Qty"
    FROM SalesOrderLines
    WHERE
        "Open_Qty" > 0
        OR "Inv_No" IS NULL
)

SELECT
    "SO_No" AS "SO No",
    "SO_Date" AS "SO Date",
    "Customer_Name" AS "Customer Name",
    "SO_Status" AS "SO Status",
    "Currency",

    SUM("Allocated_SO_Qty") AS "Total SO Qty",
    SUM("Allocated_Open_Qty") AS "Total Open Qty",

    CASE
        WHEN "Group_Inv_No" = 'No Invoice'
            THEN NULL
        ELSE "Group_Inv_No"
    END AS "Invoice No",

    "Inv_Date" AS "Invoice Date",
    "Inv_Status" AS "Invoice Status",

    SUM("Allocated_Inv_Qty") AS "Invoiced Qty"

FROM SplitRows

GROUP BY
    "SO_No",
    "SO_Date",
    "Customer_Name",
    "SO_Status",
    "Currency",
    "Group_Inv_No",
    "Inv_Date",
    "Inv_Status"

ORDER BY
    "SO_No",
    CASE WHEN "Group_Inv_No" = 'No Invoice' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    "Group_Inv_No";

WITH
BaseData AS (
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum" AS "Net_Sales_LC"
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        -(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
    FROM ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
),
CurrentPeriod AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS "Current_FY",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 3 ELSE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) + 9 END AS "Current_FY_Month_Num",
        ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1) AS "Month_Start",
        ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AS "Prev_Year_Today",
        ADD_MONTHS(ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1), -12) AS "Prev_Month_Start",
        DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AS "MTD_Days",
        DAYOFMONTH(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12)) AS "Prev_MTD_Days"
    FROM DUMMY
),
CurrentYTDSales AS (
    SELECT "Customer_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group","FY_Year"
),
PreviousYearSales AS (
    SELECT "Customer_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Full_Year_Sales"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group","FY_Year"
),
PreviousYTDSales AS (
    SELECT "Customer_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
        AND "FY_Month_Num" <= (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group","FY_Year"
),
-- MTD aggregates (this month up to today vs same month last year up to same day)
CurrentMTD AS (
    SELECT "Customer_Group", SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "MTD_Sales"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group"
),
PreviousMTD AS (
    SELECT "Customer_Group", SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "MTD_Sales"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Prev_Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= (SELECT "Prev_Year_Today" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group"
),
Growth_Calc AS (
    SELECT 
        curr."Customer_Group",
        curr."FY_Year" AS "Current_FY",
        curr."YTD_Sales" AS "Current_YTD",
        prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" AS "Previous_Full_Year",
        prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" AS "Previous_YTD",
        (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod) AS "Months_Upto_Current",

        -- YTD growth metrics (unchanged)
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" IS NULL OR prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Sales" - prev_ytd."YTD_Sales") / prev_ytd."YTD_Sales" * 100, 2)
        END AS "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",

        CASE 
            WHEN prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" IS NULL OR prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(curr."YTD_Sales" / prev_full."Full_Year_Sales" * 100, 2)
        END AS "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",

        ROUND(curr."YTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Avg_Monthly_Sales",
        ROUND(COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Sales",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Sales",

        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Sales",0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (curr."YTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                    - (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Sales",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                )
                / (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Sales",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "Avg_Monthly_Sales_Growth_%",

        -- 🔹 MTD Avg Monthly Sales Growth % (average per day, MTD vs same-month MTD last year)
        cm."MTD_Sales" AS "Current_MTD_Sales",
        pm."MTD_Sales" AS "Previous_MTD_Sales",
        ROUND(cm."MTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        ROUND(pm."MTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        CASE 
            WHEN pm."MTD_Sales" IS NULL OR (SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod) = 0 OR pm."MTD_Sales" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (cm."MTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                    - (pm."MTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                )
                / (pm."MTD_Sales" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Sales_Growth_%"
    FROM CurrentYTDSales curr
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYearSales  prev_full ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev_full."Customer_Group"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYTDSales   prev_ytd  ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev_ytd."Customer_Group"
    LEFT JOIN CurrentMTD         cm        ON curr."Customer_Group" = cm."Customer_Group"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousMTD        pm        ON curr."Customer_Group" = pm."Customer_Group"
)

SELECT 
    "Customer_Group",
    "Current_FY",
    "Current_YTD",
    "Previous_Full_Year",
    "Previous_YTD",
    "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",
    "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",
    "Avg_Monthly_Sales",
    "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Sales",
    "Avg_Monthly_Sales_Growth_%",
    "Current_MTD_Sales",
    "Previous_MTD_Sales",
    "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Sales_Growth_%",  -- << requested
    CASE 
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 25 THEN 'High Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 20 THEN 'Normal Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" < -10 THEN 'Declining'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 'New/No Previous Data'
        ELSE 'Stable'
    END AS "Growth_Category"
FROM Growth_Calc
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" DESC,
    "Customer_Group";

description: Sales Comparsion Customer wise Item Group wise
sql:
WITH SalesData AS (
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- Financial Year starts from April
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END AS "Fiscal Year",
            T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
            T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
            T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
            SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Qty",      -- Total Quantity Sold
            SUM(T1."LineTotal") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSum", 0)) AS "Total Sales"  -- Net Sales Value after Discount
        FROM OINV T0
        INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
        INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
        INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
        WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR transactions
        GROUP BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END,
            T3."ItmsGrpNam",
            T0."CardCode",
            T0."CardName"
    )

    SELECT 
        A."Fiscal Year" AS "Current Year",
        A."Item Group",
        A."Customer Code",
        A."Customer Name",
        COALESCE(A."Total Qty", 0) AS "Current Year Qty",
        COALESCE(A."Total Sales", 0) AS "Current Year Sales",
        COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) AS "Previous Year Qty",
        COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
        
    -- Growth/Decline for Qty
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "Qty Growth/Decline (%)",

    -- Growth/Decline for Sales Value
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Sales" - B."Total Sales") / NULLIF(B."Total Sales", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "Sales Growth/Decline (%)"

    FROM SalesData A
    LEFT JOIN SalesData B ON A."Fiscal Year" = B."Fiscal Year" + 1 
        AND A."Item Group" = B."Item Group"
        AND A."Customer Code" = B."Customer Code"
    WHERE A."Fiscal Year" = '2025'  -- Replace with the required financial year
    ORDER BY A."Fiscal Year" DESC, A."Item Group", A."Customer Name";

SELECT 
    A."ItemCode",
    A."Item Name",
    A."Year",
    A."Total Ordered Quantity",
    A."Total Order Value",
    (A."Total Ordered Quantity" - COALESCE(B."Total Ordered Quantity", 0)) AS "YoY Quantity Change",
    ROUND((A."Total Ordered Quantity" - COALESCE(B."Total Ordered Quantity", 0)) / NULLIF(B."Total Ordered Quantity", 0) * 100, 2) AS "YoY Quantity (%) Growth",
    (A."Total Order Value" - COALESCE(B."Total Order Value", 0)) AS "YoY Value Change",
    ROUND((A."Total Order Value" - COALESCE(B."Total Order Value", 0)) / NULLIF(B."Total Order Value", 0) * 100, 2) AS "YoY Value (%) Growth"
FROM 
(
    SELECT 
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
        YEAR(T0."DocDate") AS "Year",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Ordered Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM ORDR T0
    JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription", YEAR(T0."DocDate")
) A
LEFT JOIN 
(
    SELECT 
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
        YEAR(T0."DocDate") + 1 AS "Year",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Ordered Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM ORDR T0
    JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription", YEAR(T0."DocDate")
) B 
ON A."ItemCode" = B."ItemCode" AND A."Year" = B."Year"
ORDER BY A."ItemCode", A."Year" DESC;

SELECT 
    
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- April to Dec (same year)
        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1  -- Jan to March (previous year)
    END AS "Financial Year",
OITM."U_OLDERPCOD", 
    OITM."ItemName",
    SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Ordered Quantity",
    SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
FROM ORDR T0
JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
JOIN OITM ON OITM."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  -- Exclude canceled orders
AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR currency transactions
GROUP BY 
    OITM."U_OLDERPCOD", 
    OITM."ItemName",
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1  
    END
ORDER BY 
    OITM."U_OLDERPCOD", 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1  
    END DESC;

description: Customer & Item Sales Order Trend Analysis (Last 5 Years)
sql:
WITH FinancialYearOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        MAX(T0."CardName") AS "CardName",
        T1."ItemCode",
        MAX(ITEM."ItemName") AS "Item Name", -- Permanent fix: Item Master se name pick hoga
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- FY starts in April
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FinancialYear",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM ORDR T0
    JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    JOIN OITM ITEM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITEM."ItemCode" -- OITM table join ki gayi hai
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR transactions
    GROUP BY T0."CardCode", T1."ItemCode",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END
),
FY1 AS (SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
FY2 AS (SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END),
FY3 AS (SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END),
FY4 AS (SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END),
FY5 AS (SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END),

-- Master unique spine strictly based on Code combinations
MasterKeys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "CardCode", "ItemCode" FROM FinancialYearOrders
)

SELECT 
    K."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
    COALESCE(FY1."CardName", FY2."CardName", FY3."CardName", FY4."CardName", FY5."CardName") AS "Customer Name",
    K."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
    COALESCE(FY1."Item Name", FY2."Item Name", FY3."Item Name", FY4."Item Name", FY5."Item Name") AS "Item Name",

    -- FY Header Labels
    'FY ' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + 1 AS NVARCHAR) AS "FY1",

    'FY ' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END + 1 AS NVARCHAR) AS "FY2",

    'FY ' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END + 1 AS NVARCHAR) AS "FY3",

    'FY ' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END + 1 AS NVARCHAR) AS "FY4",

    'FY ' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END + 1 AS NVARCHAR) AS "FY5",

    -- Total Orders for Last 5 Years
    FY1."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders FY1",
    FY2."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders FY2",
    FY3."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders FY3",
    FY4."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders FY4",
    FY5."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders FY5",

    -- Total Quantity for Last 5 Years
    FY1."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity FY1",
    FY2."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity FY2",
    FY3."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity FY3",
    FY4."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity FY4",
    FY5."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity FY5",

    -- Total Order Value for Last 5 Years
    FY1."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value FY1",
    FY2."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value FY2",
    FY3."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value FY3",
    FY4."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value FY4",
    FY5."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value FY5"

FROM MasterKeys K
LEFT JOIN FY1 ON K."CardCode" = FY1."CardCode" AND K."ItemCode" = FY1."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN FY2 ON K."CardCode" = FY2."CardCode" AND K."ItemCode" = FY2."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN FY3 ON K."CardCode" = FY3."CardCode" AND K."ItemCode" = FY3."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN FY4 ON K."CardCode" = FY4."CardCode" AND K."ItemCode" = FY4."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN FY5 ON K."CardCode" = FY5."CardCode" AND K."ItemCode" = FY5."ItemCode"
ORDER BY "Customer Code", "Item Code";

description: Customer & Item Sales Order Trend Analysis YOY
sql:
WITH FinancialYearOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T3."CardName",                          -- OCRD Customer Name
        T1."ItemCode",
        T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",           -- OITM Item Name
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- FY starts in April
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FinancialYear",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM ORDR T0
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."CardCode" = T3."CardCode"   -- OCRD join
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR transactions
    GROUP BY T0."CardCode", T3."CardName", T1."ItemCode", T2."ItemName",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END
),
CurrentFY AS (
    SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders 
    WHERE "FinancialYear" = 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) 
        ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
    END
),
PreviousFY AS (
    SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders 
    WHERE "FinancialYear" = 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
        ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2 
    END
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(CY."CardCode", PY."CardCode") AS "Customer Code",
    COALESCE(CY."CardName", PY."CardName") AS "Customer Name",   -- अब OCRD से
    COALESCE(CY."ItemCode", PY."ItemCode") AS "Item Code",
    COALESCE(CY."Item Name", PY."Item Name") AS "Item Name",

    'FY ' || CAST(CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || 
    CAST(CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) END AS NVARCHAR) AS "Selected Financial Year",

    'FY ' || CAST(CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2 END AS NVARCHAR) 
    || '-' || 
    CAST(CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS NVARCHAR) AS "Previous Financial Year",

    CY."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders (Current FY)",
    PY."Total Orders" AS "Total Orders (Previous FY)",

    CY."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity (Current FY)",
    PY."Total Quantity" AS "Total Quantity (Previous FY)",

    CY."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value (Current FY)",
    PY."Total Order Value" AS "Total Order Value (Previous FY)",

    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(CY."Total Orders", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0), 0) * 100, 2) 
    END AS "YoY Order Growth (%)",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PY."Total Quantity", 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(CY."Total Quantity", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Quantity", 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(PY."Total Quantity", 0), 0) * 100, 2) 
    END AS "YoY Quantity Growth (%)",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(CY."Total Order Value", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0), 0) * 100, 2) 
    END AS "YoY Value Growth (%)"

FROM CurrentFY CY
FULL OUTER JOIN PreviousFY PY ON CY."CardCode" = PY."CardCode" AND CY."ItemCode" = PY."ItemCode"
ORDER BY "YoY Value Growth (%)" DESC;

WITH CombinedData AS (
    -- Invoices
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Orders",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Value_LC"
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' and  T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_YEARS(?, -1) AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes (as negative)
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",
        -COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry"),
        -SUM(T1."Quantity"),
        -SUM(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100))
    FROM ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N' and  T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_YEARS(?, -1) AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END
),

Pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        "CardCode",
        "CardName",
        "ItemCode",
        "Item Name",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) ELSE YEAR(?) - 1 END 
            THEN "Orders" ELSE 0 END) AS "Current FY Orders",
        
        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) - 1 ELSE YEAR(?) - 2 END 
            THEN "Orders" ELSE 0 END) AS "Previous FY Orders",

        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) ELSE YEAR(?) - 1 END 
            THEN "Quantity" ELSE 0 END) AS "Current FY Quantity",

        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) - 1 ELSE YEAR(?) - 2 END 
            THEN "Quantity" ELSE 0 END) AS "Previous FY Quantity",

        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) ELSE YEAR(?) - 1 END 
            THEN "Value_LC" ELSE 0 END) AS "Current FY Value",

        MAX(CASE WHEN "FY_Year" = 
            CASE WHEN MONTH(?) >= 4 THEN YEAR(?) - 1 ELSE YEAR(?) - 2 END 
            THEN "Value_LC" ELSE 0 END) AS "Previous FY Value"
    FROM CombinedData
    GROUP BY 
        "CardCode", "CardName", "ItemCode", "Item Name"
)

SELECT *,
    CASE 
        WHEN "Previous FY Orders" = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND(("Current FY Orders" - "Previous FY Orders") * 100.0 / "Previous FY Orders", 2)
    END AS "YoY Order Growth (%)",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN "Previous FY Quantity" = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND(("Current FY Quantity" - "Previous FY Quantity") * 100.0 / "Previous FY Quantity", 2)
    END AS "YoY Quantity Growth (%)",

    CASE 
        WHEN "Previous FY Value" = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE ROUND(("Current FY Value" - "Previous FY Value") * 100.0 / "Previous FY Value", 2)
    END AS "YoY Value Growth (%)"

FROM Pivoted
ORDER BY "YoY Value Growth (%)" DESC;

description: Customer Item-wise YOY SALES ORDER Comparison
sql:
WITH FinancialOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
        T0."DocDate",  -- Add DocDate to SELECT

        CASE 
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? THEN 'Current'
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_YEARS(?, -1) AND ADD_YEARS(?, -1) THEN 'Previous'
        END AS "FY_Type",

        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"

    FROM ORDR T0
    JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
        AND (
            T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? OR
            T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_YEARS(?, -1) AND ADD_YEARS(?, -1)
        )
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", 
        T0."CardName", 
        T1."ItemCode", 
        T1."Dscription",
        T0."DocDate",  -- Add DocDate to GROUP BY
        CASE 
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? THEN 'Current'
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_YEARS(?, -1) AND ADD_YEARS(?, -1) THEN 'Previous'
        END
),
CurrentFY AS (
    SELECT 
        "CardCode",
        "CardName",
        "ItemCode",
        "Item Name",
        SUM("Total Orders") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM("Total Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
        SUM("Total Order Value") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM FinancialOrders 
    WHERE "FY_Type" = 'Current'
    GROUP BY "CardCode", "CardName", "ItemCode", "Item Name"
),
PreviousFY AS (
    SELECT 
        "CardCode",
        "CardName",
        "ItemCode",
        "Item Name",
        SUM("Total Orders") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM("Total Quantity") AS "Total Quantity",
        SUM("Total Order Value") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM FinancialOrders 
    WHERE "FY_Type" = 'Previous'
    GROUP BY "CardCode", "CardName", "ItemCode", "Item Name"
)

SELECT 
    COALESCE(CF."CardCode", PF."CardCode") AS "Customer Code",
    COALESCE(CF."CardName", PF."CardName") AS "Customer Name",
    COALESCE(CF."ItemCode", PF."ItemCode") AS "Item Code",
    COALESCE(CF."Item Name", PF."Item Name") AS "Item Name",

    CF."Total Orders" AS "Current FY Orders",
    PF."Total Orders" AS "Previous FY Orders",

    CF."Total Quantity" AS "Current FY Quantity",
    PF."Total Quantity" AS "Previous FY Quantity",

    CF."Total Order Value" AS "Current FY Value",
    PF."Total Order Value" AS "Previous FY Value",

    -- YoY % Growth (Orders)
    CASE 
        WHEN NULLIF(PF."Total Orders", 0) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((CF."Total Orders" - PF."Total Orders") / NULLIF(PF."Total Orders", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "YoY Order Growth (%)",

    -- YoY % Growth (Quantity)
    CASE 
        WHEN NULLIF(PF."Total Quantity", 0) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((CF."Total Quantity" - PF."Total Quantity") / NULLIF(PF."Total Quantity", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "YoY Quantity Growth (%)",

    -- YoY % Growth (Value)
    CASE 
        WHEN NULLIF(PF."Total Order Value", 0) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((CF."Total Order Value" - PF."Total Order Value") / NULLIF(PF."Total Order Value", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "YoY Value Growth (%)"

FROM CurrentFY CF
FULL OUTER JOIN PreviousFY PF 
    ON CF."CardCode" = PF."CardCode" AND CF."ItemCode" = PF."ItemCode"
ORDER BY "YoY Value Growth (%)"

SELECT 
        TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY') AS "Month",
        COUNT(T0."DocNum") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0))) AS "Total Doc Amount",
        SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) + T0."DiscSum") AS "Before Discount Amount",
        SUM(T0."DiscSum") AS "Discount Amount",
        SUM((IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0)) AS "Taxable Amount"
        --- SUM(T0."VatSum") AS "Tax Amount"
        -- SUM(T0."TotalExpns") AS "Freight Amount",
        --- SUM(T0."RoundDif") AS "RoundOff Amount"
    FROM ORDR T0
    INNER JOIN OBPL T9 ON T0."BPLId" = T9."BPLId"
    LEFT OUTER JOIN CRD1 T1 ON T1."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" 
        AND T1."Address" = T0."ShipToCode" AND T1."AdresType" = 'S'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN NNM1 ON NNM1."Series" = T0."Series" 
        AND IFNULL(T0."Indicator", '') <> '76'
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" IN ('Y','N') 
        AND T0."DocStatus" <> 'C'
    GROUP BY TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY')
    ORDER BY MIN(T0."DocDueDate");

description: Customer Order Due report Detail with Delay
sql:
SELECT 
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'MM YYYY') AS "Month",
    T0."BPLName", 
    (CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' AND T0."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'Canceled' 
        ELSE 'Closed' 
    END) AS "Status",
    NNM1."Indicator" AS "Period Ind", 
    NNM1."SeriesName", 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate" AS "Posting Date", 
    T0."NumAtCard" AS "Customer Ref No", 
    T0."TaxDate" AS "Document Date", 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    REPLACE(T0."Address", CHAR(13), ' ') AS "BillingAddress", 
    (SELECT "TaxId0" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "PANNo", 
    (SELECT V1."Name" FROM RDR12 V0 INNER JOIN OCST V1 ON V1."Code" = V0."StateB" AND V1."Country" = V0."CountryB" WHERE V0."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry") AS "State", 
    (SELECT V0."CityS" FROM RDR12 V0 WHERE V0."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry") AS "City", 
    REPLACE(T0."Address2", CHAR(13), ' ') AS "ShippingAddress", 
    (SELECT "TaxId11" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "TINNo", 
    (SELECT "TaxId3" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "ServiceTaxNo", 
    (SELECT "TaxId1" FROM CRD7 WHERE CRD7."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" AND IFNULL(CRD7."Address", '') = '' AND "AddrType" = 'S') AS "CSTNo", 
    T1."GSTRegnNo" AS "GSTNumber", 
    (IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) + T0."DiscSum" AS "Before Discount Amount", 
    T0."DiscSum" AS "Discount Amount", 
    (IFNULL(T0."DocTotal", 0)) - IFNULL(T0."VatSum", 0) - IFNULL(T0."TotalExpns", 0) - IFNULL(T0."RoundDif", 0) AS "Taxable Amount", 
    T0."TotalExpns" AS "Freight Amount", 
    T0."VatSum" AS "Tax Amount", 
    T0."RoundDif", 
    T0."DocTotal", 
    T0."DocDueDate" AS "Due Date", 
    (DAYS_BETWEEN(NOW(), T0."DocDueDate")) * -1 AS "Overdue days"
FROM ORDR T0
INNER JOIN OBPL T9 ON T0."BPLId" = T9."BPLId"
LEFT OUTER JOIN CRD1 T1 ON T1."CardCode" = T0."CardCode" 
    AND T1."Address" = T0."ShipToCode" AND T1."AdresType" = 'S'
LEFT OUTER JOIN NNM1 ON NNM1."Series" = T0."Series" 
    AND IFNULL(T0."Indicator", '') <> '76'
WHERE T0."CANCELED" IN ('Y','N') 
    AND T0."DocStatus" <> 'C'
ORDER BY T0."DocDueDate";

WITH FinancialYearOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- FY starts in April
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FinancialYear",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Orders",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value"
    FROM ORDR T0
    JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR transactions
    GROUP BY T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", 
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END
),
CurrentFY AS (
    SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) 
        ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
    END
),
PreviousFY AS (
    SELECT * FROM FinancialYearOrders WHERE "FinancialYear" = 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
        ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2 
    END
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(CY."CardCode", PY."CardCode") AS "Customer Code",
    COALESCE(CY."CardName", PY."CardName") AS "Customer Name",
    
    -- Fixed CONCAT() issue using proper nesting
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 
        THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('FY ', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)), CONCAT('-', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) + 1))
        ELSE CONCAT(CONCAT('FY ', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1), CONCAT('-', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))
    END AS "Selected Financial Year",

    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 
        THEN CONCAT(CONCAT('FY ', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1), CONCAT('-', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)))
        ELSE CONCAT(CONCAT('FY ', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2), CONCAT('-', YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1))
    END AS "Previous Financial Year",

    COALESCE(CY."Total Orders", 0) AS "Total Orders (Selected FY)",
    COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0) AS "Total Orders (Previous FY)",
    COALESCE(CY."Total Order Value", 0) AS "Total Order Value (Selected FY)",
    COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0) AS "Total Order Value (Previous FY)",

    -- Customer Retention Status
    CASE 
        WHEN PY."CardCode" IS NOT NULL AND CY."CardCode" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Retained'
        WHEN PY."CardCode" IS NULL AND CY."CardCode" IS NOT NULL THEN 'New'
        WHEN PY."CardCode" IS NOT NULL AND CY."CardCode" IS NULL THEN 'Lost'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS "Customer Status",

    -- Year-over-Year Order & Value Changes
    COALESCE(CY."Total Orders", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0) AS "YoY Order Change",
    ROUND((COALESCE(CY."Total Orders", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Orders", 0)) / NULLIF(PY."Total Orders", 0) * 100, 2) AS "YoY Order % Growth",
    
    COALESCE(CY."Total Order Value", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0) AS "YoY Value Change",
    ROUND((COALESCE(CY."Total Order Value", 0) - COALESCE(PY."Total Order Value", 0)) / NULLIF(PY."Total Order Value", 0) * 100, 2) AS "YoY Value % Growth"

FROM CurrentFY CY
FULL OUTER JOIN PreviousFY PY ON CY."CardCode" = PY."CardCode"
ORDER BY "YoY Value % Growth" DESC;

description: Customer Sales Order Analysis with First & Last Order WITH OP-CL COUNT & Monthly Average
sql:
WITH ActiveMonths AS (
    SELECT 
        T1."CardCode",
        COUNT(DISTINCT TO_VARCHAR(T1."DocDate", 'YYYYMM')) AS "ActiveMonthCount"
    FROM ORDR T1
    WHERE T1."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T1."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY T1."CardCode"
),
BP_Country AS (
    SELECT 
        "CardCode", 
        MIN("Country") AS "Country"
    FROM CRD1 
    WHERE "AdresType" = 'B'
    GROUP BY "CardCode"
),
DocStatusCount AS (
    SELECT 
        T1."CardCode",
        COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 1 END) AS "Open Orders",
        COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS "Closed Orders"
    FROM ORDR T1
    WHERE T1."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T1."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY T1."CardCode"
)

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T0."CardCode") AS "Sl No",
    T0."CardCode" AS "Client No",
    T0."CardName" AS "Name",
    T0."CardFName" AS "Company Name",
    IFNULL(CRC."Name", BC."Country") AS "Country",
    T0."Phone1" AS "Phone Number",
    T0."E_Mail" AS "Email",
    T0."CntctPrsn" AS "Contact Person",
    CASE T0."CardType"

    END AS "Client Type",

    D."Open Orders",
    D."Closed Orders",

    SUM(T3."Quantity") AS "Total Order Quantity",
    ROUND(SUM(T3."LineTotal"), 2) AS "Total Order Amount (Rs)",
    ROUND(SUM(T3."LineTotal") / 10000000, 2) AS "Total Order Value (Rs Cr)",

FROM 
    OCRD T0
    INNER JOIN ORDR T1 ON T0."CardCode" = T1."CardCode"

WHERE 
    T1."CANCELED" = 'N' AND

description: Customer-wise Foreign Sales Report Consolidated Report
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",  
    T0."CardName",  
    T0."DocCur",
    --T0."DocDate",
    COUNT(T0."DocNum") AS "OrderCount",  
    SUM(T0."DocTotalFC") AS "TotalForeignAmount",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN
            SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate")), 3, 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate") + 1), 3, 2)
        ELSE
            SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1), 3, 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate")), 3, 2)
    END AS "FinancialYear"

FROM 
    ORDR T0 
WHERE 
    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
GROUP BY 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName", 
    T0."DocCur",
    --T0."DocDate",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN
            SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate")), 3, 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate") + 1), 3, 2)
        ELSE
            SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1), 3, 2) || '-' || SUBSTRING(TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."DocDate")), 3, 2)
    END

SELECT 
    "FinYear",
    "Customer Code",
    "Customer Name",
    SUM("Net Amount") AS "Net Sales (LC)",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "DocumentType" = 'Invoice' THEN "DocEntry" END) AS "Invoice Count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "DocumentType" = 'CreditNote' THEN "DocEntry" END) AS "Credit Note Count"
FROM (
    -- Invoices and Debit Memos
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."TaxDate") >= 4 
                THEN TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate")) || '-' || TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate") + 1)
            ELSE TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate") - 1) || '-' || TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate"))
        END AS "FinYear",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") - MAX(T0."DiscSum") AS "Net Amount",  -- Apply discount once per document
        T0."DocEntry",
        'Invoice' AS "DocumentType"
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocType" IN ('I', 'D')  -- Invoice / Debit Memo
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."TaxDate", T0."DocEntry"

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes and Returns (as negative)
    SELECT 
        T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."TaxDate") >= 4 
                THEN TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate")) || '-' || TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate") + 1)
            ELSE TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate") - 1) || '-' || TO_VARCHAR(YEAR(T0."TaxDate"))
        END AS "FinYear",
        -1 * (SUM(T1."LineTotal") - MAX(T0."DiscSum")) AS "Net Amount",  -- Subtract discount once per document
        T0."DocEntry",
        'CreditNote' AS "DocumentType"
    FROM ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocType" IN ('S', 'R')  -- Credit Memo / Return
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."TaxDate", T0."DocEntry"
) AS Combined
GROUP BY 
    "FinYear", "Customer Code", "Customer Name"
ORDER BY 
    "FinYear", "Customer Code";

description: Monthly - Item Wise Order Trend Analysis
sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") 
        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
    END AS "Fiscal Year",
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 
        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 
    END AS "Fiscal Month",T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", 
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
    SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Ordered Quantity",
    SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") AS "Total Order Value (Foreign)",
    T1."Currency",
    T1."Rate",
    SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Order Value (Line Total)"
FROM ORDR T0
JOIN RDR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  and  T1."Currency" <> 'INR' -- Exclude canceled orders
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") 
        ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
    END,
    CASE 
        WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 
        ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 
    END,
T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", 
    T1."ItemCode", 
    T1."Dscription",
    T1."Currency",
    T1."Rate"
ORDER BY 
    "Fiscal Year" ASC, 
    "Fiscal Month" ASC, 
    "Total Order Value (Foreign)" ASC;

-- Step 1: Base data from Invoices and Credit Memos
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",
        (SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        MONTHNAME(T0."DocDate") AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",
        -1 * (SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
    FROM ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OCRG."GroupName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
),

-- Step 2: Monthly Aggregation
MonthlyAgg AS (
    SELECT 
        "Customer_Group",
        "FY_Year",
        "FY_Month_Num",
        "Month_Name",
        SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Monthly_Sales_LC"
    FROM BaseData
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num", "Month_Name"
),

-- Step 3: YTD Aggregation
YTDAgg AS (
    SELECT 
        "Customer_Group",
        "FY_Year",
        SUM("Monthly_Sales_LC") AS "YTD_Sales_LC"
    FROM MonthlyAgg
    GROUP BY "Customer_Group", "FY_Year"
),

-- Step 4: Combine MTD and Previous Year MTD for Growth %
MTD_Growth AS (
    SELECT 
        curr."Customer_Group",
        curr."FY_Year",
        curr."FY_Month_Num",
        curr."Month_Name",
        curr."Monthly_Sales_LC" AS "Current_MTD",
        prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" AS "Previous_MTD",
        CASE 
            WHEN prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((curr."Monthly_Sales_LC" - prev."Monthly_Sales_LC") / prev."Monthly_Sales_LC" * 100, 2)
        END AS "MTD_Growth_Percent"
    FROM MonthlyAgg curr
    LEFT JOIN MonthlyAgg prev
        ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev."Customer_Group"
        AND curr."FY_Month_Num" = prev."FY_Month_Num"
        AND curr."FY_Year" = prev."FY_Year" + 1
),

-- Step 5: Combine YTD and Previous YTD
YTD_Growth AS (
    SELECT 
        curr."Customer_Group",
        curr."FY_Year",
        curr."YTD_Sales_LC" AS "Current_YTD",
        prev."YTD_Sales_LC" AS "Previous_YTD",
        CASE 
            WHEN prev."YTD_Sales_LC" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Sales_LC" - prev."YTD_Sales_LC") / prev."YTD_Sales_LC" * 100, 2)
        END AS "YTD_Growth_Percent"
    FROM YTDAgg curr
    LEFT JOIN YTDAgg prev
        ON curr."Customer_Group" = prev."Customer_Group"
        AND curr."FY_Year" = prev."FY_Year" + 1
)

-- Final Output
SELECT 
    M."Customer_Group",
    M."FY_Year",
    M."FY_Month_Num",
    M."Month_Name",
    M."Current_MTD",
    M."Previous_MTD",
    M."MTD_Growth_Percent",
    Y."Current_YTD",
    Y."Previous_YTD",
    Y."YTD_Growth_Percent"
FROM MTD_Growth M
LEFT JOIN YTD_Growth Y
    ON M."Customer_Group" = Y."Customer_Group"
    AND M."FY_Year" = Y."FY_Year"
ORDER BY 
    M."Customer_Group", M."FY_Year", M."FY_Month_Num";

description: Sales Comparison Customer Wise Item Wise
sql:
WITH SalesData AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- Financial Year starts from April
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
        END AS "Fiscal Year",
        T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
        T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
        T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Qty",      -- Total Quantity Sold
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSum", 0)) AS "Total Sales", -- Net Sales Value after Discount
        SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSumFC", 0)) AS "Total Sales FC" -- Net Sales Value in FC
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Exclude INR transactions
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
        END,
        T3."ItmsGrpNam",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T2."ItemName",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName"
)

SELECT 
    A."Fiscal Year" AS "Current Year",
    A."Item Group",
    A."Item Code",
    A."Item Name",
    A."Customer Code",
    A."Customer Name",
    COALESCE(A."Total Qty", 0) AS "Current Year Qty",
    COALESCE(A."Total Sales", 0) AS "Current Year Sales",
    COALESCE(A."Total Sales FC", 0) AS "Current Year Sales FC",
    COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) AS "Previous Year Qty",
    COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
    COALESCE(B."Total Sales FC", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales FC",
    
    -- Growth/Decline for Quantity
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0) * 100, 2) 
    END AS "Qty Growth/Decline (%)",

    -- Growth/Decline for Sales Value
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Sales" - B."Total Sales") / NULLIF(B."Total Sales", 0) * 100, 2) 
    END AS "Sales Growth/Decline (%)"


FROM SalesData A
LEFT JOIN SalesData B ON A."Fiscal Year" = B."Fiscal Year" + 1 
    AND A."Item Group" = B."Item Group"
    AND A."Item Code" = B."Item Code"
    AND A."Customer Code" = B."Customer Code"
WHERE A."Fiscal Year" = '2025'  -- Replace with the required financial year
ORDER BY A."Fiscal Year" DESC, A."Item Group", A."Item Name", A."Customer Name";
