    A."Customer Name",
    COALESCE(A."Total Qty", 0) AS "Current Year Qty",
    COALESCE(A."Total Sales", 0) AS "Current Year Sales",
    COALESCE(A."Total Sales FC", 0) AS "Current Year Sales FC",
    COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) AS "Previous Year Qty",
    COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
    COALESCE(B."Total Sales FC", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales FC",
    
    -- Growth/Decline for Quantity
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN '100%'
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0) * 100, 2) || '%' 
    END AS "Qty Growth/Decline %",
    
    -- Growth/Decline for Sales Value
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) = 0 THEN '100%'
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Sales" - B."Total Sales") / NULLIF(B."Total Sales", 0) * 100, 2) || '%' 
    END AS "Sales Growth/Decline %",

    -- Forecasted Quantity
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN A."Total Qty"  -- If no previous year data, use current year qty
        ELSE ROUND(A."Total Qty" * (1 + (A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0)), 2)
    END AS "Forecasted Qty",

    -- Forecasted Growth %
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(A."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN '0%' -- Avoid division by zero
        ELSE ROUND(((ROUND(A."Total Qty" * (1 + (A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0)), 2) - A."Total Qty") / NULLIF(A."Total Qty", 0)) * 100, 2) || '%'
    END AS "Forecast Growth %"

FROM SalesData A
LEFT JOIN SalesData B ON A."Fiscal Year" = B."Fiscal Year" + 1 
        AND A."Item Group" = B."Item Group"
        AND A."Item Code" = B."Item Code"
        AND A."Customer Code" = B."Customer Code"
WHERE A."Fiscal Year" = '2024'  -- Replace with the required financial year
ORDER BY A."Fiscal Year" DESC, A."Item Group", A."Item Name", A."Customer Name";

WITH SalesData AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  -- Financial Year starts from April
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
        END AS "Fiscal Year",
        T3."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
        SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Qty",      -- Total Quantity Sold
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "Total Sales"    -- Total Sales Value
    FROM OINV T0
    INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  -- Filter non-INR transactions
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
        END,
        T3."ItmsGrpNam"
)

SELECT 
    A."Fiscal Year" AS "Current Year",
    A."Item Group",
    A."Total Qty" AS "Current Year Qty",
    A."Total Sales" AS "Current Year Sales",
    COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) AS "Previous Year Qty",
    COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
    
    -- Growth/Decline for Quantity
    CASE 
        WHEN B."Total Qty" = 0 THEN '100%'
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / B."Total Qty" * 100, 2) || '%' 
    END AS "Qty Growth/Decline %",
    
    -- Growth/Decline for Sales Value
    CASE 
        WHEN B."Total Sales" = 0 THEN '100%'
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Sales" - B."Total Sales") / B."Total Sales" * 100, 2) || '%' 
    END AS "Sales Growth/Decline %"

FROM SalesData A
LEFT JOIN SalesData B ON A."Fiscal Year" = B."Fiscal Year" + 1 
        AND A."Item Group" = B."Item Group"
WHERE A."Fiscal Year" = '2025'  -- Replace with desired financial year
ORDER BY A."Fiscal Year" DESC, A."Item Group";

SELECT 
    Sales."Fiscal Year" AS "Current Year",
    Sales."Month",
    Sales."DocCur",
    COALESCE(Sales."Total Sales", 0) - COALESCE(Credit."Total Credit Notes", 0) AS "Net Sales",
    COALESCE(Sales."Total Sales FC", 0) - COALESCE(Credit."Total Credit Notes FC", 0) AS "Net Sales FC",
    COALESCE(PrevSales."Total Sales", 0) - COALESCE(PrevCredit."Total Credit Notes", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
    COALESCE(PrevSales."Total Sales FC", 0) - COALESCE(PrevCredit."Total Credit Notes FC", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales FC",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PrevSales."Total Sales", 0) - COALESCE(PrevCredit."Total Credit Notes", 0) = 0 THEN '100%'
        ELSE ROUND(((COALESCE(Sales."Total Sales", 0) - COALESCE(Credit."Total Credit Notes", 0)) - 
                    (COALESCE(PrevSales."Total Sales", 0) - COALESCE(PrevCredit."Total Credit Notes", 0))) / 
                    (COALESCE(PrevSales."Total Sales", 1) - COALESCE(PrevCredit."Total Credit Notes", 0)) * 100, 2) || '%' 
    END AS "Growth/Decline %"
FROM 
    (
        -- Sales Data
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END AS "Fiscal Year",
            MONTH(T0."DocDate") AS "Month",
            T0."DocCur",
            SUM(T0."DocTotal") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSum", 0)) AS "Total Sales",
            SUM(T0."DocTotalFC") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSumFC", 0)) AS "Total Sales FC"
        FROM OINV T0
        WHERE 
            T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  
            AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  
            AND NOT EXISTS (  -- Exclude invoices that have credit memos
                SELECT 1 
                FROM ORIN T3
                INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
                WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
            )
        GROUP BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END,
            MONTH(T0."DocDate"),
            T0."DocCur"
    ) Sales
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        -- Credit Notes
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T3."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T3."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T3."DocDate") - 1 
            END AS "Fiscal Year",
            MONTH(T3."DocDate") AS "Month",
            T3."DocCur",
            SUM(T4."LineTotal") * -1 AS "Total Credit Notes",
            SUM(T4."TotalFrgn") * -1 AS "Total Credit Notes FC"
        FROM ORIN T3
        INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE T3."CANCELED" = 'N'  
        AND T3."DocCur" <> 'INR'  
        GROUP BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T3."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T3."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T3."DocDate") - 1 
            END,
            MONTH(T3."DocDate"),
            T3."DocCur"
    ) Credit 
ON Sales."Fiscal Year" = Credit."Fiscal Year" 
AND Sales."Month" = Credit."Month"
AND Sales."DocCur" = Credit."DocCur"

LEFT JOIN 
    (
        -- Previous Year Sales Data
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END AS "Fiscal Year",
            MONTH(T0."DocDate") AS "Month",
            T0."DocCur",
            SUM(T0."DocTotal") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSum", 0)) AS "Total Sales",
            SUM(T0."DocTotalFC") - SUM(COALESCE(T0."DiscSumFC", 0)) AS "Total Sales FC"
        FROM OINV T0
        WHERE 
            T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  
            AND T0."DocCur" <> 'INR'  
            AND NOT EXISTS (  
                SELECT 1 
                FROM ORIN T3
                INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
                WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
            )
        GROUP BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 
            END,
            MONTH(T0."DocDate"),
            T0."DocCur"
    ) PrevSales
ON Sales."Fiscal Year" = PrevSales."Fiscal Year" + 1 
AND Sales."Month" = PrevSales."Month"
AND Sales."DocCur" = PrevSales."DocCur"

LEFT JOIN 
    (
        -- Previous Year Credit Notes
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T3."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T3."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T3."DocDate") - 1 
            END AS "Fiscal Year",
            MONTH(T3."DocDate") AS "Month",
            T3."DocCur",
            SUM(T4."LineTotal") * -1 AS "Total Credit Notes",
            SUM(T4."TotalFrgn") * -1 AS "Total Credit Notes FC"
        FROM ORIN T3
        INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE T3."CANCELED" = 'N'  
        AND T3."DocCur" <> 'INR'  
        GROUP BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN MONTH(T3."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T3."DocDate")  
                ELSE YEAR(T3."DocDate") - 1 
            END,
            MONTH(T3."DocDate"),
            T3."DocCur"
    ) PrevCredit
ON PrevSales."Fiscal Year" = PrevCredit."Fiscal Year" 
AND PrevSales."Month" = PrevCredit."Month"
AND PrevSales."DocCur" = PrevCredit."DocCur"

WHERE Sales."Fiscal Year" = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY Sales."Fiscal Year" DESC, Sales."Month";

SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocCur", -- Customer Currency
    
    -- Total Sales in Customer Currency
    SUM(T0."DocTotal") AS "Total Sales (Customer Currency)", 
    SUM( T0."DocTotalFC") as "FC", 

    -- Total Sales in System Currency: Use DocTotal for INR, DocTotalFC for foreign currency
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocCur" = 'INR' THEN T0."DocTotal" 
        ELSE T0."DocTotalFC"
    END) AS "Total Sales (System Currency)"

FROM 
    OINV T0
INNER JOIN 
    OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode" -- Join to filter by customer group
WHERE 
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  -- Exclude canceled invoices
    AND T0."DocTotal" > 0  -- Exclude credit notes (negative values)
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?  -- Date range filter
    AND T2."GroupCode" = '100'  -- Filter by customer group

    -- Exclude invoices that have been credited via credit memos
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM ORIN T3
        INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
    )
GROUP BY 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    T0."DocCur"
ORDER BY 
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocCur" = 'INR' THEN T0."DocTotal" 
        ELSE T0."DocTotalFC"
    END) DESC;

description: Sales Analysis Report ITEM Wise (Local & Foreign Currency)
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
    T0."DocCur", -- Customer Currency

    -- Consolidated Quantity Sold
    SUM(T1."Quantity") AS "Total Quantity Sold",

    -- Total Sales in INR (Less Discount)
    SUM(T1."LineTotal") - SUM(T0."DiscSum") AS "Total Sales (INR)",

    -- Total Sales in Foreign Currency (Less Discount)
    SUM(T1."TotalFrgn") - SUM(T0."DiscSumFC") AS "Total Sales (Foreign Currency)",

    -- Total Sales in System Currency (Handles Local & Foreign Currency) - Less Discount
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN T0."DocCur" = 'INR' THEN (T1."LineTotal" - T0."DiscSum") 
            ELSE (T1."TotalFrgn" - T0."DiscSumFC")
        END
    ) AS "Total Sales (System Currency)"

FROM 
    OINV T0
INNER JOIN 
    INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"  -- Join Invoice Lines
INNER JOIN 
    OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"  -- Join Customer Master
WHERE 
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  -- Exclude canceled invoices
    AND T0."DocTotal" > 0  -- Exclude credit notes
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?  -- Date range filter
    AND T2."GroupCode" = '100'  -- Filter by customer group (optional)

    -- Exclude invoices that have been credited via credit memos
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM ORIN T3
        INNER JOIN RIN1 T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
    )

GROUP BY 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    T1."ItemCode", 
    T1."Dscription", 
    T0."DocCur"
ORDER BY 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T1."ItemCode";

SELECT 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocCur"          AS "Currency",          -- use header currency, not line
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Order Count",
        SUM(T1."OpenSum")    AS "Total LC",
        SUM(T1."OpenSumFC")  AS "Total FC"
    FROM ORDR T0
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 
        ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    WHERE 
        T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."DocCur"
    ORDER BY 
        "Total LC" DESC;

SELECT 
    "Customer_Group",
    "DocNum" AS "Invoice_Number",
    "CardCode" AS "Customer_Code",
    "ItemCode",
    "DocCur" AS "Currency",
    "DocRate" AS "Exchange_Rate",
    "ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
    "DocDate",
    "FY_Year",
    "FY_Month_Num",
    "Month_Name",
    SUM("Net_Sales_LC") AS "Net_Sales_LC",
    SUM("Net_Sales_FC") AS "Net_Sales_FC",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "DocEntry") AS "Invoice_Count",
    SUM("Quantity") AS "Total_Quantity"
FROM (
    -- Invoices
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."DocCur", 
        T0."DocRate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocDate",
        
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        TO_NVARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'Month') AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",
        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        (T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        T1."Quantity"
    FROM 
        OINV T0
    INNER JOIN 
        INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN 
        OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN 
        OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN
        OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN
        OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -5*365)  -- Last 5 years filter

    UNION ALL

    -- Credit Notes (as negative)
    SELECT 
        OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."DocCur", 
        T0."DocRate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam",
        T0."DocDate",
        
        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "FY_Year",

        CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3
            ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9
        END AS "FY_Month_Num",

        TO_NVARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'Month') AS "Month_Name",
        T0."DocEntry",
        -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_LC",
        -(T1."TotalFrgn" - (T1."TotalFrgn" * T0."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net_Sales_FC",
        -T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity"
    FROM 
        ORIN T0
    INNER JOIN 
        RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN 
        OCRD ON T0."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
    INNER JOIN 
        OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
    LEFT JOIN
        OITM ON T1."ItemCode" = OITM."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN
        OITB ON OITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE 
        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T0."DocDate" >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -5*365)  -- Last 5 years filter
) T
GROUP BY 
    "Customer_Group", "CardCode", "ItemCode", "ItmsGrpNam", 
    "DocCur", "DocRate", "DocNum", "DocDate", 
    "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num", "Month_Name"
ORDER BY 
    "Customer_Group", "Customer_Code", "Item_Group", 
    "ItemCode", "DocCur", "DocRate", "DocNum",
    "DocDate", "FY_Year", "FY_Month_Num";

SELECT 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."Currency",
    COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Order Count",
    SUM(T1."OpenSum") AS  "Total LC",
    SUM( T1."OpenSumFC") AS "Total FC"
FROM 
    ORDR T0
    INNER JOIN RDR1 T1 
        ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
WHERE 
    T0."DocStatus" = 'O'    -- Order open
    AND T1."LineStatus" = 'O' -- Line open
GROUP BY 
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."Currency"
ORDER BY 
    "Total LC" DESC;

WITH AP_Invoice AS (
    SELECT
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."Series",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocDate",
        T0."TaxDate",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."NumAtCard",
        T0."BPLId",
        T0."CANCELED",
        T0."DocStatus",
        T0."DocType",                  -- << added
        T0."Indicator",
        T0."VatSum"         AS "TaxAmt",
        T0."TotalExpns"     AS "FreightAmt",
        T0."DiscSum"        AS "HdrDisc",
        T0."RoundDif"       AS "RoundDif",
        T0."DocTotal"       AS "DocTotal",
        T0."PaidToDate"     AS "PaidAmt",
        T0."WTSum"          AS "WTSum",
        T0."GSTTranTyp"     AS "GSTTranTyp",
        T0."Address"        AS "BillAddr",
        T0."Address2"       AS "ShipAddr",
        T0."ShipToCode"     AS "ShipToCode",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "LineAmt"
    FROM OPCH T0
    INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY
        T0."DocEntry", T0."Series", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."TaxDate",
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."NumAtCard", T0."BPLId",
        T0."CANCELED", T0."DocStatus", T0."DocType",    -- << added
        T0."Indicator",
        T0."VatSum", T0."TotalExpns", T0."DiscSum", T0."RoundDif", T0."DocTotal",
        T0."PaidToDate", T0."WTSum", T0."GSTTranTyp", T0."Address", T0."Address2", T0."ShipToCode"
),
AP_CreditMemo AS (
    SELECT
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."Series",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."DocDate",
        T0."TaxDate",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName",
        T0."NumAtCard",
        T0."BPLId",
        T0."CANCELED",
        T0."DocStatus",
        T0."DocType",                  -- << added
        T0."Indicator",
        - T0."VatSum"         AS "TaxAmt",
        - T0."TotalExpns"     AS "FreightAmt",
        - T0."DiscSum"        AS "HdrDisc",
        - T0."RoundDif"       AS "RoundDif",
        - T0."DocTotal"       AS "DocTotal",
        0                     AS "PaidAmt",
        - T0."WTSum"          AS "WTSum",
        T0."GSTTranTyp"       AS "GSTTranTyp",
        T0."Address"          AS "BillAddr",
        T0."Address2"         AS "ShipAddr",
        T0."ShipToCode"       AS "ShipToCode",
        - SUM(T1."LineTotal") AS "LineAmt"
    FROM ORPC T0
    INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    GROUP BY
        T0."DocEntry", T0."Series", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."TaxDate",
        T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."NumAtCard", T0."BPLId",
        T0."CANCELED", T0."DocStatus", T0."DocType",    -- << added
        T0."Indicator",
        T0."VatSum", T0."TotalExpns", T0."DiscSum", T0."RoundDif", T0."DocTotal",
        T0."WTSum", T0."GSTTranTyp", T0."Address", T0."Address2", T0."ShipToCode"
),
Docs AS (
    SELECT * FROM AP_Invoice
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM AP_CreditMemo
)
SELECT
    B."BPLName"                                AS "Branch Name",
    D."CANCELED",
    CASE
        WHEN D."DocTotal" <> D."PaidAmt" AND D."PaidAmt" <> 0 THEN 'Partially Paid'
        WHEN D."PaidAmt" = 0 THEN 'Pending'
        ELSE 'Paid'
    END                                         AS "Payment Status",
    CASE
        WHEN D."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN D."DocStatus" = 'C' AND D."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'Canceled'
        ELSE 'Closed'
    END                                         AS "Document Status",
    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(D."GSTTranTyp",'') = 'GA' THEN 'GST Tax Invoice'
        WHEN IFNULL(D."GSTTranTyp",'') = 'GD' THEN 'GST Debit Memo'
        ELSE 'Bill Of Supply'
    END                                         AS "Document Type",
    N."Indicator"                               AS "Period Indicator",
    N."SeriesName",
    D."DocNum",
    D."DocDate"                                 AS "Posting Date",
    D."NumAtCard"                               AS "Vendor Ref No",
    D."TaxDate"                                 AS "Document Date",
    D."CardCode",
    D."CardName",
    D."DocType",                                -- << raw DocType (I/S)
    CASE                                         -- << friendly name
        WHEN D."DocType" = 'I' THEN 'Item'
        WHEN D."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service'
        ELSE D."DocType"
    END AS "DocType Name",
    REPLACE(D."BillAddr", CHAR(13), ' ')        AS "Billing Address",

    /* AP logistics (billing State/City from PCH12) */
    (SELECT S."Name"
    FROM PCH12 I
    JOIN OCST S ON S."Code" = I."StateB" AND S."Country" = I."CountryB"
    WHERE I."DocEntry" = D."DocEntry")        AS "State",
    (SELECT I."CityB" FROM PCH12 I WHERE I."DocEntry" = D."DocEntry") AS "City",

    REPLACE(D."ShipAddr", CHAR(13), ' ')        AS "Shipping Address",

    /* Supplier statutory IDs */
    (SELECT "TaxId0"  FROM CRD7 X WHERE X."CardCode" = D."CardCode" AND IFNULL(X."Address",'') = '' AND X."AddrType"='S') AS "PAN No",
    (SELECT "TaxId11" FROM CRD7 X WHERE X."CardCode" = D."CardCode" AND IFNULL(X."Address",'') = '' AND X."AddrType"='S') AS "TIN No",
    (SELECT "TaxId3"  FROM CRD7 X WHERE X."CardCode" = D."CardCode" AND IFNULL(X."Address",'') = '' AND X."AddrType"='S') AS "Service Tax No",
    (SELECT "TaxId1"  FROM CRD7 X WHERE X."CardCode" = D."CardCode" AND IFNULL(X."Address",'') = '' AND X."AddrType"='S') AS "CST No",

    C1."GSTRegnNo"                              AS "GST Number",

    /* Amount build-up */
    (D."LineAmt" + D."HdrDisc")                  AS "Before Discount Amount",
    D."HdrDisc"                                  AS "Discount Amount",
    (D."LineAmt" + D."FreightAmt" - D."HdrDisc") AS "Taxable Amount",
    D."FreightAmt"                               AS "Freight Amount",
    D."TaxAmt"                                   AS "Tax Amount",
    D."RoundDif"                                 AS "RoundDif",
    D."DocTotal"                                 AS "DocTotal",
    D."WTSum"                                    AS "WTSum",
    D."PaidAmt"                                  AS "Paid Amount",
    (D."DocTotal" - D."PaidAmt")                 AS "Pending Amount"

FROM Docs D
LEFT JOIN OBPL  B  ON B."BPLId"   = D."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN CRD1  C1 ON C1."CardCode" = D."CardCode"
            AND C1."Address"  = D."ShipToCode"
            AND C1."AdresType"= 'S'
LEFT JOIN NNM1  N  ON N."Series"  = D."Series"
WHERE D."CANCELED" = 'N';

SELECT 
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocStatus",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."BPLName",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T1."LineNum",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    T3."ItmsGrpNam",
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."unitMsr",
    T1."Price",
    -- Invoice Amount calculations
    T1."LineTotal" AS "Gross Invoice Amount",
    (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net Invoice Amount",
    -- Tax calculations
    (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Taxable Amount",
    T1."DiscPrcnt" AS "Discount %",
    (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100) AS "Discount Amount",
    T1."VatPrcnt" AS "Tax Rate %",
    ((T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) * T1."VatPrcnt"/100) AS "Tax Amount",
    T1."WhsCode",
    T0."Ref1",
    T0."Ref2",
    'Invoice' AS "Document Type",
    -- Document totals
    T0."DocTotal" AS "Document Total",
    T0."VatSum" AS "Total Tax Amount",
    T0."DiscSum" AS "Total Discount Amount",
    T0."Comments"
FROM 
    OPCH T0  
INNER JOIN 
    PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
INNER JOIN 
    OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode" 
INNER JOIN 
    OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE 
    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? 
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

UNION ALL

    T0."DocEntry",

    T1."Dscription",

    T1."Price",
    -- Credit Note amounts (negative)
    -T1."LineTotal" AS "Gross Invoice Amount",
    -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Net Invoice Amount",
    -- Tax calculations for credit notes
    -(T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) AS "Taxable Amount",
    T1."DiscPrcnt" AS "Discount %",
    -(T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100) AS "Discount Amount",
    T1."VatPrcnt" AS "Tax Rate %",
    -((T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * T1."DiscPrcnt"/100)) * T1."VatPrcnt"/100) AS "Tax Amount",
    T1."WhsCode",
    
    T0."Ref1",
    T0."Ref2",
    'Credit Note' AS "Document Type",
    -- Document totals (negative)
    -T0."DocTotal" AS "Document Total",
    -T0."VatSum" AS "Total Tax Amount",
    -T0."DiscSum" AS "Total Discount Amount",
T0."Comments"
FROM

INNER JOIN

INNER JOIN 
    OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode" 
INNER JOIN

    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

FROM

    T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

    AND T3."ItmsGrpCod" NOT IN (160, 187, 186, 163, 162, 140, 164, 172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 179, 180, 182, 183, 184, 188, 189, 190)
    --AND NOT EXISTS-- ( -- This correctly excludes AP Invoices that have a Credit Memo against them
        --SELECT 'X'
        --FROM "ORPC" T6

    T6."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'

    "CardName", "DocDate", "DocumentType";

SELECT 
        T0."DocNum" AS "AP_Invoice_Number",
        T0."DocDate" AS "AP_Invoice_Date",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Vendor_Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Vendor_Name",
        T1."BaseRef" AS "GRN_Number",
        GRN."DocDate" AS "GRN_Date",
        PO."DocNum" AS "PO_Number",
        PO."DocDate" AS "PO_Date",
        T1."ItemCode" AS "Item_Code",
        T1."Dscription" AS "Item_Description",
        T1."Quantity" AS "Quantity",
        GRN_DETAIL."Price" AS "GRN_Price",
        PO_DETAIL."Price" AS "PO_Price",
        T1."Price" AS "AP_Invoice_Price",
        GRN_DETAIL."Price" - PO_DETAIL."Price" AS "GRN_vs_PO_Diff",
        T1."Price" - GRN_DETAIL."Price" AS "AP_vs_GRN_Diff"
    FROM 
        OPCH T0 -- AP Invoice Header
        INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" -- AP Invoice Details
        INNER JOIN OPDN GRN ON T1."BaseEntry" = GRN."DocEntry" AND T1."BaseType" = 20 -- Linked GRN Header
        INNER JOIN PDN1 GRN_DETAIL ON GRN."DocEntry" = GRN_DETAIL."DocEntry" AND T1."BaseLine" = GRN_DETAIL."LineNum" -- Linked GRN Details
        INNER JOIN POR1 PO_DETAIL ON GRN_DETAIL."BaseEntry" = PO_DETAIL."DocEntry" AND GRN_DETAIL."BaseLine" = PO_DETAIL."LineNum" -- Linked PO Details
        INNER JOIN OPOR PO ON PO."DocEntry" = PO_DETAIL."DocEntry" -- PO Header
    WHERE 
        (T1."Price" <> GRN_DETAIL."Price" OR GRN_DETAIL."Price" <> PO_DETAIL."Price") -- Check Price Differences
        AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N' -- Exclude canceled AP invoices
        AND GRN."CANCELED" = 'N' -- Exclude canceled GRNs
        AND PO."CANCELED" = 'N' -- Exclude canceled POs
        AND T0."DocDate" >= ? -- Start date
        AND T0."DocDate" <= ? -- End date

    AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 'X'
            FROM "ORPC" T6
            INNER JOIN "RPC1" T7 ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
            WHERE T0."DocEntry" = T7."BaseEntry" -- Exclude credit memos
        )

SELECT DISTINCT
    T6."DocNum"                     AS "Purchase Request No",
    T6."DocDate"                    AS "PR Date",
    T6."ReqDate"                    AS "PR Req Date",
    T8."RefDocNum"                  AS "Sales Order No",
    T8."Remark"                     AS "Sales Order Remark",
    T5."DocNum"                     AS "PO No",
    T5."DocDate"                    AS "PO Date",
    T0."DocDueDate"                 AS "PO DueDate",
    T5."U_W_ORDER"                  AS "PO W Order",
    T0."Comments"                   AS "PO Remarks",
    T5."NumAtCard"                  AS "PO NumAtCard",
    T5."DocStatus"                  AS "PO Status",

    -- A/P Invoice (Header)
    T0."DocDate"                    AS "AP Doc Date",
    T0."NumAtCard"                  AS "AP NumAtCard",
    T0."DocEntry"                   AS "AP DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum"                     AS "AP DocNum",

    -- Down Payment (Header amounts; no quantities)
    T0."DpmAmnt"                    AS "AP DP Amount",
    T0."DpmAppl"                    AS "AP DP Applied",

    -- Vendor & Item
    T5."CardName"                   AS "Vendor Name",
    T4."ItemCode"                   AS "Item Code",
    T4."Dscription"                 AS "Item Description",

    -- PO values
    T4."Quantity"                   AS "PO Qty",
    T4."Price"                      AS "PO Rate",

    -- AP values (gross and net of credit memos)
    T1."Quantity"                   AS "AP Qty (Gross)",
    T1."Price"                      AS "AP Invoice Rate",

    IFNULL(CM."CM_Qty", 0)          AS "AP CreditMemo Qty",
    (T1."Quantity" - IFNULL(CM."CM_Qty", 0)) AS "AP Qty (Net)",

    (T4."Price" - T1."Price")       AS "Price Diff",
    (T4."Quantity" - (T1."Quantity" - IFNULL(CM."CM_Qty", 0))) AS "Quantity Diff (vs PO, Net)"
FROM "OPCH" T0                                  -- A/P Invoice (Header)
INNER JOIN "PCH1" T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"           -- A/P Invoice (Lines)
INNER JOIN "OCRD" O1  ON T0."CardCode" = O1."CardCode"
INNER JOIN "OITM" I1  ON T1."ItemCode" = I1."ItemCode"

-- Link back to GRPO
INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2 
    ON T1."BaseType" = 20 
    AND T1."BaseEntry" = T2."DocEntry" 
    AND T1."BaseLine"  = T2."LineNum"
INNER JOIN "OPDN" T3 ON T3."DocEntry" = T2."DocEntry"

-- Link back to PO
INNER JOIN "POR1" T4 
    ON T2."BaseType" = 22 
    AND T2."BaseEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
    AND T2."BaseLine"  = T4."LineNum"
INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"

-- Link back to PR
LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T4."BaseEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"

-- Your PR↔SO cross-reference
INNER JOIN "PRQ21" T8 ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"

-- Net out A/P Credit Memo quantities that reference this A/P Invoice & line
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        R1."BaseEntry" AS "AP_DocEntry",
        R1."BaseLine"  AS "AP_LineNum",
        SUM(R1."Quantity") AS "CM_Qty"
    FROM "RPC1" R1         -- A/P Credit Memo (Lines)
    INNER JOIN "ORPC" R0   -- A/P Credit Memo (Header)
        ON R0."DocEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
    WHERE R0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND R1."BaseType" = 18           -- base is A/P Invoice
        AND R1."BaseEntry" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY R1."BaseEntry", R1."BaseLine"
) CM
    ON CM."AP_DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    AND CM."AP_LineNum"  = T1."LineNum"

-- Keep only non-canceled A/P Invoices, POs, GRPOs; PR optional
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N';

sql:
WITH
BaseData AS (
    -- AP Invoices
    SELECT 
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum" AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
    FROM OPCH T0
    INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OITB."ItmsGrpNam", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

    UNION ALL

    -- AP Credit Notes
    SELECT 
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        -(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
    FROM ORPC T0
    INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OITB."ItmsGrpNam", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
),
CurrentPeriod AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS "Current_FY",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 3 ELSE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) + 9 END AS "Current_FY_Month_Num",
        ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1) AS "Month_Start",
        ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AS "Prev_Year_Today",
        ADD_MONTHS(ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1), -12) AS "Prev_Month_Start",
        DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AS "MTD_Days",
        DAYOFMONTH(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12)) AS "Prev_MTD_Days"
    FROM DUMMY
),
CurrentYTDPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
),
PreviousYearPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "Full_Year_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
    GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
),
PreviousYTDPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group","FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
        AND "FY_Month_Num" <= (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group","FY_Year"
),
CurrentMTD AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY "Item_Group"
),
PreviousMTD AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Prev_Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= (SELECT "Prev_Year_Today" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group"
),
Growth_Calc AS (
    SELECT 
        curr."Item_Group",
        curr."FY_Year" AS "Current_FY",
        curr."YTD_Purchase" AS "Current_YTD",
        prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" AS "Previous_Full_Year",
        prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_YTD",
        (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod) AS "Months_Upto_Current",

        CASE 
            WHEN prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Purchase" - prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase") / prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" * 100, 2)
        END AS "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",

        CASE 
            WHEN prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" * 100, 2)
        END AS "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",

        ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
        ROUND(COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",

        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                    - (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                )
                / (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",

        cm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Current_MTD_Purchase",
        pm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
        ROUND(cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        ROUND(pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        CASE 
            WHEN pm."MTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR (SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod) = 0 OR pm."MTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                    - (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                )
                / (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%"
    FROM CurrentYTDPurchase curr
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYearPurchase  prev_full ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_full."Item_Group"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYTDPurchase   prev_ytd  ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_ytd."Item_Group"
    LEFT JOIN CurrentMTD            cm        ON curr."Item_Group" = cm."Item_Group"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousMTD           pm        ON curr."Item_Group" = pm."Item_Group"
)

SELECT 
    "Item_Group",
    "Current_FY",
    "Current_YTD",
    "Previous_Full_Year",
    "Previous_YTD",
    "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",
    "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",
    "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
    "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
    "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
    "Current_MTD_Purchase",
    "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
    "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
    CASE 
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 25 THEN 'High Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 20 THEN 'Normal Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" < -10 THEN 'Declining'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 'New/No Previous Data'
        ELSE 'Stable'
    END AS "Growth_Category"
FROM Growth_Calc
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" DESC,
    "Item_Group";

description: Purchase Analysis Vendor wise and Item Group
sql:
WITH
BaseData AS (
    -- AP Invoices
    SELECT 
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Vendor_Code",
        T2."CardName" AS "Vendor_Name",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum" AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
    FROM OPCH T0
    INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"  -- Vendor Master
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OITB."ItmsGrpNam", T0."CardCode", T2."CardName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"

    UNION ALL

    -- AP Credit Notes
    SELECT 
        OITB."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item_Group",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Vendor_Code",
        T2."CardName" AS "Vendor_Name",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate") ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1 END AS "FY_Year",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") - 3 ELSE MONTH(T0."DocDate") + 9 END AS "FY_Month_Num",
        T0."DocEntry",
        T0."DocDate" AS "DocDate",
        -(SUM(T1."LineTotal") - T0."DiscSum") AS "Net_Purchase_LC"
    FROM ORPC T0
    INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM ITM ON T1."ItemCode" = ITM."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB OITB ON ITM."ItmsGrpCod" = OITB."ItmsGrpCod"
    INNER JOIN OCRD T2 ON T0."CardCode" = T2."CardCode"  -- Vendor Master
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY OITB."ItmsGrpNam", T0."CardCode", T2."CardName", T0."DocEntry", T0."DocDate", T0."DiscSum"
),
CurrentPeriod AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1 END AS "Current_FY",
        CASE WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 3 ELSE MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) + 9 END AS "Current_FY_Month_Num",
        ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1) AS "Month_Start",
        ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AS "Prev_Year_Today",
        ADD_MONTHS(ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)+1), -12) AS "Prev_Month_Start",
        DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AS "MTD_Days",
        DAYOFMONTH(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12)) AS "Prev_MTD_Days"
    FROM DUMMY
),
CurrentYTDPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year"
),
PreviousYearPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "Full_Year_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
    GROUP BY "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year"
),
PreviousYTDPurchase AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "YTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "FY_Year" = (SELECT "Current_FY" FROM CurrentPeriod) - 1
        AND "FY_Month_Num" <= (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", "FY_Year"
),
CurrentMTD AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name"
),
PreviousMTD AS (
    SELECT "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name", SUM("Net_Purchase_LC") AS "MTD_Purchase"
    FROM BaseData
    WHERE "DocDate" >= (SELECT "Prev_Month_Start" FROM CurrentPeriod)
        AND "DocDate" <= (SELECT "Prev_Year_Today" FROM CurrentPeriod)
    GROUP BY "Item_Group", "Vendor_Code", "Vendor_Name"
),
VendorSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        curr."Item_Group",
        curr."Vendor_Code",
        curr."Vendor_Name",
        curr."FY_Year" AS "Current_FY",
        curr."YTD_Purchase" AS "Current_YTD",
        prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" AS "Previous_Full_Year",
        prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_YTD",
        (SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod) AS "Months_Upto_Current",

        CASE 
            WHEN prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((curr."YTD_Purchase" - prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase") / prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase" * 100, 2)
        END AS "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",

        CASE 
            WHEN prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" IS NULL OR prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / prev_full."Full_Year_Purchase" * 100, 2)
        END AS "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",

        ROUND(curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
        ROUND(COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0), 2) AS "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",

        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (curr."YTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                    - (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0))
                )
                / (COALESCE(prev_ytd."YTD_Purchase",0) / NULLIF((SELECT "Current_FY_Month_Num" FROM CurrentPeriod), 0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",

        cm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Current_MTD_Purchase",
        pm."MTD_Purchase" AS "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
        ROUND(cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        ROUND(pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0), 2) AS "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
        CASE 
            WHEN pm."MTD_Purchase" IS NULL OR (SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod) = 0 OR pm."MTD_Purchase" = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (cm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                    - (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0))
                )
                / (pm."MTD_Purchase" / NULLIF((SELECT "Prev_MTD_Days" FROM CurrentPeriod),0)) * 100, 2
            )
        END AS "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%"
    FROM CurrentYTDPurchase curr
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYearPurchase  prev_full ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_full."Item_Group" AND curr."Vendor_Code" = prev_full."Vendor_Code"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousYTDPurchase   prev_ytd  ON curr."Item_Group" = prev_ytd."Item_Group" AND curr."Vendor_Code" = prev_ytd."Vendor_Code"
    LEFT JOIN CurrentMTD            cm        ON curr."Item_Group" = cm."Item_Group" AND curr."Vendor_Code" = cm."Vendor_Code"
    LEFT JOIN PreviousMTD           pm        ON curr."Item_Group" = pm."Item_Group" AND curr."Vendor_Code" = pm."Vendor_Code"
)

SELECT 
    "Item_Group",
    "Vendor_Code",
    "Vendor_Name",
    "Current_FY",
    "Current_YTD",
    "Previous_Full_Year",
    "Previous_YTD",
    "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%",
    "Current_YTD_Pct_of_Prev_Full_Year",
    "Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
    "Prev_Avg_Monthly_Purchase",
    "Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
    "Current_MTD_Purchase",
    "Previous_MTD_Purchase",
    "Current_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "Previous_MTD_Avg_Daily",
    "MTD_Avg_Monthly_Purchase_Growth_%",
    CASE 
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 25 THEN 'High Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" > 20 THEN 'Normal Growth'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" < -10 THEN 'Declining'
        WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 'New/No Previous Data'
        ELSE 'Stable'
    END AS "Growth_Category"
FROM VendorSummary
ORDER BY 
    "Item_Group",
    CASE WHEN "YTD_Growth_vs_Prev_YTD_%" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    "Current_YTD" DESC,
    "Vendor_Name";

SELECT 
    -- PR Details
    T6."DocNum" AS "Purchase Request No",
    T6."DocDate" AS "PR Date",
    T6."ReqDate" AS "PR Req Date",
    T8."RefDocNum" AS "Sales Order No",
    T8."Remark" AS "Sales Order Remark",
    
    -- PO Header Details
    T5."DocNum" AS "PO No",
    T5."DocDate" AS "PO Date",
    T5."DocDueDate" AS "PO DueDate",
    T5."U_W_ORDER" AS "PO W Order",
    T5."Comments" AS "PO Remarks",
    T5."NumAtCard" AS "PO NumAtCard",
    T5."DocStatus" AS "PO Status",
    
    -- Vendor & Item Details
    T5."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
    T7."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
    T7."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
    
    -- PR Quantities
    MAX(T7."Quantity") AS "PR Qty",
    MAX(T7."OpenQty") AS "PR Remaining Qty",
    
    -- PO Quantities
    MAX(CASE WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN T4."Quantity" ELSE 0 END) AS "PO Qty",
    MAX(CASE WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN T4."Price" ELSE 0 END) AS "PO Rate",
    
    -- AP Quantities - Aggregated by PR line
    SUM(COALESCE(T1."Quantity", 0)) AS "AP Qty",
    AVG(COALESCE(T1."Price", 0)) AS "AP Invoice Rate",
    
    -- GRPO Details (First and Last)
    MIN(T3."DocNum") AS "First GRPO No",
    MIN(T3."DocDate") AS "First GRPO Date",
    MIN(T2."Quantity") AS "First GRPO Qty",
    MIN(T2."Price") AS "First GRPO Rate",
    
    MAX(T3."DocNum") AS "Last GRPO No",
    MAX(T3."DocDate") AS "Last GRPO Date",
    MAX(T2."Quantity") AS "Last GRPO Qty",
    MAX(T2."Price") AS "Last GRPO Rate",
    
    -- GRPO Summary
    COUNT(T3."DocNum") AS "GRPO Count",
    SUM(T2."Quantity") AS "GRPO Total Qty",
    AVG(T2."Price") AS "GRPO Avg Rate",
    
    -- AP Invoice Details (First and Last)
    MIN(T0."DocNum") AS "First AP Invoice No",
    MIN(T0."DocDate") AS "First AP Invoice Date",
    MIN(T1."Quantity") AS "First AP Invoice Qty",
    MIN(T1."Price") AS "First AP Invoice Rate",
    
    MAX(T0."DocNum") AS "Last AP Invoice No",
    MAX(T0."DocDate") AS "Last AP Invoice Date",
    MAX(T1."Quantity") AS "Last AP Invoice Qty",
    MAX(T1."Price") AS "Last AP Invoice Rate",
    
    -- AP Invoice Summary
    COUNT(T0."DocNum") AS "AP Invoice Count",
    
    -- Differences
    (MAX(CASE WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN T4."Price" ELSE 0 END) - 
    COALESCE(AVG(T1."Price"), 0)) AS "Price Diff",
    
    (MAX(CASE WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN T4."Quantity" ELSE 0 END) - 
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."Quantity"), 0)) AS "Quantity Diff",
    
    -- Status Message
    MAX(CASE 
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled - PR Item Closed'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NULL AND T7."LineStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PR Item Manually Closed'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T4."Quantity" < T7."Quantity" THEN 'PO Created - Partial'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Created - Open'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PO Created - Closed'
        WHEN T7."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Pending'
        ELSE 'PO Pending'
    END) AS "PO Status Message"

FROM
    "PRQ1" T7  -- PR Line items
    LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN "PRQ21" T8 ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
    
    -- BaseType 1470000113 = Purchase Request
    LEFT JOIN "POR1" T4 ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry" 
                    AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine" 
                    AND T4."BaseType" = 1470000113
    
    LEFT JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
    
    -- BaseType 22 = PO to GRPO
    LEFT JOIN "PDN1" T2 ON T4."DocEntry" = T2."BaseEntry" 
                    AND T4."LineNum" = T2."BaseLine" 
                    AND T2."BaseType" = 22
    LEFT JOIN "OPDN" T3 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry" AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
    
    -- BaseType 20 = Goods Receipt PO to AP Invoice
    LEFT JOIN "PCH1" T1 ON T2."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry" 
                    AND T2."LineNum" = T1."BaseLine" 
                    AND T1."BaseType" = 20
    LEFT JOIN "OPCH" T0 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry" AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

WHERE
    (T6."CANCELED" = 'N' OR T6."CANCELED" IS NULL)
    AND T8."RefDocNum" = ?

GROUP BY
    T6."DocNum",
    T6."DocDate",
    T6."ReqDate",
    T8."RefDocNum",
    T8."Remark",
    T5."DocNum",
    T5."DocDate",
    T5."DocDueDate",
    T5."U_W_ORDER",
    T5."Comments",
    T5."NumAtCard",
    T5."DocStatus",
    T5."CardName",
    T5."CANCELED",
    T7."ItemCode",
    T7."Dscription",
    T7."LineStatus",
    T7."LineNum"

ORDER BY
    T6."DocNum",
    T7."LineNum";

description: Production Subgroup Wise With Item Detail Yesterday
sql:
SELECT 
                'SUBGROUP' AS "LEVEL",
                T1."U_SUBGRP",
                NULL AS "U_BRND",
                NULL AS "ItemCode",
                NULL AS "ItemName",
                NULL AS "U_VMS", 
                NULL AS "U_ITMSZ",
                -- Yesterday Data
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."PlannedQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Planned Qty", 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."RjctQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Total Rejection",  
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."CmpltQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Total Production",
                -- MTD Data
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."PlannedQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Planned Qty", 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."RjctQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Total Rejection",  
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Total Production"
            FROM OWOR T0
            INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
            INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
            WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
            GROUP BY T1."U_SUBGRP"

            HAVING 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."PlannedQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) > 0 
                OR 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."RjctQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) > 0 
                OR 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) > 0 

            UNION ALL

            -- Item Level Aggregation
            SELECT 
                'ITEM' AS "LEVEL",
                T1."U_SUBGRP",T1."U_BRND",
                T1."ItemCode",
                T1."ItemName", 
                T1."U_VMS", 
                T1."U_ITMSZ",
                -- Yesterday Data
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."PlannedQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Planned Qty", 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."RjctQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Total Rejection",  
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN T0."PostDate" = ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, -1) THEN T0."CmpltQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "Yesterday Total Production",
                -- MTD Data
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."PlannedQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Planned Qty", 
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."RjctQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Total Rejection",  
                SUM(CASE 
                        WHEN MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) 
                        AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" 
                        ELSE 0 
                    END) AS "MTD Total Production"

description: Item-Wise Consolidated Consumption Againest Production Qty
sql:
SELECT 
                    T1."ItemCode"         AS "Component Item Code",
                    T3."ItemName"         AS "Component Description",
                    T4."ItmsGrpNam"       AS "Item Group",
                    SUM(T1."Quantity")    AS "Issued Qty",
                    SUM(T2."CmpltQty")    AS "Complete FG Qty"
                FROM 
                    "IGE1" T1
                    INNER JOIN "OIGE" T0 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    LEFT JOIN "OWOR" T2 ON T1."BaseEntry" = T2."DocEntry" AND T1."BaseType" = 202
                    INNER JOIN "OITM" T3 ON T1."ItemCode" = T3."ItemCode"
                    INNER JOIN "OITB" T4 ON T3."ItmsGrpCod" = T4."ItmsGrpCod"
                    LEFT JOIN "OITM" T5 ON T2."ItemCode" = T5."ItemCode"
                WHERE 
                    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                    AND T1."BaseType" = 202         -- Only Issues linked to Production Orders
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    AND T2."Type" = 'S'
                    AND T0."DocNum" <> '25015626'
                    AND T4."ItmsGrpNam" IN ('FUEL & GAS','AB BELTS','RAW MATERIAL','CHEMICALS')
                GROUP BY 
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T3."ItemName",
                    T4."ItmsGrpNam"
                Order BY 
                    T4."ItmsGrpNam"

SELECT
                    T1."U_VMS",
                    T1."U_PRDTYP",
                    T1."U_ITMSZ" AS "Item Size",

                    -- Forging data for Week and MTD
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "FORGING Weekly Production",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "FORGING MTD Production",
                    MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) AS "FORGING In Hand Stock",

                    -- Broaching data for Week and MTD
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "BROACHING Weekly Production",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "BROACHING MTD Production",
                    MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) AS "BROACHING In Hand Stock",

                    -- Quality Inspection data for Week and MTD
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "QUALITY INSPECTION Weekly Production",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "QUALITY INSPECTION MTD Production",
                    MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) AS "QUALITY INSPECTION In Hand Stock",

                    -- Electroplating data for Week and MTD
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "ELECTROPLATING Weekly Production",
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "ELECTROPLATING MTD Production",
                    MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) AS "ELECTROPLATING In Hand Stock"

                FROM OWOR T0
                INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
                WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
                GROUP BY
                    T1."U_VMS",
                    T1."U_ITMSZ",
                    T1."U_PRDTYP"
                HAVING
                    -- Forging filter
                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) <> 0

                    -- Broaching filter
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) <> 0

                    -- Quality Inspection filter
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) <> 0

                    -- Electroplating filter
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' AND WEEK(T0."PostDate") = WEEK(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR SUM(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' AND MONTH(T0."PostDate") = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND YEAR(T0."PostDate") = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) THEN T0."CmpltQty" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                    OR MAX(CASE WHEN T1."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' THEN T1."OnHand" ELSE 0 END) <> 0
                ORDER BY
                    T1."U_VMS";

SELECT
    T0."U_VMS" AS "Row Labels",
    T0."U_ITMSZ" AS "ITEM SIZE",
    T0."U_ITMREGCOD" AS "ITEM_DESC",

        END) AS "Weekly Planned Qty", 
    SUM(CASE

        END) AS "MTD Planned Qty",

INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"

description: EXPORT SALES DETAIL PRODUCT AND CUSTOMER WISE
sql:
SELECT 
    T0."CardCode" AS "Customer Code",
    T0."CardName" AS "Customer Name",

    -- Today Quantity
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."DocDate" = ? 
            THEN T1."Quantity" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Today Quantity",

    -- Today Total (Less header discount)
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN T0."DocDate" = ? 
            THEN T1."LineTotal" - 
                 (T0."DiscSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)))
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Today Total",

    -- MTD Quantity
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) 
            THEN T1."Quantity" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Quantity",

    -- MTD Total (Less header discount)
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) 
            THEN T1."LineTotal" - 
                 (T0."DiscSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(T0."DocTotal",0)))
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Total"

FROM OINV T0  
INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."CardCode" = T3."CardCode"

    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?)

    --         WHEN WEEK(T0."DocDate") = WEEK(?) 
    --         AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."Price" 
    --         ELSE NULL 
    --     END) AS "Weekly Price",
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN WEEK(T0."DocDate") = WEEK(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."LineTotal" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "Weekly Total",
    -- MTD Purchases
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."Quantity" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Quantity",
    -- AVG(CASE 
    --         WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
    --         AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."Price" 
    --         ELSE NULL 
    --     END) AS "MTD Price",
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."LineTotal" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS "MTD Total"
FROM OPCH T0  -- OPCH is the Purchase Orders Header Table
INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"  -- PCH1 is the Purchase Order Detail Table
INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"  -- OITM for Item Information
INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"  -- OITB for Item Group Info
WHERE  T0."CANCELED" = 'N'  -- Exclude canceled purchase orders
GROUP BY T3."ItmsGrpNam"
HAVING SUM(CASE 
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH(?) 
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR(?) THEN T1."Quantity" 
            ELSE 0 
        END) > 0;

SELECT 
    Summary."Production Date",
    Summary."U_VMS",
    Summary."U_ITMREGCOD",
    Summary."U_ITMSZ",
    Summary."U_PRDTYP",

    /* -------- AGGREGATIONS -------- */
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'BLANKING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Blanking",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'FORGING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Forging",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'TRIMMING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Trimming",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'PUNCHING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Punching",
    {{OTHERSTAGE}}
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'SHANK' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Shank Grinding",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'HARD BARREL' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Hard Barrel",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'SOFT BARREL' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Soft Barrel",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'BROACHING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Broaching",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'ROTARY' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Rotary Polish",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'HEAT TREATMENT' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Heat Treatment",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'HEAD FACE AUTOMATIC' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Head Face Automatic",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'HEAD POLISH MANUAL' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Head Polish Manual",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'HEAD POLISH INSPECTION' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Head Polish Inspection",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'RYMAN' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Ryman Polish",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'CNC RYMAN' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "CNC Ryman",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'BELT POLISH' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Belt Polish Manual",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'BELT PROFILE' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Belt Profile",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'STAMPING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Stamping",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'RING POLISH AUTOMATIC' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Ring Polish Automatic",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'QUALITY INSPECTION' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Quality Inspection",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'VIBRATOR' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Vibrator",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'ELECTROPLATING' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "Electroplating",
    SUM(CASE WHEN Summary."U_SUBGRP" = 'D-NICKEL' THEN Summary."CalculatedQty" ELSE 0 END) AS "D-Nickel",

    SUM(Summary."CalculatedQty") AS "Net Total Qty",
    Summary."Order Type"

FROM (
    /* PART 1: Standard Production Receipts (OIGN) */
    SELECT 
        T0."DocDate" AS "Production Date",
        I."U_VMS",
        I."U_ITMREGCOD",
        I."U_ITMSZ",
        I."U_PRDTYP",
        I."U_SUBGRP",
        O."Type" AS "Order Type",
        ABS(ROUND(T1."Quantity")) AS "CalculatedQty"
    FROM OIGN T0
    INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM I ON T1."ItemCode" = I."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OWOR O ON O."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
    WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
        AND O."Type" <> 'D' -- Exclude Disassembly here
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        AND I."U_PRDTYP" = ?
        AND {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
        AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_ITMSZ" = ? )

    UNION ALL

    /* PART 2: Disassembly Production Issues (OIGE) */
    SELECT 
        T0."DocDate" AS "Production Date",
        I."U_VMS",
        I."U_ITMREGCOD",
        I."U_ITMSZ",
        I."U_PRDTYP",
        I."U_SUBGRP",
        O."Type" AS "Order Type",
        -ABS(ROUND(T1."Quantity")) AS "CalculatedQty" -- Negative for Disassembly
    FROM OIGE T0
    INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OITM I ON T1."ItemCode" = I."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OWOR O ON O."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
    WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
        AND O."Type" = 'D' -- Only Disassembly here
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        AND I."U_PRDTYP" = ?
        AND {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
        AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_ITMSZ" = ? )
) Summary

GROUP BY
    Summary."Production Date",
    Summary."U_VMS",
    Summary."U_ITMREGCOD",
    Summary."U_ITMSZ",
    Summary."U_PRDTYP",
    Summary."Order Type"
ORDER BY
    Summary."Production Date",
    Summary."U_VMS";
