description: Receipt Details from Production Report semi-finish
sql:
SELECT 
                --T0."BPLName" AS "Branch Name",
                --T3."U_NAME" AS "User Name",
                --T4."Indicator" AS "Period Ind.",
                --T4."SeriesName" AS "Series Name",
                --T0."DocNum" AS "Receipt No.",
                --T0."DocDate" AS "Receipt Date",
                --T1."BaseRef" AS "Production Order No",
                T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
                ROUND(T1."Quantity") AS "Received Qty.",
                --T1."U_REJUNFIL",
                --T1."U_REJSCAL",
                --T1."U_REJSCR",
                --T1."U_REJUNBRO",
                T1."U_REWRK" AS "Rework",

            CASE 
                    WHEN T1."TranType" = 'C' THEN 'Complete'
                    WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN 'Rejection'
                    ELSE T1."TranType"
                END AS "Status",
                T2."U_ITMSZ",
                T2."U_BRND",
                T2."U_SUBGRP",
                T5."WhsName"
            FROM OIGN T0
            INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
            LEFT OUTER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
            LEFT OUTER JOIN OUSR T3 ON T3."USERID" = T0."UserSign"
            INNER JOIN NNM1 T4 ON T0."Series" = T4."Series"
            INNER JOIN OWHS T5 ON T5."WhsCode" = T1."WhsCode"
            WHERE 
                T1."BaseType" = 202 
                AND T2."ItmsGrpCod" = 164 and T1."TranType" = 'C'
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

            order by 
            T0."DocDate"

SELECT
                    YEAR(T0."DocDate")  AS "Year",
                    MONTH(T0."DocDate") AS "Month",

                    T1."ItemCode"       AS "Item Code",
                    T2."ItemName"       AS "Item Name",
                    T6."PlannedQty"     AS "Planned Qty",

                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."TranType" = 'C' THEN T1."Quantity" ELSE 0 END) AS "Complete Qty",

                    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN T1."Quantity" ELSE 0 END) AS "Rejection Qty",

                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL(IFNULL(T1."U_REJUNFIL",'0'),19,6))  AS "Rejection Unfilling",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL(IFNULL(T1."U_REJSCAL",'0'),19,6))   AS "Rejection Scaling",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL(IFNULL(T1."U_REJSCR",'0'),19,6))    AS "Rejection Scrap",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL(IFNULL(T1."U_REJUNBRO",'0'),19,6))  AS "Rejection Unbroaching",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL(IFNULL(T1."U_REWRK",'0'),19,6))     AS "Rework",

                    T2."U_ITMSZ",
                    T2."U_BRND",
                    T2."U_SUBGRP"

                FROM OIGN T0
                INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                LEFT JOIN OWOR T6 ON T6."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
                LEFT JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OWHS T5 ON T5."WhsCode" = T1."WhsCode"

                WHERE
                    T1."BaseType" = 202
                    AND T2."ItmsGrpCod" = 164
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                GROUP BY
                    YEAR(T0."DocDate"),
                    MONTH(T0."DocDate"),
                    T6."PlannedQty",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T2."ItemName",
                    T2."U_ITMSZ",
                    T2."U_BRND",
                    T2."U_SUBGRP"

                ORDER BY
                    YEAR(T0."DocDate"),
                    MONTH(T0."DocDate");

SELECT
                    T0."DocDate" AS "Receipt Date",
                    T6."Type" AS "Production Type",
                    T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                    T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
                    T6."PlannedQty" AS "Planned Qty",
                    T2."IWeight1" AS "Item Weight (Grams)",
                    /* ===== QUANTITY SECTION ===== */
                    SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN T1."TranType" = 'C' THEN T1."Quantity"
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ) AS "Complete Qty",
                    SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN T1."Quantity"
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ) AS "Rejection Qty",
                    /* ===== REJECTION % ===== */
                    ROUND(
                        CASE
                            WHEN SUM(T1."Quantity") = 0 THEN 0
                            ELSE (
                                SUM(
                                    CASE
                                        WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN T1."Quantity"
                                        ELSE 0
                                    END
                                ) / SUM(T1."Quantity")
                            ) * 100
                        END,
                        2
                    ) AS "Rejection %",
                    /* ===== REJECTION BREAKDOWN ===== */
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL (IFNULL (T1."U_REJUNFIL", '0'), 19, 6)) AS "Rejection Unfilling",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL (IFNULL (T1."U_REJSCAL", '0'), 19, 6)) AS "Rejection Scaling",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL (IFNULL (T1."U_REJSCR", '0'), 19, 6)) AS "Rejection Scrap",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL (IFNULL (T1."U_REJUNBRO", '0'), 19, 6)) AS "Rejection Unbroaching",
                    SUM(TO_DECIMAL (IFNULL (T1."U_REWRK", '0'), 19, 6)) AS "Rework",
                    T2."U_ITMSZ",
                    T2."U_BRND",
                    T2."U_SUBGRP",
                    MAX(
                        CASE
                            WHEN T1."TranType" = 'C' THEN T5."WhsName"
                        END
                    ) AS "Complete Warehouse",
                    MAX(
                        CASE
                            WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN T5."WhsName"
                        END
                    ) AS "Rejection Warehouse",
                    /* ===== WEIGHT SECTION (KG) ===== */
                    ROUND(
                        SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN T1."TranType" = 'C' THEN T1."Quantity" * (IFNULL (T2."IWeight1", 0) / 1000)
                                ELSE 0
                            END
                        ),
                        3
                    ) AS "Complete Weight (KG)",
                    ROUND(
                        SUM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN T1."TranType" = 'R' THEN T1."Quantity" * (IFNULL (T2."IWeight1", 0) / 1000)
                                ELSE 0
                            END
                        ),
                        3
                    ) AS "Rejection Weight (KG)"
                FROM
                    OIGN T0
                    INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                    LEFT JOIN OWOR T6 ON T6."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
                    LEFT JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
                    INNER JOIN OWHS T5 ON T5."WhsCode" = T1."WhsCode"
                WHERE
                    T1."BaseType" = 202
                    AND T2."ItmsGrpCod" = 164
                    ---AND T6."Type" = 'S'
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                GROUP BY
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T2."ItemName",
                    T6."PlannedQty",
                    T2."IWeight1",
                    T2."U_ITMSZ",
                    T2."U_BRND",
                    T2."U_SUBGRP"
                ORDER BY
                    T0."DocDate";

WITH ReceiptData AS (
                SELECT 
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    T1."TranType",
                    T1."U_REJUNFIL",
                    T1."U_REJSCAL",
                    T1."U_REJSCR",
                    T1."U_REJUNBRO",
                    T1."U_REWRK",
                    T1."WhsCode",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."BPLName",
                    T0."UserSign",
                    T0."Series",
                    'RECEIPT'           AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGN T0
                INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    'C'                 AS "TranType",
                    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
                    T1."WhsCode",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."BPLName",
                    T0."UserSign",
                    T0."Series",
                    'ISSUE'             AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGE T0
                INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"    = T1."BaseRef"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND O."Type"      = 'D'
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )
            SELECT 
                MAX(RD."DocDate")                       AS "Receipt Date",
                RD."ProductionOrder"                    AS "Production Order No",

                CASE O."Type"
                    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Standard'
                    WHEN 'D' THEN 'Disassembly'
                    WHEN 'P' THEN 'Special'
                END                                     AS "Production Type",

                CASE O."Status"
                    WHEN 'P' THEN 'Planned'
                    WHEN 'R' THEN 'Released'
                    WHEN 'L' THEN 'Closed'
                    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
                END                                     AS "Production Status",

                RD."ItemCode"                           AS "Item Code",
                I."ItemName"                            AS "Item Name",
                I."IWeight1"                            AS "Item Weight (Gram)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                            THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Complete Qty (Pcs)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Rejection Qty (Pcs)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                            THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Complete Weight (KG)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Rejection Weight (KG)",

                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN RD."U_REJUNFIL" END) AS "Unfilled Rej",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN RD."U_REJSCAL"  END) AS "Scale Rej",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN RD."U_REJSCR"   END) AS "Screen Rej",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN RD."U_REJUNBRO" END) AS "Unbroken Rej",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN RD."U_REWRK"    END) AS "Rework",

                I."U_ITMSZ"                             AS "Item Size",
                I."U_BRND"                              AS "Brand",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                I."U_ITMSECTION",

                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C' THEN W."WhsName" END) AS "Pass Warehouse",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN W."WhsName" END) AS "Rejection Warehouse",

                RD."BPLName"                            AS "Branch Name",
                U."U_NAME"                              AS "User Name",
                N."Indicator"                           AS "Period Ind.",
                N."SeriesName"                          AS "Series Name"

                FROM ReceiptData RD
                LEFT JOIN  OITM I  ON RD."ItemCode"  = I."ItemCode"
                LEFT JOIN  OUSR U  ON U."USERID"     = RD."UserSign"
                INNER JOIN NNM1 N  ON RD."Series"    = N."Series"
                LEFT JOIN  OWHS W  ON RD."WhsCode"   = W."WhsCode"
                LEFT JOIN  OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"     = RD."ProductionOrder"
                WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
                    AND ( ? = '' OR O."Type"= ? )
                    AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_SUBGRP"= ? )
                    -- EXCLUDE DISASSEMBLY POSTIVE RECEIPTS (IGN1)
                    AND NOT (O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT')
                GROUP BY
                    RD."BPLName",
                    U."U_NAME",
                    N."Indicator",
                    N."SeriesName",
                    RD."ProductionOrder",
                    O."Type",
                    O."Status",
                    RD."ItemCode",
                    I."ItemName",
                    I."IWeight1",
                    I."U_ITMSZ",
                    I."U_BRND",
                    I."U_SUBGRP",
                    I."U_ITMSECTION"
                ORDER BY
                MAX(RD."DocDate"),
                RD."ProductionOrder";

sql:
SELECT 
                T0."DocDate" As "Date",
                O."DocNum", 
                T0."ItemCode",
                T2."U_ITMREGCOD",
                T2."U_SUBGRP",
                T2."U_NXTSECTION", 
                T2."U_PRESECTION",

                SUM(T0."InQty")  AS "Total Receipt",
                SUM(T0."OutQty") AS "Total Issue"

            FROM OINM T0

            INNER JOIN OWOR O 
                ON O."DocEntry" = T0."AppObjAbs"

            INNER JOIN OITM T2 
                ON T0."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"

            WHERE
                {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                AND (? = '' OR T2."U_ITMSECTION" = ?)

            GROUP BY 
                T0."DocDate",
                O."DocNum",
                T0."ItemCode",
                T2."U_ITMREGCOD", 
                T2."U_SUBGRP",
                T2."U_NXTSECTION", 
                T2."U_PRESECTION"

            ORDER BY 
                O."DocNum",
                T0."DocDate";

WITH ReceiptData AS (
                SELECT 
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."BaseEntry" AS "ProductionEntry",
                    T1."BaseRef"   AS "ProductionOrder",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    T1."TranType",
                    T1."U_REWRK",
                    T1."U_CHRREP",
                    T1."U_NICREP",
                    T1."U_BLTREP",
                    T1."U_FINFLT",
                    T1."WhsCode",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."BPLName",
                    T0."UserSign",
                    T0."Series"
                FROM OIGN T0
                INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )

            SELECT 
                MAX(RD."DocDate") AS "Receipt Date",
                
                RD."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                --I."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                I."U_ITMSZ" AS "Item Size",
                I."U_BRND"  AS "Brand",
                
                
                /* Complete Qty */
                SUM(
                    CASE 
                    WHEN O."Type" = 'D' 
                    THEN -1 * RD."Quantity"
                    WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C' 
                    THEN RD."Quantity"
                    ELSE 0 
                    END
                    ) AS "Complete Qty (Pcs)",
                    I."IWeight1" AS "Item Weight (Gram)",
                    
                    /* Rejection Qty */
                    SUM(
                        CASE 
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' 
                        THEN RD."Quantity"
                        ELSE 0 
                        END
                        ) AS "Rejection Qty (Pcs)",
                        
                        /* Complete Weight */
                        SUM(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' 
                        THEN -1 * (RD."Quantity" * IFNULL(I."IWeight1",0) / 1000)
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C' 
                        THEN (RD."Quantity" * IFNULL(I."IWeight1",0) / 1000)
                        ELSE 0 
                        END
                ) AS "Complete Weight (KG)",

                /* Rejection Weight */
                SUM(
                    CASE 
                    WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' 
                    THEN (RD."Quantity" * IFNULL(I."IWeight1",0) / 1000)
                        ELSE 0 
                        END
                        ) AS "Rejection Weight (KG)",
                        
                        /* Rejection Reasons (Now Always Show If Exists) */
                        MAX(RD."U_CHRREP") AS "CHROME REPAIR",
                        MAX(RD."U_NICREP") AS "NICKEL REPAIR",
                MAX(RD."U_BLTREP") AS "BELT REPAIR",
                MAX(RD."U_FINFLT") AS "FINISH FAULT",
                MAX(RD."U_REWRK")  AS "REWORK",
                
                
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C' THEN W."WhsName" END) AS "Pass Warehouse",
                MAX(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN W."WhsName" END) AS "Rejection Warehouse",
                
                RD."BPLName" AS "Branch Name",
                U."U_NAME" AS "User Name",
                N."Indicator" AS "Period Ind.",
                N."SeriesName" AS "Series Name",

                RD."ProductionOrder" AS "Production Order No",

                /* Production Type */
                CASE O."Type"
                    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Standard'
                    WHEN 'D' THEN 'Disassembly'
                    WHEN 'P' THEN 'Special'
                END AS "Production Type",

                /* Production Status */
                CASE O."Status"
                    WHEN 'P' THEN 'Planned'
                    WHEN 'R' THEN 'Released'
                    WHEN 'L' THEN 'Closed'
                    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
                END AS "Production Status"

            FROM ReceiptData RD

            LEFT JOIN OITM I   ON RD."ItemCode" = I."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN OUSR U   ON U."USERID" = RD."UserSign"
            INNER JOIN NNM1 N  ON RD."Series" = N."Series"
            LEFT JOIN OWHS W   ON RD."WhsCode" = W."WhsCode"
            LEFT JOIN OWOR O   ON O."DocEntry" = RD."ProductionEntry"

            WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
            AND IFNULL(U."U_NAME",'') NOT IN ('Hrithik', 'Kiran')

            GROUP BY 
                RD."BPLName",
                U."U_NAME",
                N."Indicator",
                N."SeriesName",
                RD."ProductionOrder",
                O."Type",
                O."Status",
                RD."ItemCode",
                I."ItemName",
                I."IWeight1",
                I."U_ITMSZ",
                I."U_BRND",
                I."U_SUBGRP"

            ORDER BY 
                MAX(RD."DocDate"),
                RD."ProductionOrder";

WITH ReceiptData AS (
                SELECT 
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    T1."TranType",
                    T1."U_REJUNFIL",
                    T1."U_REJSCAL",
                    T1."U_REJSCR",
                    T1."U_REJUNBRO",
                    T1."U_REWRK",
                    T1."WhsCode",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."BPLName",
                    T0."UserSign",
                    T0."Series",
                    'RECEIPT'           AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGN T0
                INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                UNION ALL

                SELECT 
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    'C'                 AS "TranType",
                    NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
                    T1."WhsCode",
                    T0."DocNum",
                    T0."BPLName",
                    T0."UserSign",
                    T0."Series",
                    'ISSUE'             AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGE T0
                INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"    = T1."BaseRef"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND O."Type"      = 'D'
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )
            SELECT 
                /* ── Month Label ── */
                YEAR(MAX(RD."DocDate"))                 AS "Year",
                MONTH(MAX(RD."DocDate"))                AS "Month No",
                MONTHNAME(MAX(RD."DocDate"))            AS "Month Name",

                RD."BPLName"                            AS "Branch Name",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                I."U_BRND"                              AS "Brand",
                I."U_ITMSZ"                             AS "Item Size",
            I."U_PRDTYP", I."U_ITMREGCOD",
                RD."ItemCode"                           AS "Item Code",
                I."ItemName"                            AS "Item Name",
                I."IWeight1"                            AS "Item Weight (Gram)",

                CASE O."Type"
                    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Standard'
                    WHEN 'D' THEN 'Disassembly'
                    WHEN 'P' THEN 'Special'
                END                                     AS "Production Type",

                /* ── Quantities ── */
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                            THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Complete Qty (Pcs)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Rejection Qty (Pcs)",

                /* ── Weights ── */
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                            THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Complete Weight (KG)",

                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Rejection Weight (KG)",

                /* ── Net Total (Complete - Rejection) ── */
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                            THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) - 
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                            THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )                                       AS "Net Qty (Pcs)",

                /* ── Rejection Breakdown ── */
                SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJUNFIL", 0) END) AS "Unfilled Rej",
                SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJSCAL",  0) END) AS "Scale Rej",
                SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJSCR",   0) END) AS "Screen Rej",
                SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJUNBRO", 0) END) AS "Unbroken Rej",
                SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REWRK",    0) END) AS "Rework",

                /* ── Order Count ── */
                COUNT(DISTINCT RD."ProductionOrder")    AS "Total Production Orders"

            FROM ReceiptData RD
            LEFT JOIN  OITM I  ON RD."ItemCode"  = I."ItemCode"
            LEFT JOIN  OUSR U  ON U."USERID"     = RD."UserSign"
            INNER JOIN NNM1 N  ON RD."Series"    = N."Series"
            LEFT JOIN  OWHS W  ON RD."WhsCode"   = W."WhsCode"
            LEFT JOIN  OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"     = RD."ProductionOrder"
            WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
                    AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_PRDTYP"= ? )
                    AND ( ? = '' OR O."Type"= ? )
                    AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_ITMSECTION"= ? )
                    -- EXCLUDE DISASSEMBLY POSTIVE RECEIPTS (IGN1)
                    AND NOT (O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT')
            GROUP BY
                YEAR(RD."DocDate"),
                MONTH(RD."DocDate"),
                RD."BPLName",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                I."U_BRND",I."U_PRDTYP", I."U_ITMREGCOD",
                I."U_ITMSZ",
                RD."ItemCode",
                I."ItemName",
                I."IWeight1",
                O."Type"
            ORDER BY
                YEAR(RD."DocDate"),
                MONTH(RD."DocDate"),
                RD."BPLName",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                RD."ItemCode";

WITH ProdData AS
                (
                SELECT
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    T1."TranType",
                    O."Type"        AS "ProdType",
                    'RECEIPT'       AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGN T0
                INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                LEFT JOIN OWOR O ON O."DocNum" = T1."BaseRef"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                UNION ALL

                SELECT
                    T0."DocDate",
                    T1."ItemCode",
                    T1."Quantity",
                    'C'             AS "TranType",
                    O."Type"        AS "ProdType",
                    'ISSUE'         AS "DocSource"
                FROM OIGE T0
                INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OWOR O  ON O."DocNum" = T1."BaseRef"
                WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND O."Type" = 'D'
                AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? 
                )

                SELECT

                TO_VARCHAR(P."DocDate",'Month-YYYY') AS "Month",
                I."U_SUBGRP",
                P."DocDate"                          AS "Production Date",

                SUM(
                CASE
                WHEN P."ProdType"='D' AND P."DocSource"='ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(P."Quantity")
                WHEN P."TranType"='C'
                THEN ROUND(P."Quantity")
                ELSE 0
                END)                                 AS "Pass Qty",

                0 AS "Total Repair",

                SUM(CASE WHEN P."TranType"='R'
                THEN ROUND(P."Quantity") ELSE 0 END) AS "Reject Qty",

                SUM(
                CASE
                WHEN P."ProdType"='D' AND P."DocSource"='ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(P."Quantity")
                ELSE ROUND(P."Quantity")
                END)                                 AS "Total Qty",

                SUM(
                CASE
                WHEN P."ProdType"='D' AND P."DocSource"='ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(P."Quantity"*I."IWeight1"/1000,2)
                WHEN P."TranType"='C'
                THEN ROUND(P."Quantity"*I."IWeight1"/1000,2)
                ELSE 0
                END)                                 AS "Total Pass Weight",

                0 AS "Total S.Area Sq M",
                0 AS "Total Repair %",

                ROUND(
                SUM(CASE WHEN P."TranType"='R' THEN P."Quantity" ELSE 0 END)
                / NULLIF(SUM(P."Quantity"),0) *100 ,2) AS "Reject %"

                FROM ProdData P
                LEFT JOIN OITM I ON P."ItemCode" = I."ItemCode"

                WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
                AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_SUBGRP" = ?)
                AND NOT (P."ProdType" = 'D' AND P."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT')

                GROUP BY
                P."DocDate",
                I."U_SUBGRP"

                ORDER BY
                P."DocDate",
                I."U_SUBGRP";

SELECT
                T0."DocNum" AS "Doc Num",
                T0."DocDate" AS "Doc Date",
                T1."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam",
                T1."Quantity",
                T1."StockPrice",
                (T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice") AS "Gross Amount",
                T4."OcrName" as "Cost Center"
                --T0."Comments",
                --T1."AcctCode",
                --T5."U_NAME",
                --T5."USER_CODE"
            FROM
                OIGE T0
                INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
                INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
                LEFT OUTER JOIN OOCR T4 ON T4."OcrCode" = T1."OcrCode"
                INNER JOIN OUSR T5 ON T0."UserSign" = T5."USERID"
            WHERE
                T1."BaseType" = 202
                AND (T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?)
                AND (? = '' OR T3."ItmsGrpNam" = ?);

description: Goods issue Report Summary for Production
sql:
SELECT 
                T1."ItemCode",
                T2."ItemName",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam",
                T4."OcrName" AS "Cost Center",

                SUM(T1."Quantity")        AS "Total Qty",
                AVG(T1."StockPrice")      AS "Avg Price",
                SUM(T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice") AS "Total Amount"

            FROM OIGE T0

            INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 
                ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                AND T1."BaseType" = 202   -- Production Issue

            INNER JOIN OITM T2 
                ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"

            INNER JOIN OITB T3 
                ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"

            LEFT JOIN OOCR T4 
                ON T1."OcrCode" = T4."OcrCode"

            WHERE 
                T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                AND (? = '' OR T3."ItmsGrpNam" = ?)

            GROUP BY 
                T1."ItemCode",
                T2."ItemName",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam",
                T4."OcrName"

            ORDER BY 
                T1."ItemCode";

description: Get Distinct ItmsGrpNam for QPRDP013 QPRDP014
sql:

                T3."ItmsGrpNam"
            FROM OITB T3
            GROUP BY
                T3."ItmsGrpNam"
            ORDER BY 
                T3."ItmsGrpNam";

description: Get Distinct ItmsGrpNam for QPRDP013 QPRDP014
sql:
SELECT
                T0."Warehouse" AS "Whs Code",
                T1."WhsName" AS "Warehouse Name",
                T0."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                T2."ItemName" AS "Item Name",
                T2."U_BRND" AS "Brand",
                SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty") AS "In Hand",
                CASE 
                    WHEN SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty") = 0 THEN 0
                    ELSE ROUND(SUM(T0."TransValue") / SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty"), 4) 
                END AS "Avg Price",
                ROUND(SUM(T0."TransValue"), 2) AS "Amount",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam"
            FROM
                OINM T0
            INNER JOIN OWHS T1 ON T1."WhsCode" = T0."Warehouse"
            INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T2."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
            INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T3."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
            WHERE
                T0."DocDate" <= ?
                AND {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
            GROUP BY
                T0."Warehouse",
                T1."WhsName",
                T0."ItemCode",
                T2."ItemName",
                T2."U_BRND",
                T3."ItmsGrpNam"
            HAVING
                SUM(T0."InQty" - T0."OutQty") <> 0
                OR SUM(T0."TransValue") <> 0
            ORDER BY
                T0."Warehouse",
                T0."ItemCode";

SELECT
    T0."PostDate",
    T0."DueDate",
    CASE
        WHEN T0."Type" = 'S' THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN T0."Type" = 'D' THEN 'Disassembly'
        WHEN T0."Type" = 'P' THEN 'Special'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Production Type",
    T0."ItemCode",
    T1."ItemName",
    T2."ItmsGrpNam" AS "Item Group",
    T3."U_PRDTYP" AS "Product Stage",
    T0."PlannedQty",
    T0."CmpltQty",
    T0."Warehouse",
    T4."WhsName",
    /* Stock before Production Order date */
    (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(N0."InQty" - N0."OutQty"), 0)
        FROM
            OINM N0
        WHERE
            N0."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
            AND N0."Warehouse" = T0."Warehouse"
            AND N0."DocDate" < T0."PostDate"
    ) AS "Stock_Before_PO",
    /* Stock After Production Order Date */
    (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(SUM(N0."InQty" - N0."OutQty"), 0)
        FROM
            OINM N0
        WHERE
            N0."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"
            AND N0."Warehouse" = T0."Warehouse"
            AND N0."DocDate" <= T0."PostDate"
    ) AS "Stock_After_PO",
    /* Current stock */
    T1."OnHand" AS "Current_Stock",
    T3."U_NXTSETION",
    T3."U_PRVSETION",
    T3."U_BRND"
FROM
    OWOR T0
    INNER JOIN OITM T1 ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OITB T2 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T2."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN OITT T3 ON T0."ItemCode" = T3."Code"
    INNER JOIN OWHS T4 ON T0."Warehouse" = T4."WhsCode"
    WHERE T0."PostDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T0."Status" = 'L'
    AND {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
ORDER BY
    T2."ItmsGrpNam",
    T4."WhsName",
    T0."PostDate",
    T0."ItemCode",
    T3."U_PRDTYP";

description: Warehouse-wise Inventory Status Report - Semi Finish stock for planning
sql:
SELECT

    T2."U_PRVSETION" AS "PREVIOUS SECTION",

FROM
    OITM T0
    INNER JOIN OITB T1 ON T0."ItmsGrpCod" = T1."ItmsGrpCod"
    LEFT JOIN OITT T2 ON T0."ItemCode" = T2."Code"
    INNER JOIN OITW T3 ON T0."ItemCode" = T3."ItemCode"
    INNER JOIN OWHS T4 ON T3."WhsCode" = T4."WhsCode"
WHERE
    {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
    AND T3."OnHand" <> 0
ORDER BY
    T1."ItmsGrpNam",
    T4."WhsName",
    T0."ItemCode";

WITH ReceiptData AS (
    SELECT 
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
        T1."Quantity",
        T1."TranType",
        T1."U_REJUNFIL",
        T1."U_REJSCAL",
        T1."U_REJSCR",
        T1."U_REJUNBRO",
        T1."U_REWRK",
        T1."WhsCode",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."BPLName",
        T0."UserSign",
        T0."Series",
        'RECEIPT'           AS "DocSource"
    FROM OIGN T0
    INNER JOIN IGN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        T0."DocDate",
        T1."ItemCode",
        T1."BaseRef"        AS "ProductionOrder",
        T1."Quantity",
        'C'                 AS "TranType",
        NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
        T1."WhsCode",
        T0."DocNum",
        T0."BPLName",
        T0."UserSign",
        T0."Series",
        'ISSUE'             AS "DocSource"
    FROM OIGE T0
    INNER JOIN IGE1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"    = T1."BaseRef"
    WHERE T1."BaseType" = 202
        AND O."Type"      = 'D'
        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
)
SELECT 
    /* ── Consolidated Period Horizon ── */
    MIN(RD."DocDate")                       AS "From Date",
    MAX(RD."DocDate")                       AS "To Date",

    RD."BPLName"                            AS "Branch Name",
    I."U_SUBGRP"                            AS "Sub Group",
    I."U_BRND"                              AS "Brand",
    I."U_ITMSZ"                             AS "Item Size",
    I."U_PRDTYP", 
    I."U_ITMREGCOD",
    RD."ItemCode"                           AS "Item Code",
    I."ItemName"                            AS "Item Name",
    I."IWeight1"                            AS "Item Weight (Gram)",

    CASE O."Type"
        WHEN 'S' THEN 'Standard'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Disassembly'
        WHEN 'P' THEN 'Special'
    END                                     AS "Production Type",

    /* ── Quantities ── */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            ELSE 0
        END
    )                                       AS "Complete Qty (Pcs)",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            ELSE 0
        END
    )                                       AS "Rejection Qty (Pcs)",

    /* ── Weights ── */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END
    )                                       AS "Complete Weight (KG)",

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity" * I."IWeight1" / 1000, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END
    )                                       AS "Rejection Weight (KG)",

    /* ── Net Total (Complete - Rejection) ── */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'ISSUE'
                THEN -1 * ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            WHEN O."Type" = 'D' AND RD."DocSource" = 'RECEIPT'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'C'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) - 
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R'
                THEN ROUND(RD."Quantity")
            ELSE 0
        END
    )                                       AS "Net Qty (Pcs)",

    /* ── Rejection Breakdown ── */
    SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJUNFIL", 0) END) AS "Unfilled Rej",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJSCAL",  0) END) AS "Scale Rej",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJSCR",   0) END) AS "Screen Rej",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REJUNBRO", 0) END) AS "Unbroken Rej",
    SUM(CASE WHEN RD."TranType" = 'R' THEN COALESCE(RD."U_REWRK",    0) END) AS "Rework",

    /* ── Order Count ── */
    COUNT(DISTINCT RD."ProductionOrder")    AS "Total Production Orders"

FROM ReceiptData RD
LEFT JOIN  OITM I  ON RD."ItemCode"  = I."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN  OUSR U  ON U."USERID"     = RD."UserSign"
INNER JOIN NNM1 N  ON RD."Series"    = N."Series"
LEFT JOIN  OWHS W  ON RD."WhsCode"   = W."WhsCode"
LEFT JOIN  OWOR O  ON O."DocNum"     = RD."ProductionOrder"
WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
    AND ( ? = '' OR I."U_SUBGRP"= ? )
    AND ( '' IN (?) OR I."U_PRDTYP" IN (?) )
    AND ( ? = '' OR O."Type"= ? )
    AND ( '' IN (?) OR I."U_ITMSZ" IN (?) )
GROUP BY
    RD."BPLName",
    I."U_SUBGRP",
    I."U_BRND",
    I."U_PRDTYP", 
    I."U_ITMREGCOD",
    I."U_ITMSZ",
    RD."ItemCode",
    I."ItemName",
    I."IWeight1",
    O."Type"
ORDER BY
    RD."BPLName",
    I."U_SUBGRP",
    RD."ItemCode";
