    A."Posting Date" DESC,
    A."DocNum",
    A."LineNum";

description: Customer item Bom tree with last Purchase Price
sql:
SELECT
                T0."ParentItem",
                S."CardCode",
                BP."CardName",
                S."Substitute" AS "CustomerItemCode",
                IFNULL(T0."Level", 0) AS "Level",
                T0."ChildItem",
                C."ItemName" AS "ChildItemName",
                C."InvntryUom" AS "UOM",
                PM."SWeight1" AS "GrossWeight",
                C."PrcrmntMtd" AS "ProcurementMethod",
                --W."OnHand" AS "In Stock",
                --W."IsCommited" AS "Commited Qty",
                --W."OnOrder" AS "Order Qty",
                --T0."RequiredQty",
                OS."Price",
                OS."Currency",
                T0."BOMQty",
                -- FG evaluated price only on parent row
                /**CASE
                    WHEN IFNULL (T0."Level", 0) = 0 THEN PM."LstEvlPric"
                    ELSE NULL
                END AS "ManufacturedItemPrice",*/
                -- Final component price logic
                CASE
                -- Buy items → use purchase price
                    WHEN C."PrcrmntMtd" = 'B' THEN IFNULL (T0."LastPrice", 0)
                    -- Manufactured items → use evaluated price
                    WHEN IFNULL (C."LstEvlPric", 0) > 0 THEN C."LstEvlPric"
                    -- Fallback
                    ELSE IFNULL (T0."LastPrice", 0)
                END AS "ComponentPrice",
                -- Price source tracking
                CASE
                    WHEN C."PrcrmntMtd" = 'B' THEN 'Purchase Price'
                    WHEN IFNULL (C."LstEvlPric", 0) > 0 THEN 'Evaluated Price'
                    ELSE 'Fallback Purchase Price'
                END AS "PriceSource",
                -- Raw last purchase price for verification
                IFNULL (T0."LastPrice", 0) AS "LastPurchasePrice",
                -- Extended component cost
                T0."RequiredQty" * (
                    CASE
                        WHEN C."PrcrmntMtd" = 'B' THEN IFNULL (T0."LastPrice", 0)
                        WHEN IFNULL (C."LstEvlPric", 0) > 0 THEN C."LstEvlPric"
                        ELSE IFNULL (T0."LastPrice", 0)
                    END
                ) AS "ExtendedComponentCost",
                T0."LastPurchaseQty",
                T0."LastPurchaseDate",
                T0."VendorCode",
                T0."VendorName"
            FROM
                "BOM_TREE_REPORTS" T0
                INNER JOIN OSCN S ON S."ItemCode" = T0."ParentItem"
                LEFT JOIN OITM PM ON PM."ItemCode" = T0."ParentItem"
                LEFT JOIN OITM C ON C."ItemCode" = T0."ChildItem"
                LEFT JOIN OITW W ON W."ItemCode" = T0."ChildItem"
                AND W."WhsCode" = 'FGWHB9'
                LEFT JOIN OCRD BP ON BP."CardCode" = S."CardCode"
                LEFT JOIN OSPP OS ON S."ItemCode" = OS."ItemCode"
                AND OS."Currency" <> 'INR'
            WHERE
                ( ? = '' OR S."CardCode" = ? )
                AND
                ( ? = '' OR S."ItemCode" = ? )
            ORDER BY
                S."CardCode",
                T0."ParentItem",
                T0."Path",
                T0."Level";

SELECT
        A."DocEntry",
        A."DocDate",
        A."U_FCLC" AS "FCLC",
        A."DocDueDate",
        A."TaxDate",
        A."DocNum",
        A."DocStatus",
        A."U_ADDATE",
        A."U_CDDATE",
        A."CardCode",
        A."CardName",
        B."LineNum",
        B."VisOrder",
        A."NumAtCard",
        B."LineStatus",
        B."ItemCode" AS "ParentItemCode",
        C."ItemName" AS "ParentItemName",
        C."U_OLDERPCOD",
        C."U_CUSTITMCOD",
        B."Dscription",
        C."U_PKGDEC",
        C."U_SEMICTN",
        C."U_MSTRCTN",
        C."SHeight1",
        C."SWidth1",
        C."SLength1",
        C."SVolume",
        C."SWeight1",
        (C."U_MSTRCTN" * C."SWeight1") AS "NetWT",
        C."CodeBars",
        C."U_Pallet" AS "Pallet",
        B."Price",
        B."PriceBefDi",
        B."U_REMKS",
        /* QUANTITIES */
        B."Quantity" AS "TotalOrderedQty",
        B."OpenQty" AS "OpenQty",
        (B."Quantity" - B."OpenQty") AS "ClosedQty",
        /* VOLUMES / CBM */
        (B."OpenQty" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."SVolume") AS "OpenVolume_CBM",
        ((B."Quantity" - B."OpenQty") / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."SVolume") AS "ClosedVolume_CBM",
        (B."Quantity" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."SVolume") AS "TotalVolume_CBM",
        /* WEIGHTS */
        C."U_GRSWT",
        (B."OpenQty" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."U_GRSWT") AS "OpenWeight",
        ((B."Quantity" - B."OpenQty") / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."U_GRSWT") AS "ClosedWeight",
        (B."Quantity" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * C."U_GRSWT") AS "TotalWeight",
        (B."OpenQty" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * (C."U_MSTRCTN" * C."SWeight1")) AS "OpenNetWeight",
        ((B."Quantity" - B."OpenQty") / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * (C."U_MSTRCTN" * C."SWeight1")) AS "ClosedNetWeight",
        (B."Quantity" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0) * (C."U_MSTRCTN" * C."SWeight1")) AS "TotalNetWeight",
        /* CARTONS */
        (B."OpenQty" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0)) AS "OpenCartons",
        ((B."Quantity" - B."OpenQty") / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0)) AS "ClosedCartons",
        (B."Quantity" / NULLIF(C."U_MSTRCTN", 0)) AS "TotalCartons",
        B."WhsCode",
        B."LineTotal",
        C."PrcrmntMtd",
        B."UomCode",
        A."Comments",
        BP."U_BRAND",
        C."U_ITMSZ1",
        C."UserText"
FROM
        ORDR A
        INNER JOIN RDR1 B ON A."DocEntry" = B."DocEntry"
        INNER JOIN OITM C ON B."ItemCode" = C."ItemCode"
        INNER JOIN OCRD BP ON A."CardCode" = BP."CardCode"
where
        A."DocStatus" = 'O'
        AND B."LineStatus" = 'O'
ORDER BY
        A."DocNum",
        C."U_OLDERPCOD",
        B."LineNum";
SELECT DISTINCT T0."U_ITMSECTION" FROM OITM T0 WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}

SELECT DISTINCT
                T6."DocNum" AS "Purchase Request No",
                T6."DocDate" AS "PR Date",
                T6."ReqDate" AS "PR Req Date",
                T8."RefDocNum" AS "Sales Order No",
                T8."Remark" AS "Sales Order Remark",
                T5."DocNum" AS "PO No",
                T5."DocDate" AS "PO Date",
                T0."DocDueDate" AS "PO DueDate",
                T5."U_W_ORDER" AS "PO W Order",
                T0."Comments" AS "PO Remarks",
                T5."NumAtCard" AS "PO NumAtCard",
                T5."DocStatus" AS "PO Status",
                
                -- A/P Invoice (Header)
                T0."DocDate" AS "AP Doc Date",
                T0."NumAtCard" AS "AP NumAtCard",
                T0."DocEntry" AS "AP DocEntry",
                T0."DocNum" AS "AP DocNum",

                -- Down Payment (Header amounts; no quantities)
                T0."DpmAmnt" AS "AP DP Amount",
                T0."DpmAppl" AS "AP DP Applied",

                -- Vendor & Item
                T5."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
                T4."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
                T4."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
                
                -- PO values
                T4."Quantity" AS "PO Qty",
                T4."Price" AS "PO Rate",
                
                -- AP values (gross and net of credit memos)
                T1."Quantity" AS "AP Qty (Gross)",
                T1."Price" AS "AP Invoice Rate",
                IFNULL (CM."CM_Qty", 0) AS "AP CreditMemo Qty",
                (T1."Quantity" - IFNULL (CM."CM_Qty", 0)) AS "AP Qty (Net)",
                (T4."Price" - T1."Price") AS "Price Diff",
                (T4."Quantity" - (T1."Quantity" - IFNULL (CM."CM_Qty", 0))) AS "Quantity Diff (vs PO, Net)"
                
            FROM
            "OPCH" T0 -- A/P Invoice (Header)
            INNER JOIN "PCH1" T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" -- A/P Invoice (Lines)
            INNER JOIN "OCRD" O1 ON T0."CardCode" = O1."CardCode"
            INNER JOIN "OITM" I1 ON T1."ItemCode" = I1."ItemCode"

                -- Link back to GRPO
                INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2 ON T1."BaseType" = 20
                AND T1."BaseEntry" = T2."DocEntry"
                AND T1."BaseLine" = T2."LineNum"
                INNER JOIN "OPDN" T3 ON T3."DocEntry" = T2."DocEntry"

                -- Link back to PO
                INNER JOIN "POR1" T4 ON T2."BaseType" = 22
                AND T2."BaseEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
                AND T2."BaseLine" = T4."LineNum"
                INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
                
                -- Link back to PR
                LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T4."BaseEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
                LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
                
                -- Your PR↔SO cross-reference
                INNER JOIN "PRQ21" T8 ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
                
                -- Net out A/P Credit Memo quantities that reference this A/P Invoice & line
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                    R1."BaseEntry" AS "AP_DocEntry",
                    R1."BaseLine" AS "AP_LineNum",
                    SUM(R1."Quantity") AS "CM_Qty"
                    FROM
                        "RPC1" R1 -- A/P Credit Memo (Lines)
                        INNER JOIN "ORPC" R0 -- A/P Credit Memo (Header)
                        ON R0."DocEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
                        WHERE
                        R0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND R1."BaseType" = 18 -- base is A/P Invoice
                        AND R1."BaseEntry" IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY
                        R1."BaseEntry",
                        R1."BaseLine"
                        ) CM ON CM."AP_DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                        AND CM."AP_LineNum" = T1."LineNum"
                        
                        -- Keep only non-canceled A/P Invoices, POs, GRPOs; PR optional
                        WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?;

description: Purchase Analysis Report by doc status 'O' 'C'
sql:
SELECT * FROM
                (
                    SELECT
                        'PO' AS "Document Type",
                        T0."DocEntry",
                        T0."DocNum",
                        T0."NumAtCard",
                        T0."CardCode",
                        T0."CardName",
                        T0."DocDate" AS "Posting Date",
                        T0."DocDueDate" AS "Due Date",
                        T0."DocTotal" AS "Amount",
                        (T0."DocTotal" - T0."VatSum") AS "Net",
                        T0."VatSum" AS "Tax",
                        T0."DocTotal" AS "Original Amount",
                        SUM(T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price") AS "Open Amount",
                        T0."TaxDate",
                        T0."BPLName"
                    FROM
                        OPOR T0
                        INNER JOIN POR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocStatus" = ?
                    GROUP BY
                        T0."DocEntry",
                        T0."DocNum",
                        T0."NumAtCard",
                        T0."CardCode",
                        T0."CardName",
                        T0."DocDate",
                        T0."DocDueDate",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        T0."VatSum",
                        T0."TaxDate",
                        T0."BPLName"
                    UNION ALL
                    -- GRPO (OPEN VALUE)
                    SELECT
                        'Goods Receipt PO',
                        T0."DocEntry",
                        T0."DocNum",
                        T0."NumAtCard",
                        T0."CardCode",
                        T0."CardName",
                        T0."DocDate",
                        T0."DocDueDate",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        (T0."DocTotal" - T0."VatSum"),
                        T0."VatSum",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        SUM(T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price") AS "Open Amount",
                        T0."TaxDate",
                        T0."BPLName"
                    FROM
                        OPDN T0
                        INNER JOIN PDN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocStatus" = ?
                    GROUP BY
                        T0."DocEntry",
                        T0."DocNum",
                        T0."NumAtCard",
                        T0."CardCode",
                        T0."CardName",
                        T0."DocDate",
                        T0."DocDueDate",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        T0."VatSum",
                        T0."TaxDate",
                        T0."BPLName"
                    UNION ALL
                    --  AP INVOICE (OPEN VALUE)
                    SELECT
                        'AP Invoice',
                        T0."DocEntry",
                        T0."DocNum",
                        T0."NumAtCard",
                        T0."CardCode",
                        T0."CardName",
                        T0."DocDate",
                        T0."DocDueDate",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        (T0."DocTotal" - T0."VatSum"),
                        T0."VatSum",
                        T0."DocTotal",
                        (T0."DocTotal" - T0."PaidToDate") AS "Open Amount",
                        T0."TaxDate",
                        T0."BPLName"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocStatus" = ?
                ) A
                WHERE
                    (? = '' OR "CardCode" = ?)
            ORDER BY
                A."Posting Date" DESC;

description: Purchase Analysis Report by date (vendor wise)
sql:
SELECT * FROM (

/* =======================  
    PURCHASE ORDER (PO)
   ======================= */
SELECT
    'PO' AS "DocType",
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    CASE OCRD."U_PurchType"   
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Consumables'   
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Service'  
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'Brought-Out'   
        ELSE 'Purchase Category' END AS "Purchase Category",

    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
    END AS "DocStatus",

    T0."BPLName",

    L."LineTotal" AS "TaxableAmount",
    T0."DiscSum"  AS "Discount",
    L."LineTotal" - T0."DiscSum" AS "Total After Discount",
    0             AS "TaxAmount",
    T0."WTSum"    AS "WTaxAmount",
    T0."DocTotal" AS "Total"

FROM OPOR T0
INNER JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "LineTotal"
    FROM POR1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) L ON L."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

UNION ALL

/* =======================
    GRPO
   ======================= */
SELECT
    'GRPO',
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    CASE OCRD."U_PurchType" 
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Consumables'   
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Service'    
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'Brought-Out'  
    ELSE 'Unknown'END AS "Purchase Category",

    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
    END,

    T0."BPLName",

    L."LineTotal",
    T0."DiscSum",
    L."LineTotal" - T0."DiscSum",
    T0."VatSum",
    T0."WTSum",
    T0."DocTotal"

FROM OPDN T0
INNER JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "LineTotal"
    FROM PDN1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) L ON L."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
  /* Exclude GRPO if any line is copied to Goods Return (ORPD / RPD1) */
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM RPD1 R1 
        INNER JOIN ORPD R0 ON R0."DocEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
        WHERE R1."BaseType" = 20 
        AND R1."BaseEntry" = T0."DocEntry" 
        AND R0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    )

UNION ALL

/* =======================
    AP INVOICE
   ======================= */
SELECT
    'AP Invoice',
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    CASE OCRD."U_PurchType" 
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Consumables'  
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Service'  
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'Brought-Out'   
        ELSE 'Unknown'END AS "Purchase Category",

    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
    END,

    T0."BPLName",

    L."LineTotal",
    T0."DiscSum",
    L."LineTotal" - T0."DiscSum",
    T0."VatSum",
    T0."WTSum",
    T0."DocTotal"

FROM OPCH T0
INNER JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "LineTotal"
    FROM PCH1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) L ON L."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

UNION ALL

/* =======================
    AP CREDIT NOTE
   ======================= */
SELECT
    'AP Credit Note',
    T0."DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    CASE OCRD."U_PurchType"    

    WHEN 'C' THEN 'Consumables'  
    WHEN 'S' THEN 'Service'    
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'Brought-Out' 
        ELSE 'Unknown'END AS "Purchase Category",

    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
    END,

    T0."BPLName",

    -L."LineTotal",
    -T0."DiscSum",
    -L."LineTotal" - T0."DiscSum",
    -T0."VatSum",
    -T0."WTSum",
    -T0."DocTotal"

FROM ORPC T0
INNER JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "LineTotal"
    FROM RPC1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) L ON L."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

) A

ORDER BY A."DocDate", A."DocNum";

description: Purchase Analysis Report by items and services
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
/* =======================  PURCHASE ORDER ======================= */
SELECT
    'PO' AS "DocType",
    CAST(T0."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "Numerator",
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDate" AS "Posting Date",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."TaxDate",
    T1."LineNum",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' OR T1."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN 'Service'
        ELSE IG."ItmsGrpNam"
    END AS "Item Group",
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."UomCode",
    T1."Price",
    T1."LineTotal",
    T1."OpenQty",
    T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price" AS "Open Value",
    T1."TaxCode",
    T1."VatPrcnt",
    OCRD."LicTradNum" AS "GST No.",
    COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "Tax",
    COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0) AS "Discount",
    /* Proportional WTax distribution based on Row Total */
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "WTax Amount",
    /* Total Amount = LineTotal + Tax - Discount - WTax Amount */
    T1."LineTotal" 
    + COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) 
    - COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0)
    - (CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS "Total Amount",
    CASE WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Item' END AS "ItemType",
    CASE WHEN T1."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS "LineStatus",
    CASE WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS "DocStatus",
    OCRD."U_PurchType"
FROM OPOR T0
INNER JOIN POR1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "TotalLineTotal"
    FROM POR1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) HDR ON HDR."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ON OBPL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN OITM IM ON IM."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN OITB IG ON IG."ItmsGrpCod" = IM."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

UNION ALL

/* =======================  GRPO (Excluding Returned Lines) ======================= */
SELECT
    'GRPO',
    CAST(T0."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."TaxDate",
    T1."LineNum",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' OR T1."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN 'Service'
        ELSE IG."ItmsGrpNam"
    END,
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."UomCode",
    T1."Price",
    T1."LineTotal",
    T1."OpenQty",
    T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price",
    T1."TaxCode",
    T1."VatPrcnt",
    OCRD."LicTradNum",
    COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0),
    COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0),
    /* Proportional WTax distribution based on Row Total */
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END,
    /* Total Amount = LineTotal + Tax - Discount - WTax Amount */
    T1."LineTotal" 
    + COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) 
    - COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0)
    - (CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END),
    CASE WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Item' END,
    CASE WHEN T1."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
    CASE WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
OCRD."U_PurchType"
FROM OPDN T0
INNER JOIN PDN1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "TotalLineTotal"
    FROM PDN1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) HDR ON HDR."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ON OBPL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN OITM IM ON IM."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN OITB IG ON IG."ItmsGrpCod" = IM."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM RPD1 R1 
    INNER JOIN ORPD R0 ON R0."DocEntry" = R1."DocEntry"
    WHERE R1."BaseType" = 20 
        AND R1."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
        AND R1."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum"
        AND R0."CANCELED" = 'N'
)

UNION ALL

/* =======================  AP INVOICE ======================= */
SELECT
    'AP Invoice',
    CAST(T0."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."TaxDate",
    T1."LineNum",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' OR T1."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN 'Service'
        ELSE IG."ItmsGrpNam"
    END,
    T1."Quantity",
    T1."UomCode",
    T1."Price",
    T1."LineTotal",
    T1."OpenQty",
    T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price",
    T1."TaxCode",
    T1."VatPrcnt",
    OCRD."LicTradNum",
    COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0),
    COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0),
    /* Proportional WTax distribution based on Row Total */
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END,
    /* Total Amount = LineTotal + Tax - Discount - WTax Amount */
    T1."LineTotal" 
    + COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) 
    - COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0)
    - (CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END),
    CASE WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Item' END,
    CASE WHEN T1."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
    CASE WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
    OCRD."U_PurchType"
FROM OPCH T0
INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "TotalLineTotal"
    FROM PCH1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) HDR ON HDR."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ON OBPL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN OITM IM ON IM."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN OITB IG ON IG."ItmsGrpCod" = IM."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

UNION ALL

/* =======================  AP CREDIT NOTE ======================= */
SELECT
    'AP Credit Note',
    CAST(T0."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."NumAtCard",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."TaxDate",
    T1."LineNum",
    T1."ItemCode",
    T1."Dscription",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' OR T1."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN 'Service'
        ELSE IG."ItmsGrpNam"
    END,
    -T1."Quantity",
    T1."UomCode",
    T1."Price",
    -T1."LineTotal",
    T1."OpenQty",
    -(T1."OpenQty" * T1."Price"),
    T1."TaxCode",
    T1."VatPrcnt",
    OCRD."LicTradNum",
    -COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0),
    -COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0),
    /* Proportional WTax distribution based on Row Total */
    - (CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
            ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END),
    /* Total Amount = - (LineTotal + Tax - Discount - WTax Amount) */
    -(T1."LineTotal" 
    + COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) 
      - COALESCE(T1."LineTotal" * (T0."DiscPrcnt" / 100.0), 0)
        - (CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(T0."WTSum", 0) = 0 THEN 0
            WHEN COALESCE(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0) > 0 THEN 
              ROUND(T0."WTSum" * (T1."LineTotal" / NULLIF(HDR."TotalLineTotal", 0)), 2)
            ELSE 0 
        END)),
    CASE WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Item' END,
    CASE WHEN T1."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
    CASE WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END,
    OCRD."U_PurchType"
FROM ORPC T0
INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "DocEntry", SUM("LineTotal") AS "TotalLineTotal"
    FROM RPC1
    GROUP BY "DocEntry"
) HDR ON HDR."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OCRD ON OCRD."CardCode" = T0."CardCode"
LEFT JOIN OBPL ON OBPL."BPLId" = T0."BPLId"
LEFT JOIN OITM IM ON IM."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
LEFT JOIN OITB IG ON IG."ItmsGrpCod" = IM."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
) A
ORDER BY
    A."Posting Date" DESC,
    A."DocNum",
    A."LineNum";

-- PURCHASE REQUEST
            SELECT 
                T0."DocNum" AS "PR Number",
                T0."DocDate" AS "PR Date",
                T0."ReqDate" AS "Required Date",

                CASE 
                    WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
                    WHEN T0."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
                    ELSE 'Draft'
                END AS "Status",

                T0."Requester",
                T0."Comments",

                T1."ItemCode",
                T1."Dscription" AS "Item Name",
                T1."WhsCode",

                T1."Quantity" AS "Requested Qty",

                IFNULL(PO."OrderedQty", 0) AS "Ordered Qty",

                (T1."Quantity" - IFNULL(PO."OrderedQty", 0)) AS "Open Qty",

                -- Conversion Status
                CASE 
                    WHEN IFNULL(PO."OrderedQty",0) = 0 THEN 'Not Converted'
                    WHEN IFNULL(PO."OrderedQty",0) < T1."Quantity" THEN 'Partial'
                    ELSE 'Fully Converted'
                END AS "Conversion Status",

                PO."PO_DocNums",

                -- Delay
                DAYS_BETWEEN(T0."ReqDate", CURRENT_DATE) AS "Delay Days"

            FROM OPRQ T0

            INNER JOIN PRQ1 T1 
                ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"

            -- PO Link
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT 
                    P1."BaseEntry",
                    P1."BaseLine",

                    SUM(P1."Quantity") AS "OrderedQty",

                    STRING_AGG(TO_NVARCHAR(P0."DocNum"), ', ') AS "PO_DocNums"

                FROM POR1 P1
                INNER JOIN OPOR P0 
                    ON P1."DocEntry" = P0."DocEntry"

                GROUP BY 
                    P1."BaseEntry", 
                    P1."BaseLine"
            ) PO
                ON PO."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                AND PO."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum"

            WHERE T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

            ORDER BY 
                T0."DocDate" DESC,
                T0."DocNum",
                T1."LineNum";

SELECT 
    T0."DocNum", 
    T0."DocDate", 
    T0."CardCode", 
    T0."CardName", 
    T1."ItemCode", 
    T1."Dscription", 
    T1."Quantity", 
    T1."Price", 
    T1."LineTotal",
    T1."U_Remarks"
FROM OPOR T0  
INNER JOIN POR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
SELECT DISTINCT T0."U_ITMSECTION" FROM OITM T0 WHERE {{ITMSGRPCOD}}

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 4 THEN 'Revenue'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 5 THEN 'Expense'
    END                     AS "Financial Group",

    L3."AcctCode"           AS "Level3 Code",
    L3."AcctName"           AS "Level3 Name",

    L4."AcctCode"           AS "Level4 Code",
    L4."AcctName"           AS "Level4 Name",

    T0."AcctCode"           AS "Level5 Code",
    T0."AcctName"           AS "Level5 Name",

    SUM(
        COALESCE(T1."Credit", 0)
        - COALESCE(T1."Debit", 0)
    )                       AS "Balance"

FROM OACT T0

LEFT JOIN OACT L4
    ON T0."FatherNum" = L4."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN OACT L3
    ON L4."FatherNum" = L3."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN JDT1 T1
    ON T0."AcctCode" = T1."Account"

LEFT JOIN OJDT T2
    ON T1."TransId" = T2."TransId"

WHERE
    T0."Levels" = 5
    AND T0."GroupMask" IN (4,5)
    AND T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T2."TransType" <> -3

GROUP BY
    T0."GroupMask",
    L3."AcctCode",
    L3."AcctName",
    L4."AcctCode",
    L4."AcctName",
    T0."AcctCode",
    T0."AcctName"

ORDER BY
    T0."GroupMask",
    L3."AcctCode",
    L4."AcctCode",
    T0."AcctCode";

SELECT
    YEAR (T0."RefDate") AS "Year",
    MONTH (T0."RefDate") AS "Month",
    -- Income (shown negative)
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN - (T0."Credit" - T0."Debit")
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "Income",
    -- Expense (positive)
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN (T0."Debit" - T0."Credit")
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "Expense",
    -- Profit (correct calculation)
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN (T0."Credit" - T0."Debit")
            WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN - (T0."Debit" - T0."Credit")
        END
    ) AS "Profit"
FROM
    JDT1 T0
    INNER JOIN OACT T1 ON T0."Account" = T1."AcctCode"
    WHERE T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    AND T1."GroupMask" IN (4, 5)
GROUP BY
    YEAR (T0."RefDate"),
    MONTH (T0."RefDate")
ORDER BY
    YEAR (T0."RefDate"),
    MONTH (T0."RefDate");

SELECT
    *
FROM
    (
        -- YOUR EXISTING DETAIL (unchanged)
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN 'Income'
                WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN 'Expense'
            END AS "Category",
            T1."AcctCode",
            T1."AcctName",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 4  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Apr",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 5  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "May",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 6  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Jun",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 7  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Jul",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 8  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Aug",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 9  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Sep",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 10 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Oct",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 11 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Nov",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 12 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Dec",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 1  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Jan",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 2  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Feb",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 3  THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) AS "Mar",
            CASE
                WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN 1
                WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN 2
            END AS "SortOrder"
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    T0."RefDate",
                    T1."AcctCode",
                    T1."AcctName",
                    T1."GroupMask",
                    CASE
                        WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN - (T0."Credit" - T0."Debit") -- display
                        WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN (T0."Debit" - T0."Credit")
                    END AS Amount
                FROM
                    JDT1 T0
                    INNER JOIN OACT T1 ON T0."Account" = T1."AcctCode"
                    WHERE T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    AND T1."GroupMask" IN (4, 5)
            ) T0
            INNER JOIN OACT T1 ON T0."AcctCode" = T1."AcctCode"
        GROUP BY
            T1."GroupMask",
            T1."AcctCode",
            T1."AcctName"
        UNION ALL
        -- NET PROFIT (computed with REAL SIGNS → positive)
        SELECT
            'Total',
            NULL,
            'Net Profit',
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 4  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Apr",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 5  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "May",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 6  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Jun",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 7  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Jul",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 8  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Aug",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 9  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Sep",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 10 THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Oct",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 11 THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Nov",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 12 THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Dec",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 1  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Jan",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 2  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Feb",
            SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(T0."RefDate") = 3  THEN P ELSE 0 END) AS "Mar",
            3
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    T0."RefDate",
                    CASE
                        WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 4 THEN (T0."Credit" - T0."Debit") -- Income +
                        WHEN T1."GroupMask" = 5 THEN - (T0."Debit" - T0."Credit") -- Expense -
                    END AS P
                FROM
                    JDT1 T0
                    INNER JOIN OACT T1 ON T0."Account" = T1."AcctCode"
                    WHERE T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    AND T1."GroupMask" IN (4, 5)
            ) T0
    ) X
ORDER BY
    "SortOrder",
    "AcctCode";

WITH
    OpeningBalance AS (
        SELECT
            T3."CardCode",
            COALESCE(SUM(T0."Debit" - T0."Credit"), 0) AS OpeningBalance
        FROM
            JDT1 T0
            INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."ShortName" = T3."CardCode"
            INNER JOIN OCRG T5 ON T3."GroupCode" = T5."GroupCode"
        WHERE
            T3."CardCode" = ?
            AND T0."RefDate" < ?
        GROUP BY
            T3."CardCode"
    ),
    Transactions AS (
        SELECT
            T3."CardCode",
            T3."CardName",
            T0."TransId",
            T1."Memo",
            T0."Ref1" AS "Doc No",
            T0."Ref2" AS "BP Ref No",
            T4."Comments" AS "BP Remarks",
            T0."RefDate",
            T0."Debit",
            T0."Credit",
            T4."WTSum"
        FROM
            JDT1 T0
            INNER JOIN OJDT T1 ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"
            INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."ShortName" = T3."CardCode"
            LEFT JOIN OPCH T4 ON T0."TransId" = T4."TransId"
        WHERE
            T3."CardCode" = ?
            AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    )
SELECT
    OpeningBalance."CardCode",
    NULL AS "CardName",
    NULL AS "TransId",
    'Opening Balance' AS "Memo",
    NULL AS "Doc No",
    NULL AS "BP Ref No",
    NULL AS "BP Remarks",
    NULL AS "RefDate",
    NULL AS "Debit",
    NULL AS "Credit",
    NULL AS "WTSum",
    OpeningBalance.OpeningBalance AS "Cumulative_Balance"
FROM
    OpeningBalance
UNION ALL
SELECT
    Transactions."CardCode",
    "CardName",
    "TransId",
    "Memo",
    "Doc No",
    "BP Ref No",
    "BP Remarks",
    "RefDate",
    "Debit",
    "Credit",
    "WTSum",
    OpeningBalance.OpeningBalance + COALESCE(
        SUM("Debit" - "Credit") OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                Transactions."CardCode"
            ORDER BY
                "RefDate" ASC
        ),
        0
    ) AS "Cumulative_Balance"
FROM
    Transactions
    LEFT JOIN OpeningBalance ON Transactions."CardCode" = OpeningBalance."CardCode";

SELECT
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocTotal" AS "Payment Total",
    T0."CashSum",
    T0."CheckSum",
    T0."TrsfrSum",
    IFNULL (SUM(T1."SumApplied"), 0) AS "Applied Amount",
    T0."DocTotal" - IFNULL (SUM(T1."SumApplied"), 0) AS "Unapplied Amount",
    -- Invoice numbers in one column
    STRING_AGG (T2."DocNum", ', ') AS "Invoices",
    T0."Comments"
FROM
    ORCT T0
    LEFT JOIN RCT2 T1 ON T1."DocNum" = T0."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN OINV T2 ON T1."DocEntry" = T2."DocEntry"
WHERE
    T0."Canceled" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocTotal",
    T0."CashSum",
    T0."CheckSum",
    T0."TrsfrSum",
    T0."Comments"
ORDER BY
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocNum";

SELECT
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocTotal" AS "Payment Total",
    T0."CashSum",
    T0."CheckSum",
    T0."TrsfrSum",
    IFNULL (SUM(T1."SumApplied"), 0) AS "Applied Amount",
    T0."DocTotal" - IFNULL (SUM(T1."SumApplied"), 0) AS "Unapplied Amount",
    -- Invoice numbers (AP Invoices)
    STRING_AGG (T2."DocNum", ', ') AS "Invoices",
    T0."Comments"
FROM
    OVPM T0
    LEFT JOIN VPM2 T1 ON T1."DocNum" = T0."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN OPCH T2 ON T1."DocEntry" = T2."DocEntry"
WHERE
    T0."Canceled" = 'N'
    AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
GROUP BY
    T0."DocNum",
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."CardCode",
    T0."CardName",
    T0."DocTotal",
    T0."CashSum",
    T0."CheckSum",
    T0."TrsfrSum",
    T0."Comments"
ORDER BY
    T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocNum";

SELECT 
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."ItemName",

    T1."ItmsGrpCod" AS "GroupCode",
    T1."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",

    T1."BalInvntAc" AS "InventoryGL",
    T2."AcctName" AS "InventoryGLName",

    T0."InvntryUom" AS "UOM",

    /* OPENING QTY */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" < ?
            THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "OpeningQty",

    /* OPENING VALUE */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" < ?
            THEN A."TransValue"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "OpeningValue",

    /* INWARD QTY */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            THEN A."InQty"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "InwardQty",

    /* INWARD VALUE */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                AND A."TransValue" > 0
            THEN A."TransValue"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "InwardValue",

    /* OUTWARD QTY */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            THEN A."OutQty"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "OutwardQty",

    /* OUTWARD VALUE */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                AND A."TransValue" < 0
            THEN -A."TransValue"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "OutwardValue",

    /* CLOSING QTY */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" <= ?
            THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "ClosingQty",

    /* CLOSING VALUE */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN A."DocDate" <= ?
            THEN A."TransValue"
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "ClosingValue",

    /* HAS STOCK */
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN A."DocDate" <= ?
                THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) <> 0
        THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "HasStock",

    COUNT(DISTINCT T0."ItemCode") AS "ItemCount"

FROM OITM T0

INNER JOIN OITB T1
    ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T0."ItmsGrpCod"

LEFT JOIN OACT T2
    ON T2."AcctCode" = T1."BalInvntAc"

INNER JOIN OINM A
    ON A."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode"

WHERE 
    T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'
    AND A."DocDate" <= ?

GROUP BY 
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."ItemName",
    T0."InvntryUom",
    T1."ItmsGrpCod",
    T1."ItmsGrpNam",
    T1."BalInvntAc",
    T2."AcctName"

HAVING
(
    ? = 0
    OR (? = 1 AND SUM(A."InQty" - A."OutQty") <> 0)
    OR (? = 2 AND SUM(A."InQty" - A."OutQty") = 0)
)

ORDER BY 
    T1."ItmsGrpNam",
    T0."ItemCode";

WITH OpeningBalance AS 
(
    SELECT 
        T1."Account",

        COALESCE(SUM(T1."Debit") - SUM(T1."Credit"), 0) AS "Opening_Local_Balance",

        COALESCE(SUM(T1."FCDebit") - SUM(T1."FCCredit"), 0) AS "Opening_FC_Balance"

    FROM JDT1 T1

    INNER JOIN OJDT T0 
        ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"

    WHERE 
        T1."Account" = ?
        AND T0."RefDate" < ?

    GROUP BY T1."Account"
),

CumulativeBalances AS
(
    SELECT 

        T1."Account",

        COALESCE(A."AcctName", '') AS "AcctName",

        T0."RefDate",
        T1."BaseRef",
        T0."Memo",
        T0."UpdateDate",
        T0."CreateDate",
        T1."LineMemo",

        T1."Debit"  AS "LocalDebit",
        T1."Credit" AS "LocalCredit",

        T1."FCDebit",
        T1."FCCredit",

        COALESCE(OB."Opening_Local_Balance", 0)
        +
        SUM(T1."Debit" - T1."Credit")
        OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY T1."Account"
            ORDER BY T0."RefDate", T1."TransId", T1."Line_ID"
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS "Cumulative_Local_Balance",

        COALESCE(OB."Opening_FC_Balance", 0)
        +
        SUM(T1."FCDebit" - T1."FCCredit")
        OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY T1."Account"
            ORDER BY T0."RefDate", T1."TransId", T1."Line_ID"
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS "Cumulative_FC_Balance",
        T0."Ref1",
        T0."Ref2",
        T1."Ref3Line"

    FROM OJDT T0

    INNER JOIN JDT1 T1
        ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"

    LEFT JOIN OACT A
        ON T1."Account" = A."AcctCode"

    LEFT JOIN OpeningBalance OB
        ON T1."Account" = OB."Account"

    WHERE 
        T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        AND T1."Account" = ?
)

FROM OpeningBalance OB

SELECT

    CASE
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 1 THEN 'Assets'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 2 THEN 'Liabilities'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 3 THEN 'Equity'
    END                                     AS "Financial Group",

    L3."AcctCode"                           AS "Level3 Code",
    L3."AcctName"                           AS "Level3 Name",

    L4."AcctCode"                           AS "Level4 Code",
    L4."AcctName"                           AS "Level4 Name",

    T0."AcctCode"                           AS "Account Code",
    T0."AcctName"                           AS "Account Name",

    SUM(
        IFNULL(T1."Debit",0)
        - IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
    )                                       AS "Balance"

FROM OACT T0

LEFT JOIN OACT L4
    ON T0."FatherNum" = L4."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN OACT L3
    ON L4."FatherNum" = L3."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN JDT1 T1
    ON T0."AcctCode" = T1."Account"

LEFT JOIN OJDT T2
    ON T1."TransId" = T2."TransId"

WHERE

    T0."Postable" = 'Y'

    AND T0."GroupMask" IN (1,2,3)

    AND T2."RefDate" <= ?

GROUP BY

    T0."GroupMask",

    L3."AcctCode",
    L3."AcctName",

    L4."AcctCode",
    L4."AcctName",

    T0."AcctCode",
    T0."AcctName"

HAVING
    SUM(
        IFNULL(T1."Debit",0)
        + IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
    ) <> 0

ORDER BY

    T0."GroupMask",

    L3."AcctCode",

    L4."AcctCode",

    T0."AcctCode";

SELECT

    CASE
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 1 THEN 'Assets'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 2 THEN 'Liabilities'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 3 THEN 'Equity'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 4 THEN 'Revenue'
        WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 5 THEN 'Expenses'
    END AS "Financial Group",

    L3."AcctCode" AS "Level3 Code",
    L3."AcctName" AS "Level3 Name",

    L4."AcctCode" AS "Level4 Code",
    L4."AcctName" AS "Level4 Name",

    T0."AcctCode" AS "Account Code",
    T0."AcctName" AS "Account Name",

    -- Opening Balance
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T2."RefDate" < ?
            THEN IFNULL(T1."Debit",0) - IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "Opening Balance",

    -- Debit
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            THEN IFNULL(T1."Debit",0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "Debit",

    -- Credit
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            THEN IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS "Credit",

    -- Closing Balance
    (
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN T2."RefDate" < ?
                THEN IFNULL(T1."Debit",0) - IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )

        +

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                THEN IFNULL(T1."Debit",0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )

        -

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                THEN IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ) AS "Closing Balance"

FROM OACT T0

LEFT JOIN OACT L4
    ON T0."FatherNum" = L4."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN OACT L3
    ON L4."FatherNum" = L3."AcctCode"

LEFT JOIN JDT1 T1
    ON T0."AcctCode" = T1."Account"

LEFT JOIN OJDT T2
    ON T1."TransId" = T2."TransId"

WHERE

    T0."Postable" = 'Y'

    AND T2."RefDate" <= ?

GROUP BY

    T0."GroupMask",

    L3."AcctCode",
    L3."AcctName",

    L4."AcctCode",
    L4."AcctName",

    T0."AcctCode",
    T0."AcctName"

HAVING

    SUM(IFNULL(T1."Debit",0)) <> 0
    OR
    SUM(IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)) <> 0

ORDER BY

    T0."GroupMask",
    L3."AcctCode",
    L4."AcctCode",
    T0."AcctCode";
SELECT T0."CardCode", T0."CardName", T0."CardType" FROM OCRD T0 ORDER BY T0."CardType";

SELECT
        -- Sales Order Details (ORDR T9)
        T9."DocEntry" AS "SO DocEntry",
        T9."DocNum" AS "SO DocNum",
        T9."DocDate" AS "SO Posting Date",
        T9."DocDueDate" AS "SO Due Date",
        T9."CardCode",
        T9."CardName" AS "Customer Name",
        T9."NumAtCard" AS "BP Reference No.",
        T9."DocStatus" AS "Sales Order Status",
        -- Purchase Request Details (OPRQ T6 & PRQ1 T7)
        T6."DocNum" AS "Purchase Request No",
        T6."DocDate" AS "PR Date",
        TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS') AS "PR Time",
        T6."ReqDate" AS "PR Req Date",
        T12."U_NAME" AS "PR User Name",
        T7."LineNum" AS "PR Line Number",
        T7."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
        T7."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
        T8."RefDocNum" AS "Sales Order No",
        T8."Remark" AS "Sales Order Remark",
        -- Purchase Order Details (OPOR T5 & POR1 T4)
        T5."DocNum" AS "PO No",
        T5."DocDate" AS "PO Date",
        TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS') AS "PO Time",
        T11."U_NAME" AS "PO User Name",
        T5."DocDueDate" AS "PO DueDate",
        T5."U_W_ORDER" AS "PO W Order",
        T5."Comments" AS "PO Remarks",
        T5."NumAtCard" AS "PO NumAtCard",
        T5."DocStatus" AS "PO Status",
        T5."CardCode" AS "Vendor Code",
        T5."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
        -- GRPO Details (OPDN T3 & PDN1 T2)
        T3."DocDate" AS "GRPO Doc Date",
        TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T3."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS') AS "GRPO Doc Time",
        T3."NumAtCard" AS "GRPO NumAtCard",
        T3."DocEntry" AS "GRPO DocEntry",
        T3."DocNum" AS "GRPO DocNum",
        T3."DocStatus" AS "GRPO Status",
        -- AP Invoice Details (OPCH T0 & PCH1 T1)
        T0."DocDate" AS "AP Doc Date",
        TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS') AS "AP Doc Time",
        T0."NumAtCard" AS "AP NumAtCard",
        T0."DocEntry" AS "AP DocEntry",
        T0."DocNum" AS "AP DocNum",
        -- Quantities & Rates
        COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0) AS "PR QTY",
        COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0) AS "PR Open Qty",
        COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0) - COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) AS "Open PR Qty",
        CASE
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)
                ELSE 0
        END AS "PO Qty",
        CASE
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)
                ELSE 0
        END AS "PO Rate",
        COALESCE(T2."Quantity", 0) AS "GRPO Qty",
        COALESCE(T2."Price", 0) AS "GRPO Invoice Rate",
        COALESCE(T1."Quantity", 0) AS "AP Qty",
        COALESCE(T1."Price", 0) AS "AP Invoice Rate",
        -- Differences
        (
                CASE
                        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                        AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)
                        ELSE 0
                END - COALESCE(T1."Price", 0)
        ) AS "Price Diff",
        (
                CASE
                        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                        AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)
                        ELSE 0
                END - COALESCE(T1."Quantity", 0)
        ) AS "Quantity Diff",
        -- Status Messages
        CASE
                WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled - PR Item Closed'
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NULL
                AND T7."LineStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PR Item Manually Closed'
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                AND T4."Quantity" < T7."Quantity" THEN 'PO Created - Partial'
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                AND T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Created - Open'
                WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL
                AND T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PO Created - Closed'
                WHEN T7."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Pending'
                ELSE 'PO Pending'
        END AS "PO Status Message",

        -- Status Flag
CASE 
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'POC-PRC'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NULL AND T7."LineStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PR-MC'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T4."Quantity" < T7."Quantity" THEN 'POC-P'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'POC-O'
        WHEN T5."DocNum" IS NOT NULL AND T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'POC-C'
        WHEN T7."LineStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO-P'
        ELSE 'PO-P'
END AS "PO_Flag",
        CASE
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'C'
                AND T5."DocNum" IS NULL THEN 'Complete - No POs'
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'O'
                AND T5."DocNum" IS NULL THEN 'Open - PO Creation Pending'
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'N' THEN 'Not Yet Open'
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" IS NULL THEN 'PR Status Unknown'
                ELSE T6."DocStatus"
        END AS "PR STATUS",
        T10."U_NAME" AS "E_U_NAME",
        T10."SendDate",
        T10."SendTime"
FROM
        "PRQ1" T7
        LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
        LEFT JOIN "PRQ21" T8 ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
        LEFT JOIN "ORDR" T9 ON T8."RefDocNum" = T9."DocNum"
        AND T8."RefObjType" = '17' -- 17 = Sales Order
        AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'
        -- BaseType 1470000113 = Purchase Request
        LEFT JOIN "POR1" T4 ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
        AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 1470000113
        LEFT JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
        -- BaseType 22 = Purchase Order
        LEFT JOIN "PDN1" T2 ON T4."DocEntry" = T2."BaseEntry"
        AND T4."LineNum" = T2."BaseLine"
        AND T2."BaseType" = 22
        LEFT JOIN "OPDN" T3 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
        AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
        -- BaseType 20 = Goods Receipt PO
        LEFT JOIN "PCH1" T1 ON T2."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
        AND T2."LineNum" = T1."BaseLine"
        AND T1."BaseType" = 20
        LEFT JOIN "OPCH" T0 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"
        AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T11 ON T5."UserSign" = T11."USERID"
        LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12 ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"
        LEFT JOIN "OEML" T10 ON T5."DocEntry" = T10."DocEntry"
WHERE
T9."DocStatus" = 'O'
        AND(
                T6."CANCELED" = 'N'
                OR T6."CANCELED" IS NULL
        )
ORDER BY
        T6."DocNum",
        T7."LineNum";

SELECT
        IFNULL (T9."E_Mail", '') AS "VendorEmail",
        IFNULL (T10."E_Mail", '') AS "UserEmail",
        T8."RefDocNum" AS "ReferenceNo",
        T5."CardCode" AS "VendorCode",
        T5."CardName" AS "VendorName",
        T5."DocNum" AS "PONo",
        TO_VARCHAR (T5."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "PODate",
        TO_VARCHAR (T5."DocDueDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "PODueDate",
        T7."ItemCode" AS "ItemCode",
        T7."Dscription" AS "ItemDescription",
        CAST(COALESCE(T4."OpenQty", 0) AS INT) AS "POOpenQty"
FROM
        "PRQ1" T7
        LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
        INNER JOIN "PRQ21" T8 ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
        INNER JOIN "ORDR" T1 ON T8."RefDocEntr" = T1."DocEntry"
        AND CAST(T8."RefObjType" AS VARCHAR) = '17'
        LEFT JOIN "POR1" T4 ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
        AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine"
        AND T4."BaseType" IN (147041000, 1470000113)
        LEFT JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
        INNER JOIN "OCRD" T9 ON T5."CardCode" = T9."CardCode"
        INNER JOIN "OUSR" T10 ON T5."UserSign" = T10."USERID"
WHERE
        (
                T6."CANCELED" = 'N'
                OR T6."CANCELED" IS NULL
        )
        AND T5."DocStatus" = 'O'
        AND T4."LineStatus" = 'O'
        AND T4."OpenQty" > 0
        AND T5."DocDueDate" <= ADD_DAYS (CURRENT_DATE, 7)
ORDER BY
        T9."E_Mail" ASC,
        T5."DocNum" ASC;

SELECT 
    -- ============================================================
    -- Sales Order
    -- ============================================================
    T9."DocEntry" AS "SO DocEntry",
    T9."DocNum" AS "SO No",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "SO Creation Timestamp",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Request
    -- ============================================================
    T7."ItemCode" AS "PR_Item_Code",
    T7."Quantity" AS "PR_Qty",
    T7."OpenQty" AS "PR_Open_Qty",

    T6."DocEntry" AS "PR DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum" AS "PR No",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "PR Creation Timestamp",
    U7."U_NAME" AS "PR Creation User Name",

    SECONDS_BETWEEN(
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        ),
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    ) AS "SO_PR_Diff_Seconds",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order
    -- ============================================================
    T1."ItemCode" AS "Item_Code",
    T1."Dscription" AS "Item_Description",
    T1."Quantity" AS "PO_Qty",
    T1."OpenQty" AS "PO_Open_Qty",

    T0."DocEntry" AS "PO DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum" AS "PO No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "PO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(
        COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"),
        'YYYY-MM-DD'
    ) AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "PO Creation Timestamp",
    U0."U_NAME" AS "PO Creation User Name",

    SECONDS_BETWEEN(
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        ),
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    ) AS "PR_PO_Diff_Seconds",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate Inward
    -- ============================================================
    GATE."GateDocEntry" AS "Gate DocEntry",
    GATE."GateDocNum" AS "Gate DocNum",
    GATE."GateLineId" AS "Gate LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateDocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Gate Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
        AS "Gate Actual DateTime",
    COALESCE(GATE."GateQty", 0) AS "Gate Inward Qty",
    GATE."GateUserName" AS "Gate Created By",

    CASE
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocDate" <= COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate")
            THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' ||
            TO_VARCHAR(
                DAYS_BETWEEN(
                    COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"),
                    GATE."GateDocDate"
                )
            ) || ' days'
    END AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO Details & SLA
    -- ============================================================
    T3."Quantity" AS "GRPO_Qty",
    T3."OpenQty" AS "GRPO_Open_Qty",

    T2."DocEntry" AS "GRPO DocEntry",
    T2."DocNum" AS "GRPO NoA",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T2."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "GRPO Document Timestamp",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "GRPO Creation Timestamp",
    U2."U_NAME" AS "GRPO Creation User Name",

    SECONDS_BETWEEN(
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T2."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        ),
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    ) AS "GRPO_Diff_Seconds",

    SECONDS_BETWEEN(
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."CreateTS", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        ),
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    ) AS "PO_GRPO_Diff_Seconds",

    CASE
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_SECONDS(
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(
                        TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                    ),
                    5400
                ),
                'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI'
            )
        ELSE 'Pending Gate Entry'
    END AS "GRPO_Target_DateTime",

    CASE
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
            ),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
            )
        ) <= 540000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' ||
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ROUND(
                    (
                        NANO100_BETWEEN(
                            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                                TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                            ),
                            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                                TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                                SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                                SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                            )
                        ) - 540000000000
                    ) / 36000000000.0,
                    1
                )
            ) || ' hrs'
    END AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice Details & SLA
    -- ============================================================
    T5."Quantity" AS "AP_Qty",
    T5."OpenQty" AS "AP_Open_Qty",

    T4."DocEntry" AS "AP DocEntry",
    T4."DocNum" AS "AP No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "AP Date",
    TO_TIMESTAMP(
        TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "AP Creation Timestamp",
    U4."U_NAME" AS "AP Creation User Name",

    SECONDS_BETWEEN(
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        ),
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00',
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    ) AS "GRPO_AP_Diff_Seconds",

    CASE
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 12:00'
        ELSE 'Pending GRPO'
    END AS "AP_Target_DateTime"

FROM OPCH T4

INNER JOIN PCH1 T5
    ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
    AND T5."BaseType" = 20

INNER JOIN OPDN T2
    ON T2."DocEntry" = T5."BaseEntry"
    AND T2."CANCELED" = 'N'

INNER JOIN PDN1 T3
    ON T3."DocEntry" = T5."BaseEntry"
    AND T3."LineNum" = T5."BaseLine"

INNER JOIN POR1 T1
    ON T1."DocEntry" = T3."BaseEntry"
    AND T1."LineNum" = T3."BaseLine"
    AND T3."BaseType" = 22

INNER JOIN OPOR T0
    ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- ================================================================
-- Gate Inward: deduplicated to ONE row per PO line
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS "PO_DocEntry",
        CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS INTEGER) AS "PO_LineNum",
        GL."DocEntry" AS "GateDocEntry",
        GL."LineId" AS "GateLineId",
        COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0) AS "GateQty",
        GH."DocNum" AS "GateDocNum",
        GH."U_UTL_DocDate" AS "GateDocDate",
        GH."CreateDate" AS "GateCreateDate",
        LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0') AS "GateCreateTime",
        GU."U_NAME" AS "GateUserName",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY GL."U_UTL_BASENTR", GL."U_UTL_BASELINE"
            ORDER BY GH."CreateDate", GH."CreateTime"
        ) AS "rn"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry"
        AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN OUSR GU
        ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
) GATE
    ON GATE."PO_DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    AND GATE."PO_LineNum" = T1."LineNum"
    AND GATE."rn" = 1

-- ================================================================
-- User References
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN OUSR U0
    ON T0."UserSign" = U0."USERID"

LEFT JOIN OUSR U2
    ON T2."UserSign" = U2."USERID"

LEFT JOIN OUSR U4
    ON T4."UserSign" = U4."USERID"

-- ================================================================
-- PO -> PR
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN PRQ1 T7
    ON T7."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry"
    AND T7."LineNum" = T1."BaseLine"
    AND T1."BaseType" = 1470000113

LEFT JOIN OPRQ T6
    ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN OUSR U7
    ON T6."UserSign" = U7."USERID"

-- ================================================================
-- PR -> SO
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN PRQ21 T8
    ON T8."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
    AND T8."RefObjType" = '17'

LEFT JOIN ORDR T9
    ON T9."DocNum" = T8."RefDocNum"
    AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- ================================================================
-- Filters
-- ================================================================
WHERE
    T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND (
        T9."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T6."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T0."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T2."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T4."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    )

-- ================================================================
-- Aggregations & Sorting
-- ================================================================
GROUP BY
    T9."DocNum", T9."DocEntry", T9."CreateDate",
    T9."CreateTS", T9."DocTime",

    T7."ItemCode", T7."Quantity", T7."OpenQty",
    T6."DocNum", T6."DocEntry", T6."CreateDate",
    T6."CreateTS", T6."DocTime", U7."U_NAME",

    T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription", T1."Quantity",
    T1."OpenQty", T1."ShipDate",

    T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate",
    T0."DocDueDate", T0."CreateDate",
    T0."CreateTS", T0."DocTime", U0."U_NAME",

    GATE."GateDocEntry", GATE."GateDocNum",
    GATE."GateLineId", GATE."GateDocDate",
    GATE."GateCreateDate", GATE."GateCreateTime",
    GATE."GateQty", GATE."GateUserName",

    T3."ItemCode", T3."Quantity", T3."OpenQty",
    T2."DocEntry", T2."DocNum", T2."DocDate",
    T2."CreateDate", T2."DocTime", U2."U_NAME",

    T5."ItemCode", T5."Quantity", T5."OpenQty",
    T4."DocEntry", T4."DocNum", T4."DocDate",
    T4."CreateDate", T4."DocTime", U4."U_NAME"

ORDER BY
    T4."DocDate",
    T0."DocNum" DESC;

WITH CAL AS (
    -- Calendar of dates (extend start date if you have older data)
    SELECT TO_DATE(GENERATED_PERIOD_START) AS "d"
    FROM SERIES_GENERATE_DATE('INTERVAL 1 DAY', '2020-01-01', ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, 365))
),
NONWORK AS (
    -- Non-working dates = Sundays + holidays from HLD1 (supports StrDate..EndDate ranges)
    SELECT C."d"
    FROM CAL C
    WHERE WEEKDAY(C."d") = 6
       OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM HLD1 H
            WHERE C."d" >= TO_DATE(H."StrDate")
              AND C."d" <= TO_DATE(COALESCE(H."EndDate", H."StrDate"))
       )
),
LINK AS (
    -- A) Every PO line, with its PR line if it has one (no PR = consumable / direct PO)
    SELECT
        T1."DocEntry" AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T1."LineNum"  AS "PO_LineNum",
        CASE WHEN T1."BaseType" = 1470000113 THEN T1."BaseEntry" END AS "PR_DocEntry",
        CASE WHEN T1."BaseType" = 1470000113 THEN T1."BaseLine"  END AS "PR_LineNum"
    FROM POR1 T1
    INNER JOIN OPOR T0
        ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
       AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

    UNION ALL

    -- B) PR lines that have no (non-cancelled) PO line yet = PO not created
    SELECT
        NULL, NULL,
        P1."DocEntry", P1."LineNum"
    FROM PRQ1 P1
    INNER JOIN OPRQ P0
        ON P0."DocEntry" = P1."DocEntry"
       AND P0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM POR1 X1
        INNER JOIN OPOR X0
            ON X0."DocEntry" = X1."DocEntry"
           AND X0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        WHERE X1."BaseType"  = 1470000113
          AND X1."BaseEntry" = P1."DocEntry"
          AND X1."BaseLine"  = P1."LineNum"
    )
)
SELECT
    -- Sales Order
    T9."DocEntry"                                                 AS "SO DocEntry",
    T9."DocNum"                                                   AS "SO No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "SO Creation System Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "SO Creation System Time",

    -- Purchase Request
    T7."ItemCode"                                                 AS "PR_Item_Code",
    T7."Quantity"                                                 AS "PR_Qty",
    T7."OpenQty"                                                  AS "PR_Open_Qty",
    T6."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PR DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum"                                                   AS "PR No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "PR Creation System Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "PR Creation System Time",
    U7."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PR Creation User Name",
    -- Working days (excludes Sundays & holidays)
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T9."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T6."CreateDate")
                                                                  AS "SO_PR_Diff_Days",

    -- Purchase Order
    COALESCE(T1."ItemCode",  T7."ItemCode")                       AS "Item_Code",
    COALESCE(T1."Dscription", T7."Dscription")                    AS "Item_Description",
    T1."Quantity"                                                 AS "PO_Qty",
    T1."OpenQty"                                                  AS "PO_Open_Qty",
    T0."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PO DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum"                                                   AS "PO No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                        AS "PO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "PO Creation System Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "PO Creation System Time",
    U0."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PO Creation User Name",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T6."CreateDate", T0."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T6."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T0."CreateDate")
                                                                  AS "PR_PO_Diff_Days",

    -- Gate Inward
    GATE."GateDocEntry"                                           AS "Gate DocEntry",
    GATE."GateDocNum"                                             AS "Gate DocNum",
    GATE."GateLineId"                                             AS "Gate LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateDocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                  AS "Gate Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)      AS "Gate Actual DateTime",
    COALESCE(GATE."GateQty", 0)                                   AS "Gate Inward Qty",
    GATE."GateUserName"                                           AS "Gate Created By",

    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocDate" <= COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
                DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), GATE."GateDocDate")
                - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                    WHERE N."d" > COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate")
                      AND N."d" <= GATE."GateDocDate")
            ) || ' working days'
    END                                                           AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- GRPO
    T3."Quantity"                                                 AS "GRPO_Qty",
    T3."OpenQty"                                                  AS "GRPO_Open_Qty",
    T2."DocEntry"                                                 AS "GRPO DocEntry",
    T2."DocNum"                                                   AS "GRPO No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T2."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                        AS "GRPO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "GRPO Creation System Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "GRPO Creation System Time",
    U2."U_NAME"                                                   AS "GRPO Creation User Name",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T2."DocDate", T2."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T2."DocDate" AND N."d" <= T2."CreateDate")
                                                                  AS "GRPO_Diff_Days",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T0."CreateDate", T2."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T0."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T2."CreateDate")
                                                                  AS "PO_GRPO_Diff_Days",

    CASE
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_SECONDS(GATE."GateTs", 5400),
                'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')
        ELSE 'Pending Gate Entry'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_Target_DateTime",

    -- GRPO SLA: elapsed time from Gate entry to GRPO, minus 24h for every Sunday/holiday in between
    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN (
            NANO100_BETWEEN(
                GATE."GateTs",
                TO_TIMESTAMP(
                    TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                    SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                    SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
            )
            - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                               WHERE N."d" >= GATE."GateCreateDate" AND N."d" <= T2."CreateDate")
        ) <= 540000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
            ROUND((
                NANO100_BETWEEN(
                    GATE."GateTs",
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(
                        TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                )
                - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                                   WHERE N."d" >= GATE."GateCreateDate" AND N."d" <= T2."CreateDate")
                - 540000000000) / 36000000000.0, 1)
        ) || ' hrs'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",

    -- AP Invoice
    T5."Quantity"                                                 AS "AP_Qty",
    T5."OpenQty"                                                  AS "AP_Open_Qty",
    T4."DocEntry"                                                 AS "AP DocEntry",
    T4."DocNum"                                                   AS "AP No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                        AS "AP Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "AP Creation System Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "AP Creation System Time",
    U4."U_NAME"                                                   AS "AP Creation User Name",
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T2."CreateDate", T4."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T2."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T4."CreateDate")
                                                                  AS "GRPO_AP_Diff_Days",
    -- Next working day after GRPO (skips Sundays & holidays), 12:00
    CASE
