        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(
                (SELECT MIN(C."d") FROM CAL C
                  WHERE C."d" > T2."CreateDate"
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" = C."d")),
                'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 12:00'
        ELSE 'Pending GRPO'
    END                                                           AS "AP_Target_DateTime"

FROM LINK L

-- PO side
LEFT JOIN OPOR T0 ON T0."DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN POR1 T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry" AND T1."LineNum" = L."PO_LineNum"
LEFT JOIN OUSR U0 ON U0."USERID" = T0."UserSign"

-- PR side
LEFT JOIN PRQ1 T7 ON T7."DocEntry" = L."PR_DocEntry" AND T7."LineNum" = L."PR_LineNum"
LEFT JOIN OPRQ T6 ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN OUSR U7 ON U7."USERID" = T6."UserSign"

-- PR -> SO
LEFT JOIN PRQ21 T8 ON T8."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry" AND T8."RefObjType" = '17'
LEFT JOIN ORDR T9  ON T9."DocNum" = T8."RefDocNum" AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- PO -> GRPO -> AP
LEFT JOIN PDN1 T3 ON T3."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry" AND T3."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum" AND T3."BaseType" = 22
LEFT JOIN OPDN T2 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry" AND T2."CANCELED" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR U2 ON U2."USERID" = T2."UserSign"
LEFT JOIN PCH1 T5 ON T5."BaseEntry" = T3."DocEntry" AND T5."BaseLine" = T3."LineNum" AND T5."BaseType" = 20
LEFT JOIN OPCH T4 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry" AND T4."CANCELED" = 'N'
LEFT JOIN OUSR U4 ON U4."USERID" = T4."UserSign"

-- Gate Inward (one row per PO line)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        GL."U_UTL_BASENTR"                      AS "PO_DocEntry",
        CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS INTEGER)    AS "PO_LineNum",
        GL."DocEntry"                           AS "GateDocEntry",
        GL."LineId"                             AS "GateLineId",
        COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0)             AS "GateQty",
        GH."DocNum"                             AS "GateDocNum",
        GH."U_UTL_DocDate"                      AS "GateDocDate",
        GH."CreateDate"                         AS "GateCreateDate",
        LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0')           AS "GateCreateTime",
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
        )                                       AS "GateTs",
        GU."U_NAME"                             AS "GateUserName",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY GL."U_UTL_BASENTR", GL."U_UTL_BASELINE"
            ORDER BY GH."CreateDate", GH."CreateTime"
        )                                       AS "rn"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN OUSR GU ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
) GATE
    ON  GATE."PO_DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry"
    AND GATE."PO_LineNum"  = L."PO_LineNum"
    AND GATE."rn"          = 1

WHERE
    (
        (T9."CreateDate" >= ? AND T9."CreateDate" <= ?)
        OR (T6."CreateDate" >= ? AND T6."CreateDate" <= ?)
        OR (T0."CreateDate" >= ? AND T0."CreateDate" <= ?)
        OR (T2."CreateDate" >= ? AND T2."CreateDate" <= ?)
        OR (T4."CreateDate" >= ? AND T4."CreateDate" <= ?)
    )

GROUP BY
    T9."DocNum", T9."DocEntry", T9."CreateDate", T9."DocTime",
    T7."ItemCode", T7."Dscription", T7."Quantity", T7."OpenQty",
    T6."DocNum", T6."DocEntry", T6."CreateDate", T6."DocTime", U7."U_NAME",
    T1."ItemCode", T1."Dscription", T1."Quantity", T1."OpenQty", T1."ShipDate",
    T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."DocDueDate",
    T0."CreateDate", T0."DocTime", U0."U_NAME",
    GATE."GateDocEntry", GATE."GateDocNum", GATE."GateLineId",
    GATE."GateDocDate", GATE."GateCreateDate", GATE."GateCreateTime", GATE."GateTs",
    GATE."GateQty", GATE."GateUserName",
    T3."Quantity", T3."OpenQty",
    T2."DocEntry", T2."DocNum", T2."DocDate", T2."CreateDate", T2."DocTime", U2."U_NAME",
    T5."Quantity", T5."OpenQty",
    T4."DocEntry", T4."DocNum", T4."DocDate", T4."CreateDate", T4."DocTime", U4."U_NAME"

ORDER BY
    COALESCE(T0."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate") DESC,
    T0."DocNum" DESC;

description: SLA Report for Purchase Process (PR → PO → Gate Inward → GRPO → AP → Payment)
sql:
SELECT 
    -- ============================================================
    -- 1. Purchase Request (OPRQ / PRQ1) - Start of Flow
    -- ============================================================
    T6."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PR_DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum"                                                   AS "PR_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                        AS "PR_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "PR_Actual_DateTime",
    U6."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PR_Created_By",

    -- ============================================================
    -- 2. Purchase Order (OPOR / POR1) - SLA: Within 24 Hours after PR
    -- ============================================================
    T0."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PO_DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum"                                                   AS "PO_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "PO_Delivery_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'), 86400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "PO_Target_DateTime",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "PO_Actual_DateTime",
    U0."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PO_Created_By",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending PO'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 864000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) - 864000000000) / 36000000000.0, 1)) || ' hrs (Target: ' || 
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'), 86400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || 
        ' | Actual: ' || TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ')'
    END AS "PO_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- 3. Gate Inward (@UTL_GE_OGIN / @UTL_GE_GIN1) - SLA: As per PO Delivery Date
    -- ============================================================
    GIN_H."DocEntry"                                              AS "GateInward_DocEntry",
    GIN_H."DocNum"                                                AS "GateInward_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                     AS "Gate_Target_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."U_UTL_DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')               AS "Gate_Actual_DocDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "Gate_Actual_System_DateTime",
    U_GIN."U_NAME"                                                AS "GateInward_Created_By",
    CASE 
        WHEN GIN_H."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GIN_H."U_UTL_DocDate" <= T0."DocDueDate" THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(T0."DocDueDate", GIN_H."U_UTL_DocDate")) || ' days (Target: ' || 
        TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDueDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' | Actual: ' || TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."U_UTL_DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')'
    END AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- 4. Goods Receipt PO (OPDN / PDN1) - SLA: In 1.5 Hours after Gate Entry
    -- ============================================================
    T2."DocEntry"                                                 AS "GRPO_DocEntry",
    T2."DocNum"                                                   AS "GRPO_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'), 5400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "GRPO_Target_DateTime",
    TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "GRPO_Actual_DateTime",
    U2."U_NAME"                                                   AS "GRPO_Created_By",
    CASE 
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 54000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) - 54000000000) / 36000000000.0, 1)) || ' hrs (Target: ' || 
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GIN_H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GIN_H."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'), 5400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || 
        ' | Actual: ' || TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ')'
    END AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- 5. AP Invoice (OPCH / PCH1) - SLA: Next Day by 12:00 PM after GRPO
    -- ============================================================
    T4."DocEntry"                                                 AS "AP_DocEntry",
    T4."DocNum"                                                   AS "AP_No",
    T4."CardCode"                                                 AS "Vendor_Code",
    T4."CardName"                                                 AS "Vendor_Name",
    TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00' AS "AP_Target_DateTime",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "AP_Actual_DateTime",
    U4."U_NAME"                                                   AS "AP_Created_By",
    CASE 
        WHEN T4."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending AP'
        WHEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00') 
            <= TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00:00') THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND(NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00:00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) / 36000000000.0, 1)) || ' hrs (Target: ' || 
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00 | Actual: ' || 
        TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ')'
    END AS "AP_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- 6. Vendor Payment (OVPM / VPM2) - SLA: Within 30 Days of AP Date
    -- ============================================================
    VPM."DocEntry"                                                AS "Payment_DocEntry",
    VPM."DocNum"                                                  AS "Payment_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), 'YYYY-MM-DD')          AS "Payment_Target_Date_30Days",
    TO_VARCHAR(VPM."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')                       AS "Payment_Actual_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN VPM."DocEntry" IS NULL AND DAYS_BETWEEN(T4."DocDate", CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 
            'Overdue Unpaid by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), CURRENT_DATE)) || ' days (Target: ' || TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')'
        WHEN VPM."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Payment (Within 30 Days)'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(T4."DocDate", VPM."DocDate") <= 30 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), VPM."DocDate")) || ' days (Target: ' || 
            TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' | Actual: ' || TO_VARCHAR(VPM."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')'
    END AS "Payment_SLA_Status"

FROM "OPCH" T4

-- AP Rows
INNER JOIN "PCH1" T5 
    ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"

-- AP -> GRPO
LEFT JOIN "OPDN" T2 
    ON T2."DocEntry" = T5."BaseEntry" 
    AND T5."BaseType" = 20 
    AND T2."CANCELED" = 'N'

LEFT JOIN "PDN1" T3 
    ON T3."DocEntry" = T5."BaseEntry" 
    AND T3."LineNum" = T5."BaseLine" 
    AND T5."BaseType" = 20

-- GRPO -> Gate Inward Line & Header
LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GIN_L
    ON GIN_L."U_UTL_BASENTR" = T3."BaseEntry"
    AND GIN_L."U_UTL_BASELINE" = T3."BaseLine"

LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GIN_H
    ON GIN_H."DocEntry" = GIN_L."DocEntry"
    AND GIN_H."Canceled" = 'N'

-- GRPO -> PO
LEFT JOIN "POR1" T1 
    ON T1."DocEntry" = T3."BaseEntry" 
    AND T1."LineNum" = T3."BaseLine" 
    AND T3."BaseType" = 22

LEFT JOIN "OPOR" T0 
    ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- PO -> PR
LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 
    ON T7."DocEntry" = T1."BaseEntry" 
    AND T7."LineNum" = T1."BaseLine" 
    AND T1."BaseType" = 1470000113

LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 
    ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry" 
    AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- AP -> Outgoing Payment (OVPM / VPM2)
LEFT JOIN "VPM2" PM2 
    ON PM2."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
    AND PM2."InvType" = 18

LEFT JOIN "OVPM" VPM 
    ON VPM."DocEntry" = PM2."DocNum" 
    AND VPM."Canceled" = 'N'

-- User Details
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U4 ON T4."UserSign" = U4."USERID"
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U2 ON T2."UserSign" = U2."USERID"
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U_GIN ON GIN_H."UserSign" = U_GIN."USERID" OR GIN_H."Creator" = U_GIN."USER_CODE"
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U0 ON T0."UserSign" = U0."USERID"
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U6 ON T6."UserSign" = U6."USERID"

WHERE 
    T6."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    OR T0."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    OR GIN_H."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    OR T2."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    OR T4."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

GROUP BY 
    T6."DocEntry", T6."DocNum", T6."DocDate", T6."CreateDate", T6."DocTime", U6."U_NAME",
    T0."DocEntry", T0."DocNum", T0."DocDate", T0."DocDueDate", T0."CreateDate", T0."DocTime", U0."U_NAME",
    GIN_H."DocEntry", GIN_H."DocNum", GIN_H."U_UTL_DocDate", GIN_H."CreateDate", GIN_H."CreateTime", GIN_H."Status", U_GIN."U_NAME",
    T2."DocEntry", T2."DocNum", T2."DocDate", T2."CreateDate", T2."DocTime", U2."U_NAME",
    T4."DocEntry", T4."DocNum", T4."CardCode", T4."CardName", T4."DocDate", T4."CreateDate", T4."DocTime", U4."U_NAME",
    VPM."DocEntry", VPM."DocNum", VPM."DocDate"

ORDER BY 
    T4."DocDate" DESC, 
    T4."DocNum" DESC;

SELECT
            T0."DocNum",
            T0."DocDate",
            T0."DocDueDate",
            T0."CreateDate",
            T0."CreateTS",
            T0."ReqDate",
            T1."ItemCode",
            T1."Dscription",
            T1."Quantity",
            T1."OpenQty",
            T2."U_NAME",
            T2."USER_CODE"
        FROM
            OPRQ T0
            INNER JOIN PRQ1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
            INNER JOIN OUSR T2 ON T0."UserSign" = T2."USERID"
        WHERE
            T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
            and T0."CreateDate" between ? and ?

description: Purchase Order Fulfillment & SLA Tracking Report
sql:
SELECT
    -- ============================================================
    -- Sales Order Details (ORDR T9 via PR Link)
    -- ============================================================
    --  T9."DocEntry"                                                 AS "SO DocEntry",
    --  T9."DocNum"                                                   AS "SO DocNum",
    --  TO_VARCHAR(T9."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "SO Posting Date",
    --   TO_VARCHAR(T9."DocDueDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "SO Due Date",
    --   T9."CardCode"                                                 AS "SO CardCode",
    --   T9."CardName"                                                 AS "Customer Name",
    --   T9."NumAtCard"                                                AS "BP Reference No.",
    --    CASE 
    --      WHEN T9."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
    ---      WHEN T9."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
    --   ELSE T9."DocStatus"
    --   END                                                           AS "Sales Order Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Request Details (OPRQ T6 & PRQ1 T7)
    -- ============================================================
    T6."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PR DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum"                                                   AS "Purchase Request No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PR Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "PR Actual DateTime",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."ReqDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PR Req Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END                                                           AS "PR Doc Status",
    T12."U_NAME"                                                  AS "PR User Name",
    T7."LineNum"                                                  AS "PR Line Number",
    T4."ItemCode"                                                 AS "Item Code",
    T4."Dscription"                                               AS "Item Description",
    COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0)                                    AS "PR Qty",
    COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0)                                     AS "PR Open Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((T7."Quantity" - T7."OpenQty") / T7."Quantity") * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END                                                           AS "PR Line Fulfilled Pct",
    T8."RefDocNum"                                                AS "Sales Order No",
    T8."Remark"                                                   AS "Sales Order Remark",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- PR to PO SLA Tracking (Target: 24 hours after PR)
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'), 86400), 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')
        ELSE 'Direct PO (No PR)'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Direct PO (No PR)'
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 864000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) - 864000000000) / 36000000000.0, 1)) || ' hrs'
    END AS "PO_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order Details (OPOR T5 & POR1 T4)
    -- ============================================================
    T5."DocNum"                                                   AS "PO No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "PO Actual DateTime",
    T11."U_NAME"                                                  AS "PO User Name",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDueDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "PO_Delivery_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO_Item_Delivery_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END                                                           AS "PO Doc Status",
    T5."U_W_ORDER"                                                AS "PO W Order",
    T5."Comments"                                                 AS "PO Remarks",
    T5."NumAtCard"                                                AS "PO NumAtCard",
    T5."CardCode"                                                 AS "Vendor Code",
    T5."CardName"                                                 AS "Vendor Name",
    COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)                                    AS "PO Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."OpenQty", 0)                                     AS "PO Open Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)                                       AS "PO Rate",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate Inward Summary (Direct Link: POR1 -> @UTL_GE_GIN1)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Count", 0)                            AS "Gate_Count",
    GATE_AGG."GateInward_All_No"                                  AS "GateInward_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE_AGG."Gate_First_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')          AS "Gate_First_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE_AGG."Gate_Last_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')           AS "Gate_Last_Date",
    COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Total_Qty", 0)                        AS "Gate_Total_Inward_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN GATE_AGG."Gate_Count" IS NULL OR GATE_AGG."Gate_Count" = 0 THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GATE_AGG."Gate_First_Date" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), GATE_AGG."Gate_First_Date")) || ' days'
    END                                                           AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO Summary (Handles Multiple GRPOs)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0)                            AS "GRPO_Count",
    GRPO_AGG."GRPO_All_No"                                        AS "GRPO_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')          AS "GRPO_First_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Last_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')           AS "GRPO_Last_Date",
    COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Total_Qty", 0)                        AS "GRPO_Total_Qty",
    COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Total_OpenQty", 0)                    AS "GRPO_Open_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0) = 0 AND GATE_AGG."Gate_Count" > 0 THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN GATE_AGG."Gate_Count" IS NULL OR GATE_AGG."Gate_Count" = 0 THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GATE_AGG."Gate_First_CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE_AGG."Gate_First_CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE_AGG."Gate_First_CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 54000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice Summary (Handles Multiple AP Invoices)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Count", 0)                                AS "AP_Count",
    AP_AGG."AP_All_No"                                           AS "AP_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(AP_AGG."AP_First_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')             AS "AP_First_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(AP_AGG."AP_Last_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "AP_Last_Date",
    COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Total_Qty", 0)                           AS "AP_Total_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Count", 0) = 0 AND GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count" > 0 THEN 'Pending AP Invoice'
        WHEN GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count" IS NULL OR GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count" = 0 THEN 'GRPO Required First'
        WHEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(AP_AGG."AP_First_CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(AP_AGG."AP_First_DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || 
                SUBSTRING(LPAD(AP_AGG."AP_First_DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
            <= TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00:00') THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay'
    END                                                           AS "AP_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Outgoing Payment Summary (Handles Multiple Payments)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(PAY_AGG."Payment_Count", 0)                          AS "Payment_Count",
    PAY_AGG."Payment_All_No"                                      AS "Payment_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')        AS "Payment_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PAY_AGG."Payment_Count", 0) = 0 AND DAYS_BETWEEN(AP_AGG."AP_First_Date", CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 
            'Overdue Unpaid by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(AP_AGG."AP_First_Date", 30), CURRENT_DATE)) || ' days'
        WHEN COALESCE(PAY_AGG."Payment_Count", 0) = 0 THEN 'Pending Payment (Within 30 Days)'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(AP_AGG."AP_First_Date", PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date") <= 30 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(AP_AGG."AP_First_Date", 30), PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date")) || ' days'
    END                                                           AS "Payment_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Difference Metrics & Source Type
    -- ============================================================
    (COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) - COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Total_Qty", 0)) AS "PO_vs_AP_Quantity_Diff",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN T7."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN 'PR + PO'
        ELSE 'Direct PO (No PR)'
    END                                                           AS "Source_Type",
    
    CASE
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Created - Open'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PO Created - Closed'
        ELSE 'PO Pending'
    END                                                           AS "PO Status Message"

    -- ============================================================
    -- MAIN TABLE: POR1 (Includes Direct POs & PR-linked POs)
    -- ============================================================
    FROM "POR1" T4

    INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 
        ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
        AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'

    -- Link back to PR if exists
    LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 
        ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
        AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine"
        AND T4."BaseType" = 1470000113

    LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 
        ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
        AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'

    -- Sales Order Links
    LEFT JOIN "PRQ21" T8 
        ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"

    LEFT JOIN "ORDR" T9 
        ON T8."RefDocNum" = T9."DocNum"
        AND T8."RefObjType" = '17'
        AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'

    -- ============================================================
    -- 1. Gate Inward Pre-Aggregation (Direct link to PO Line)
    -- ============================================================
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            GL."U_UTL_BASENTR"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
            GL."U_UTL_BASELINE"                           AS "PO_LineNum",
            COUNT(DISTINCT GH."DocEntry")                 AS "Gate_Count",
            STRING_AGG(CAST(GH."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR), ', ') AS "GateInward_All_No",
            MIN(GH."U_UTL_DocDate")                       AS "Gate_First_Date",
            MAX(GH."U_UTL_DocDate")                       AS "Gate_Last_Date",
            MIN(GH."CreateDate")                          AS "Gate_First_CreateDate",
            MIN(GH."CreateTime")                          AS "Gate_First_CreateTime",
            SUM(COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0))              AS "Gate_Total_Qty"
        FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
        INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH 
            ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" 
            AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
        WHERE GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY GL."U_UTL_BASENTR", GL."U_UTL_BASELINE"
    ) GATE_AGG 
        ON GATE_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
        AND GATE_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

    -- ============================================================
    -- 2. GRPO Pre-Aggregation per PO Line
    -- ============================================================
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
            T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
            COUNT(DISTINCT T3_SUB."DocEntry")             AS "GRPO_Count",
            STRING_AGG(CAST(T3_SUB."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR), ', ') AS "GRPO_All_No",
            MIN(T3_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "GRPO_First_Date",
            MAX(T3_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "GRPO_Last_Date",
            MIN(T3_SUB."CreateDate")                      AS "GRPO_First_CreateDate",
            MIN(T3_SUB."DocTime")                         AS "GRPO_First_DocTime",
            SUM(COALESCE(T2_SUB."Quantity", 0))           AS "GRPO_Total_Qty",
            SUM(COALESCE(T2_SUB."OpenQty", 0))            AS "GRPO_Total_OpenQty"
        FROM "PDN1" T2_SUB
        INNER JOIN "OPDN" T3_SUB 
            ON T2_SUB."DocEntry" = T3_SUB."DocEntry" 
            AND T3_SUB."CANCELED" = 'N'
        WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
    ) GRPO_AGG 
        ON GRPO_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
        AND GRPO_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

    -- ============================================================
    -- 3. AP Invoice Pre-Aggregation per PO Line
    -- ============================================================
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
            T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
            COUNT(DISTINCT T0_SUB."DocEntry")             AS "AP_Count",
            STRING_AGG(CAST(T0_SUB."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR), ', ') AS "AP_All_No",
            MIN(T0_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "AP_First_Date",
            MAX(T0_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "AP_Last_Date",
            MIN(T0_SUB."CreateDate")                      AS "AP_First_CreateDate",
            MIN(T0_SUB."DocTime")                         AS "AP_First_DocTime",
            SUM(COALESCE(T1_SUB."Quantity", 0))           AS "AP_Total_Qty"
        FROM "PCH1" T1_SUB
        INNER JOIN "OPCH" T0_SUB 
            ON T1_SUB."DocEntry" = T0_SUB."DocEntry" 
            AND T0_SUB."CANCELED" = 'N'
        INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB 
            ON T1_SUB."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry" 
            AND T1_SUB."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum" 
            AND T1_SUB."BaseType" = 20
        WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
    ) AP_AGG 
        ON AP_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
        AND AP_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

    -- ============================================================
    -- 4. Outgoing Payment Pre-Aggregation per PO Line
    -- ============================================================
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
            T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
            COUNT(DISTINCT VPM_SUB."DocEntry")            AS "Payment_Count",
            STRING_AGG(CAST(VPM_SUB."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR), ', ') AS "Payment_All_No",
            MIN(VPM_SUB."DocDate")                        AS "Payment_First_Date"
        FROM "VPM2" PM2_SUB
        INNER JOIN "OVPM" VPM_SUB 
            ON VPM_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocNum" 
            AND VPM_SUB."Canceled" = 'N'
        INNER JOIN "PCH1" T1_SUB 
            ON T1_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocEntry" 
            AND PM2_SUB."InvType" = 18
        INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB 
            ON T1_SUB."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry" 
            AND T1_SUB."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum" 
            AND T1_SUB."BaseType" = 20
        WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
    ) PAY_AGG 
        ON PAY_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
        AND PAY_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

    -- User Details
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T11 ON T5."UserSign" = T11."USERID"
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12 ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"

    WHERE
        -- Date filter on PO Creation Date
        T5."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        
        -- Exclude manually closed PO lines that have NO GRPO created
        AND NOT (
            T4."LineStatus" = 'C' 
            AND COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0) = 0
        )

    ORDER BY
        T5."DocNum",
        T4."LineNum";

WITH ComponentStockForPlan AS (
    SELECT
        t0."ItemCode"                                   AS "CompCode",
        t0."ItmsGrpCod"                                 AS "CompGrp",
        t0."U_ITMSECTION", 
        t0."U_SUBGRP",
        GREATEST(
            0,
            COALESCE(curr."CurrentStock", 0)
            - COALESCE(mv."NetAfterProdDate", 0)        
            + COALESCE(mv."IssuesOnProdDate", 0)        
        )                                               AS "CompStockForPlan"
    FROM "OITM" t0
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            w."ItemCode",
            SUM(w."OnHand")                             AS "CurrentStock"
        FROM "OITW" w
        WHERE w."WhsCode" NOT IN ('REJWHB9','MCTWH')
        GROUP BY w."ItemCode"
    ) curr ON t0."ItemCode" = curr."ItemCode"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            m."ItemCode",
            SUM(CASE WHEN m."DocDate" > ?
                    THEN (m."InQty" - m."OutQty") ELSE 0 END) AS "NetAfterProdDate",
            SUM(CASE WHEN m."DocDate" = ? AND m."TransType" = 68
                    THEN m."OutQty" 
                    WHEN m."DocDate" = ? AND m."TransType" <> 68 AND m."OutQty" > 0 AND m."InQty" = 0
                    THEN m."OutQty"
                    ELSE 0 END)                               AS "IssuesOnProdDate"
        FROM "OINM" m
        WHERE m."Warehouse" NOT IN ('REJWHB9','MCTWH')
            AND m."DocDate" >= ?
        GROUP BY m."ItemCode"
    ) mv ON t0."ItemCode" = mv."ItemCode"
    WHERE
        t0."ItmsGrpCod" {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
),

BOMComponentPlan AS (
    SELECT
        ranked."ParentCode",
        ranked."InputCompCode",
        ranked."CompStockForPlan",
        ranked."CompBasedPlanQty"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            b0."Code"                                   AS "ParentCode",
            b1."Code"                                   AS "InputCompCode",
            stk."CompStockForPlan",
            ROUND(
                (stk."CompStockForPlan" / NULLIF(b1."Quantity", 0)) * b0."Qauntity",
2
            )                                           AS "CompBasedPlanQty",
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY b0."Code"
                ORDER BY
                    ROUND(
                        (stk."CompStockForPlan" / NULLIF(b1."Quantity", 0)) * b0."Qauntity",
2
                    ) ASC,
                    b1."Code" ASC
            )                                           AS "Rnk"
        FROM "OITT" b0
        INNER JOIN "ITT1" b1
            ON b0."Code" = b1."Father"
        INNER JOIN ComponentStockForPlan stk
            ON b1."Code" = stk."CompCode"
        WHERE
            COALESCE(b0."Qauntity", 0) > 0
            AND COALESCE(b1."Quantity", 0) > 0
            AND stk."CompGrp" {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
    ) ranked
    WHERE ranked."Rnk" = 1
),

TodayParentProduction AS (
    /* Step 3: Actual production qty calculation only */
    SELECT
        m."ItemCode"                                    AS "ParentCode",
        SUM(m."InQty" - m."OutQty")                     AS "ActualProdQty"
    FROM "OINM" m
    WHERE
        m."DocDate" = ?
        AND m."TransType" = 59                          -- Receipt from Production
        AND m."Warehouse" NOT IN ('REJWHB9')
    GROUP BY
        m."ItemCode"
    HAVING
        SUM(m."InQty" - m."OutQty") > 0
)

/* Step 4: Final Presentation */
SELECT
    ?                                      AS "Selected Production Date",
    ADD_DAYS(?, -1)                        AS "Stock Baseline Date",
    COALESCE(p_itm."U_VMS", 'Unassigned')               AS "Item Sub-Group",
    p_itm."ItemCode"                                    AS "Product Code (Next Stage)",
    p_itm."U_ITMSECTION", 
    p_itm."U_SUBGRP",
    p_itm."ItemName"                                    AS "Product Name",
    p_itm."U_ITMSZ"                                     AS "ITEM SIZE",
    p_itm."U_ITMREGCOD"                                 AS "ITEM_DESC",
    
    /* FIXED: Fetches the fixed Default Warehouse from Parent Item Master to avoid '#' errors */
    COALESCE(p_itm."DfltWH", 'N/A')                     AS "Produced Into Whs",

    COALESCE(bom."InputCompCode", 'INITIAL PROCESS')    AS "Input Component Code",
    COALESCE(bom."CompStockForPlan", 0)                 AS "Input Comp Stock (Before ProdDate Issues)",

    ROUND(COALESCE(bom."CompBasedPlanQty", 0), 2)       AS "Planned Qty",

    ROUND(COALESCE(prd."ActualProdQty", 0), 2)          AS "Actual Production",

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(bom."CompBasedPlanQty", 0) > 0
        THEN TO_VARCHAR(
            ROUND(
                (COALESCE(prd."ActualProdQty", 0) / bom."CompBasedPlanQty") * 100,
1
            )
        ) || '%'
        WHEN COALESCE(prd."ActualProdQty", 0) > 0
        THEN 'No Plan'
        ELSE '0.0%'
    END                                                 AS "% Achieved"

FROM "OITM" p_itm
INNER JOIN "OITB" G
    ON p_itm."ItmsGrpCod" = G."ItmsGrpCod"

LEFT JOIN BOMComponentPlan bom
    ON p_itm."ItemCode" = bom."ParentCode"

LEFT JOIN TodayParentProduction prd
    ON p_itm."ItemCode" = prd."ParentCode"

WHERE
    G."ItmsGrpCod" {{ITMSGRPCOD}}
    AND (
        COALESCE(bom."CompBasedPlanQty", 0) > 0
        OR COALESCE(prd."ActualProdQty", 0) > 0
    )

ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_itm."U_VMS" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
    p_itm."U_VMS" ASC,
    p_itm."ItemCode" ASC;

SELECT
                OCRG."GroupName" AS "Customer_Group",
                COUNT(DISTINCT T."DocKey") AS "Transaction_Count",
                SUM(T."Net_Sales_LC") AS "Net_Sales_LC"
            FROM
                (
                    -- A/R Invoices (Net of Tax, factoring in Header & Line Discounts)
                    SELECT
                        T0."CardCode",
                        'INV-' || TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocEntry") AS "DocKey",
                        (T0."DocTotal" - COALESCE(T0."VatSum", 0) - COALESCE(T0."TotalExpns", 0)) AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                    FROM
                        OINV T0
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- A/R Credit Notes (as negative)
                    SELECT
                        T0."CardCode",
                        'RIN-' || TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocEntry") AS "DocKey",
                        - (T0."DocTotal" - COALESCE(T0."VatSum", 0) - COALESCE(T0."TotalExpns", 0)) AS "Net_Sales_LC"
                    FROM
                        ORIN T0
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) T
                INNER JOIN OCRD ON T."CardCode" = OCRD."CardCode"
                INNER JOIN OCRG ON OCRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
            GROUP BY
                OCRG."GroupName"
            ORDER BY
                "Net_Sales_LC" DESC;

SELECT
                T."Month",
                COALESCE(NULLIF(T."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "Tax_Code",
                SUM(T."Taxable_Amount") AS "Taxable_Amount",
                SUM(T."VatSum") AS "Tax_Amount"
            FROM
                (
                    -- 1. AR Invoices (Lines)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        T1."TaxCode",
                        T1."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OINV T0
                        INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 2. AR Invoices (Freight Tax)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        T3."TaxCode",
                        T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OINV T0
                        INNER JOIN INV3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 3. AR Credit Memos (Lines - Negative)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        T1."TaxCode",
                        - T1."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORIN T0
                        INNER JOIN RIN1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 4. AR Credit Memos (Freight Tax - Negative)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        T3."TaxCode",
                        - T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORIN T0
                        INNER JOIN RIN3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) T
            GROUP BY
                T."Month",
                T."TaxCode"
            ORDER BY
                T."Month",
                "Tax_Amount" DESC;

SELECT
                T."Month",
                -- IGST Amount (Inter-State)
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN T."VatSum"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "IGST_Amount",
                -- CGST Amount (Intra-State: 50% of SCGST)
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                        OR UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN T."VatSum" / 2.0
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "CGST_Amount",
                -- SGST Amount (Intra-State: 50% of SCGST)
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                        OR UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN T."VatSum" / 2.0
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "SGST_Amount",
                -- CESS Amount
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN UPPER(T."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN T."VatSum"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "CESS_Amount",
                -- Total Taxable Amount
                SUM(T."Taxable_Amount") AS "Total_Taxable_Amount",
                -- Grand Total Eligible ITC
                SUM(T."VatSum") AS "Grand_Total_ITC"
            FROM
                (
                    -- 1. AP Invoices (Net of Document Discount)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T1."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 2. AP Invoice Freight / Additional Expenses
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T3."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 3. Less: AP Credit Memos (Net of Document Discount)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T1."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        - (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 4. Less: AP Credit Memo Freight
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T3."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        - T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) T
            GROUP BY
                T."Month"
            ORDER BY
                T."Month";

SELECT
                T."Month",
                T."TaxCode",
                SUM(T."Taxable_Amount") AS "Taxable_Amount",
                SUM(T."VatSum") AS "Net_ITC_Tax_Amount"
            FROM
                (
                    -- 1. AP Invoices (Net of Document Discount)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T1."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 2. AP Invoice Freight / Expenses
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T3."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 3. Less: AP Credit Memos (Net of Document Discount)
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T1."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        - (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 4. Less: AP Credit Memo Freight
                    SELECT
                        TO_VARCHAR (T0."DocDate", 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
                        COALESCE(NULLIF(T3."TaxCode", ''), '(blank)') AS "TaxCode",
                        - T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "VatSum"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) T
            GROUP BY
                T."Month",
                T."TaxCode"
            ORDER BY
                T."Month",
                "Net_ITC_Tax_Amount" DESC;

SELECT
                T."Month",
                ---------------------------------------------------------
                -- Table 3.1: Outward Supplies & Other Liabilities
                ---------------------------------------------------------
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."Taxable_Amount"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Outward_Taxable_Val",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."IGST"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Outward_IGST",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."CGST"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Outward_CGST",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."SGST"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Outward_SGST",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."CESS"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Outward_CESS",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."Total_Tax"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "3.1_Total_Output_Tax",
                ---------------------------------------------------------
                -- Table 4: Eligible ITC (Inward Supplies)
                ---------------------------------------------------------
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '4_ITC' THEN T."Taxable_Amount"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "4_Eligible_ITC_Taxable_Val",
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN T."Category" = '4_ITC' THEN T."IGST"
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS "4_Eligible_ITC_IGST",
                SUM(

                        WHEN T."Category" = '3.1_Outward' THEN T."Total_Tax"

                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------

                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- SECTION 3: AP INVOICES (Purchases / Input Tax Credit)

                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- SECTION 4: LESS AP CREDIT MEMOS (Purchase Returns / Negative ITC)

                    -- AP Credit Memos (Lines)

                    UNION ALL
                    -- AP Credit Memos (Freight)
                    SELECT

SELECT

    T."DocEntry",

    (T."Taxable_Amount" + T."Total_Tax") AS "Gross_Doc_Total"
FROM
    (
        -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            'Table 4' AS "GSTR9_Table",
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CRD1."GSTRegnNo"), ''),
                    NULLIF(TRIM(T0."LicTradNum"), ''),
                    NULLIF(TRIM(OCRD."LicTradNum"), '')
                ) IS NOT NULL

                    TRIM(
                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(TRIM(CRD1."GSTRegnNo"), ''),
                            NULLIF(TRIM(T0."LicTradNum"), ''),
                            NULLIF(TRIM(OCRD."LicTradNum"), '')
                        )
                    )
                ) = 15 THEN '4A. Supplies made to Registered Persons (B2B)'
                ELSE '4B. Supplies made to Unregistered Persons (B2C)'
            END AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
            CASE
                WHEN COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CRD1."GSTRegnNo"), ''),
                    NULLIF(TRIM(T0."LicTradNum"), ''),
                    NULLIF(TRIM(OCRD."LicTradNum"), '')
                ) IS NOT NULL
                AND LENGTH (
                    TRIM(
                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(TRIM(CRD1."GSTRegnNo"), ''),
                            NULLIF(TRIM(T0."LicTradNum"), ''),
                            NULLIF(TRIM(OCRD."LicTradNum"), '')

            ) AS "GSTRegnNo",

            CASE

                ELSE 0

        -- AR Invoice Freight

        -- AP Invoice Freight
        SELECT

            CASE

            - CASE

            - CASE

SELECT

                        T5."Rate",

                    FROM

                        INNER JOIN OWHT W ON T5."WTCode" = W."WTCode"
                    WHERE

                        T0."DocEntry",

                    -- 4A / 4B: B2B & B2C Taxable Invoices

                            ELSE 0

                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) > 0
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?

                            WHEN COALESCE(T0."LicTradNum", '') <> ''
                            AND LENGTH (TRIM(T0."LicTradNum")) = 15 THEN '4A. Supplies made to Registered Persons (B2B)'

                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0

                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",

                    FROM
                        OINV T0
                        INNER JOIN INV3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) > 0
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- 4I: Less Credit Notes Issued (ORIN)
                    SELECT
                        'Table 4' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '4I. Credit Notes issued in respect of transactions (Table 4B to 4E)' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        - (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        - COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        ORIN T0
