                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) > 0
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- Freight Credit Notes
                    SELECT
                        'Table 4' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '4I. Credit Notes issued in respect of transactions (Table 4B to 4E)' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        - T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        - COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        ORIN T0
                        INNER JOIN RIN3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) > 0
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- 2. TABLE 5: OUTWARD SUPPLIES ON WHICH TAX IS NOT PAYABLE (Nil, Exempt, Zero)
                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    SELECT
                        'Table 5' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '5D/5E. Exempted / Nil Rated / Non-GST Outward Supplies' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        0 AS "IGST",
                        0 AS "CGST",
                        0 AS "SGST",
                        0 AS "CESS",
                        0 AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        OINV T0
                        INNER JOIN INV1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) = 0
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- 3. TABLE 6: DETAILS OF INPUT TAX CREDIT (ITC) AVAILED (OPCH Less ORPC)
                    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                    -- AP Invoices Lines (6B: Inputs / Capital Goods / Services)
                    SELECT
                        'Table 6' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        CASE
                            WHEN T2."ItemClass" = 1 THEN '6B. Inward Supplies - Capital Goods'
                            WHEN T1."ItemCode" IS NULL
                            OR T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN '6B. Inward Supplies - Services'
                            ELSE '6B. Inward Supplies - Inputs'
                        END AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                        LEFT JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- AP Invoices Freight
                    SELECT
                        'Table 6' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '6B. Inward Supplies - Services' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        OPCH T0
                        INNER JOIN PCH3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- Less: AP Credit Memos (ITC Reversal in Table 6/7)
                    SELECT
                        'Table 6' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '6B. Less: Reversals via Credit Memos' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        - (T1."LineTotal" - (T1."LineTotal" * COALESCE(T0."DiscPrcnt", 0) / 100)) AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T1."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        - COALESCE(T1."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    UNION ALL
                    -- Less: AP Credit Memo Freight
                    SELECT
                        'Table 6' AS "GSTR9_Table",
                        '6B. Less: Reversals via Credit Memos' AS "Nature_Of_Supply",
                        - T3."LineTotal" AS "Taxable_Amount",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%IGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "IGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SCGST%'
                            OR UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%SGST%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) / 2.0
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "SGST",
                        - CASE
                            WHEN UPPER(T3."TaxCode") LIKE '%CESS%' THEN COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "CESS",
                        - COALESCE(T3."VatSum", 0) AS "Total_Tax"
                    FROM
                        ORPC T0
                        INNER JOIN RPC3 T3 ON T0."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
                    WHERE
                        T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
                        AND T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) T
            GROUP BY
                T."GSTR9_Table",
                T."Nature_Of_Supply"
            ORDER BY
                T."GSTR9_Table",
                T."Nature_Of_Supply";

SELECT 
                COALESCE(T4."GroupName", 'Direct G/L / Non-BP Entry') AS "Customer_Group",
                COUNT(DISTINCT T0."TransId") AS "Journal_Entry_Count",
                
                -- P&L Revenue is Credit - Debit
                SUM(T1."Credit" - T1."Debit") AS "Net_Sales_LC",
                SUM(T1."FCCredit" - T1."FCDebit") AS "Net_Sales_FC"

            FROM OJDT T0
            INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"
            INNER JOIN OACT T2 ON T1."Account" = T2."AcctCode"

            -- Link to get Business Partner (covers Invoices, Credit Memos, and direct BP JEs)
            LEFT JOIN OINV INV ON T0."TransType" = 13 AND T0."CreatedBy" = INV."DocEntry"
            LEFT JOIN ORIN RIN ON T0."TransType" = 14 AND T0."CreatedBy" = RIN."DocEntry"
            LEFT JOIN OCRD T3 ON COALESCE(INV."CardCode", RIN."CardCode", 
            CASE WHEN T1."ShortName" <> T1."Account" THEN T1."ShortName" END) = T3."CardCode"
            LEFT JOIN OCRG T4 ON T3."GroupCode" = T4."GroupCode"

            WHERE 
                -- 1. Date filter matching your P&L reporting period
                T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                
                -- 2. Drawer 4 = Sales / Turnover Drawer in Chart of Accounts (P&L Revenue)
                AND T2."GroupMask" = 4

            GROUP BY 
                COALESCE(T4."GroupName", 'Direct G/L / Non-BP Entry')

            ORDER BY 
                "Net_Sales_LC" DESC;

SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 4 THEN 'Revenue'
                    WHEN T0."GroupMask" = 5 THEN 'Expense'
                END AS "Financial Group",

                L3."AcctName" AS "Category_Name",

                SUM(
                    COALESCE(T1."Credit", 0) - COALESCE(T1."Debit", 0)
                ) AS "Balance"

            FROM OACT T0
            LEFT JOIN OACT L4 ON T0."FatherNum" = L4."AcctCode"
            LEFT JOIN OACT L3 ON L4."FatherNum" = L3."AcctCode"
            LEFT JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0."AcctCode" = T1."Account"
            LEFT JOIN OJDT T2 ON T1."TransId" = T2."TransId"

            WHERE
                T0."Levels" = 5
                AND T0."GroupMask" IN (4, 5)
                AND T2."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                AND T2."TransType" <> -3

            GROUP BY
                T0."GroupMask",
                L3."AcctName"

            ORDER BY
                "Financial Group",
                "Category_Name";

WITH
                OpeningBalance AS (
                    SELECT
                        T3."CardCode",
                        COALESCE(SUM(T0."Debit" - T0."Credit"), 0) AS OpeningBalance
                    FROM
                        JDT1 T0
                        INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."ShortName" = T3."CardCode"
                        INNER JOIN OCRG T5 ON T3."GroupCode" = T5."GroupCode"
                    WHERE
                        T3."CardName" = ?
                        AND T0."RefDate" < ?
                    GROUP BY
                        T3."CardCode"
                ),
                Transactions AS (
                    SELECT
                        T3."CardCode",
                        T3."CardName",
                        T0."TransId",
                        T1."Memo",
                        T0."Ref1" AS "Doc No",
                        T0."Ref2" AS "BP Ref No",
                        T4."Comments" AS "BP Remarks",
                        T0."RefDate",
                        T0."Debit",
                        T0."Credit",
                        T4."WTSum"
                    FROM
                        JDT1 T0
                        INNER JOIN OJDT T1 ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"
                        INNER JOIN OCRD T3 ON T0."ShortName" = T3."CardCode"
                        LEFT JOIN OPCH T4 ON T0."TransId" = T4."TransId"
                    WHERE
                        T3."CardName" = ?
                        AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                )
            SELECT
                OpeningBalance."CardCode",
                NULL AS "CardName",
                NULL AS "TransId",
                'Opening Balance' AS "Memo",
                NULL AS "Doc No",
                NULL AS "BP Ref No",
                NULL AS "BP Remarks",
                NULL AS "RefDate",
                NULL AS "Debit",
                NULL AS "Credit",
                NULL AS "WTSum",
                OpeningBalance.OpeningBalance AS "Cumulative_Balance"
            FROM
                OpeningBalance
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                Transactions."CardCode",
                "CardName",
                "TransId",
                "Memo",
                "Doc No",
                "BP Ref No",
                "BP Remarks",
                "RefDate",
                "Debit",
                "Credit",
                "WTSum",
                OpeningBalance.OpeningBalance + COALESCE(
                    SUM("Debit" - "Credit") OVER (
                        PARTITION BY
                            Transactions."CardCode"
                        ORDER BY
                            "RefDate" ASC
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS "Cumulative_Balance"
            FROM
                Transactions
                LEFT JOIN OpeningBalance ON Transactions."CardCode" = OpeningBalance."CardCode";

WITH
                OpeningBalance AS (
                    SELECT
                        T1."Account",
                        COALESCE(SUM(T1."Debit") - SUM(T1."Credit"), 0) AS "Opening_Local_Balance",
                        COALESCE(SUM(T1."FCDebit") - SUM(T1."FCCredit"), 0) AS "Opening_FC_Balance"
                    FROM
                        JDT1 T1
                        INNER JOIN OJDT T0 ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"
                    WHERE
                        T1."Account" = ?
                        AND T0."RefDate" < ?
                    GROUP BY
                        T1."Account"
                ),
                CumulativeBalances AS (
                    SELECT
                        T1."Account",
                        COALESCE(A."AcctName", '') AS "AcctName",
                        T0."RefDate",
                        T1."BaseRef",
                        T0."Memo",
                        T0."Ref1",
                        T0."UpdateDate",
                        T0."CreateDate",
                        T0."Ref2",
                        T1."Ref3Line",
                        T1."LineMemo",
                        T1."Debit" AS "LocalDebit",
                        T1."Credit" AS "LocalCredit",
                        T1."FCDebit",
                        T1."FCCredit",
                        -- Local Currency Running Balance
                        COALESCE(OB."Opening_Local_Balance", 0) + SUM(T1."Debit" - T1."Credit") OVER (
                            PARTITION BY
                                T1."Account"
                            ORDER BY
                                T0."RefDate",
                                T1."TransId",
                                T1."Line_ID" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                        ) AS "Cumulative_Local_Balance",
                        -- Foreign Currency Running Balance (FIXED)
                        COALESCE(OB."Opening_FC_Balance", 0) + SUM(T1."FCDebit" - T1."FCCredit") OVER (
                            PARTITION BY
                                T1."Account"
                            ORDER BY
                                T0."RefDate",
                                T1."TransId",
                                T1."Line_ID" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                        ) AS "Cumulative_FC_Balance"
                    FROM
                        OJDT T0
                        INNER JOIN JDT1 T1 ON T0."TransId" = T1."TransId"
                        LEFT JOIN OACT A ON T1."Account" = A."AcctCode"
                        LEFT JOIN OpeningBalance OB ON T1."Account" = OB."Account"
                    WHERE
                        T1."Account" = ?
                        AND T0."RefDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                )
            SELECT
                OB."Account",
                NULL AS "AcctName",
                OB."Opening_Local_Balance",
                OB."Opening_FC_Balance",
                NULL AS "RefDate",
                NULL AS "BaseRef",
                'Opening Balance' AS "Memo",
                NULL AS "Ref1",
                NULL AS "UpdateDate",
                NULL AS "CreateDate",
                NULL AS "Ref2",
                NULL AS "Ref3Line",
                NULL AS "LineMemo",
                NULL AS "LocalDebit",
                NULL AS "LocalCredit",
                NULL AS "FCDebit",
                NULL AS "FCCredit",
                OB."Opening_Local_Balance" AS "Cumulative_Local_Balance",
                OB."Opening_FC_Balance" AS "Cumulative_FC_Balance"
            FROM
                OpeningBalance OB
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                CB."Account",
                CB."AcctName",
                NULL,
                NULL,
                CB."RefDate",
                CB."BaseRef",
                CB."Memo",
                CB."Ref1",
                CB."UpdateDate",
                CB."CreateDate",
                CB."Ref2",
                CB."Ref3Line",
                CB."LineMemo",
                CB."LocalDebit",
                CB."LocalCredit",
                CB."FCDebit",
                CB."FCCredit",
                CB."Cumulative_Local_Balance",
                CB."Cumulative_FC_Balance"
            FROM
                CumulativeBalances CB
            ORDER BY
                "RefDate",
                --"BaseRef",
                "Account";

SELECT
            T0."DocNum",
            T0."DocDate",
            T0."DocDueDate",
            T0."CreateDate",
            CASE T0."DocStatus" 
            WHEN 'C' THEN 'Closed'      
            WHEN 'O' THEN 'Open'   
            ELSE T0."DocStatus"  
            END AS "DocStatus", 
            T0."CreateTS",
            T0."ReqDate",
            T1."ItemCode",
            T1."Dscription",
            T1."Quantity",
            T1."OpenQty",
            T2."U_NAME",
            T2."USER_CODE"
        FROM
            OPRQ T0
            INNER JOIN PRQ1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
            INNER JOIN OUSR T2 ON T0."UserSign" = T2."USERID"
        WHERE
            T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
            and T0."CreateDate" between ? and ?;

description: Purchase Request to Purchase Order (PR / PO with SLA)
sql:
WITH PR_PO_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        -- PR Document Details
        T6."DocEntry"                                       AS "PR DocEntry",
        T6."DocNum"                                         AS "PR DocNum",
        CASE T6."DocStatus" 
            WHEN 'C' THEN 'Closed'      
            WHEN 'O' THEN 'Open'   
            ELSE T6."DocStatus"  
        END                                                 AS "PR Doc Status",
        T7."LineNum"                                        AS "PR LineNum",
        T6."DocDate"                                        AS "PR Raw Date",
        
        -- Construct Clean PR DateTime Timestamp
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            || ' '
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2)
            || ':'
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
            || ':00'
        )                                                   AS "PR_Actual_DateTime_Raw",

        T12."U_NAME"                                        AS "PR User Name",
        COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0)                          AS "PR Qty",
        COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0)                           AS "PR Open Qty",

        -- PO Document Details
        T5."DocEntry"                                       AS "PO DocEntry",
        T5."DocNum"                                         AS "PO DocNum",
        T4."LineNum"                                        AS "PO LineNum",
        T5."DocDate"                                        AS "PO Raw Date",

        -- Construct Clean PO DateTime Timestamp
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            || ' '
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2)
            || ':'
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
            || ':00'
        )                                                   AS "PO_Actual_DateTime_Raw",

        T11."U_NAME"                                        AS "PO User Name",
        T5."CardCode"                                       AS "Vendor Code",
        T5."CardName"                                       AS "Vendor Name",
        T4."ItemCode"                                       AS "Item Code",
        T4."Dscription"                                     AS "Item Description",
        COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)                          AS "PO Qty",
        COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)                             AS "PO Rate",
        T6."DocTime"                                        AS "PR_DocTime_Raw",
        T6."CreateDate"                                     AS "PR_CreateDate_Raw",
        
        -- Sales Order Aggregations
        SO_AGG."SO_DocEntries",
        SO_AGG."SO_DocNums",
        SO_AGG."Customer_Codes",
        SO_AGG."Customer_Names",
        SO_AGG."SO_Remarks"

    FROM "POR1" T4
    INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry" AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN "PRQ1" T7 ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry" AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine" AND T4."BaseType" = 1470000113
    INNER JOIN "OPRQ" T6 ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry" AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T11 ON T5."UserSign" = T11."USERID"
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12 ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            D."DocEntry",
            STRING_AGG(D."SO_DocEntry_Str", ', ')           AS "SO_DocEntries",
            STRING_AGG(D."SO_DocNum_Str", ', ')             AS "SO_DocNums",
            STRING_AGG(D."CardCode", ', ')                  AS "Customer_Codes",
            STRING_AGG(D."CardName", ', ')                  AS "Customer_Names",
            STRING_AGG(D."Remark", ', ')                    AS "SO_Remarks"
        FROM (
            SELECT
                T8."DocEntry",
                CAST(T9."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR)             AS "SO_DocEntry_Str",
                CAST(T8."RefDocNum" AS NVARCHAR)            AS "SO_DocNum_Str",
                T9."CardCode",
                T9."CardName",
                T8."Remark"
            FROM "PRQ21" T8
            LEFT JOIN "ORDR" T9 ON T8."RefDocNum" = T9."DocNum" AND T8."RefObjType" = '17' AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'
            GROUP BY T8."DocEntry", T9."DocEntry", T8."RefDocNum", T9."CardCode", T9."CardName", T8."Remark"
        ) D
        GROUP BY D."DocEntry"
    ) SO_AGG ON T6."DocEntry" = SO_AGG."DocEntry"
),
PR_PO_TARGET AS (
    SELECT 
        B.*,
        -- Calculate the raw target deadline timestamp object natively
        CASE 
            WHEN B."PR_DocTime_Raw" > 1830 THEN
                ADD_DAYS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(B."PR_CreateDate_Raw", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 09:30:00'), 2)
            ELSE
                ADD_DAYS(B."PR_Actual_DateTime_Raw", 1)
        END AS "Target_DateTime_Raw"
    FROM PR_PO_BASE B
)

SELECT
    -- Sales Order Data Links (Uncomment if needed)
    --  T."SO_DocEntries"                                    AS "SO DocEntry",
    --  T."SO_DocNums"                                       AS "SO DocNum",
    --  T."Customer_Codes"                                   AS "Customer Code",
    --  T."Customer_Names"                                   AS "Customer Name",
    --  T."SO_Remarks"                                       AS "SO Remarks in PR",

    T."PR DocEntry",
    T."PR DocNum",
    T."PR Doc Status",
    T."PR LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T."PR Raw Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')               AS "PR Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T."PR_Actual_DateTime_Raw", 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') AS "PR Actual DateTime",
    T."PR User Name",
    T."PR Qty",
    T."PR Open Qty",

    T."PO DocEntry",
    T."PO DocNum",
    T."PO LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T."PO Raw Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')               AS "PO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T."PO_Actual_DateTime_Raw", 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') AS "PO Actual DateTime",
    T."PO User Name",
    T."Vendor Code",
    T."Vendor Name",
    T."Item Code",
    T."Item Description",
    T."PO Qty",
    T."PO Rate",

    -- Exact String Output of Target
    TO_VARCHAR(T."Target_DateTime_Raw", 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') AS "PO_Target_DateTime",

    -- Clean, Crash-proof SLA evaluation
    CASE
        WHEN T."PO_Actual_DateTime_Raw" <= T."Target_DateTime_Raw" THEN 'Good'
        ELSE
            'Delay by '
            || TO_VARCHAR(
                ROUND(
                    NANO100_BETWEEN(T."Target_DateTime_Raw", T."PO_Actual_DateTime_Raw") 
                    / CAST(36000000000 AS DECIMAL(18,1)),
                    1
                )
            )
            || ' hrs'
    END                                                     AS "PO_SLA_Status"

FROM PR_PO_TARGET T
WHERE
    (
        T."PR Raw Date" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T."PO Raw Date" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    )
ORDER BY 
    T."PR Raw Date",
    T."PO DocNum", 
    T."PO LineNum";

description: Sales Order to Purchase Request (SO - PR)
sql:
SELECT
            -- ============================================================
            -- Sales Order Reference Details (Shows ALL Sales Orders)
            -- ============================================================
            T9."DocEntry"                                       AS "SO DocEntry",
            T9."DocNum"                                         AS "SO DocNum",
            TO_VARCHAR(T9."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "SO Posting Date",
            TO_VARCHAR(T9."DocDueDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')           AS "SO Due Date",
            T9."CardCode"                                       AS "Customer Code",
            T9."CardName"                                       AS "Customer Name",
            RDR."LineNum"                                       AS "SO LineNum",
            RDR."ItemCode"                                      AS "SO Item Code",
            RDR."Dscription"                                    AS "SO Item Description",
            COALESCE(RDR."Quantity", 0)                         AS "SO Qty",
            COALESCE(RDR."OpenQty", 0)                          AS "SO Open Qty",
            T8."Remark"                                         AS "SO Remark in PR",

            -- ============================================================
            -- Purchase Request Details
            -- ============================================================
            T6."DocEntry"                                       AS "PR DocEntry",
            T6."DocNum"                                         AS "PR DocNum",
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PR Date",
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."ReqDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PR Req Date",
            CASE
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
                WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
                WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'No PR Created'
                ELSE 'N/A'
            END                                                 AS "PR Status",
            T7."LineNum"                                        AS "PR LineNum",
            T7."ItemCode"                                       AS "PR Item Code",
            T7."Dscription"                                     AS "PR Item Description",
            COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0)                          AS "PR Qty",
            COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0)                           AS "PR Open Qty",
            T12."U_NAME"                                        AS "PR Created By",

            -- ============================================================
            -- SO to PR SLA Target Date (Within 3 Days of SO Posting Date)
            -- ============================================================
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_DAYS(T9."DocDate", 3),
                'DD-MM-YYYY'
            )                                                   AS "PR_Target_Date",

            -- ============================================================
            -- SO to PR SLA Status
            -- ============================================================
            CASE
                -- Scenario 1: No PR created yet and 3 days have already passed
                WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL 
                    AND DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."DocDate", CURRENT_DATE) > 3 THEN
                    'Pending PR - Overdue by '
                    || TO_VARCHAR(
                        DAYS_BETWEEN(
                            ADD_DAYS(T9."DocDate", 3),
                            CURRENT_DATE
                        )
                    )
                    || ' days'

                -- Scenario 2: No PR created yet but still within 3-day window
                WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN
                    'Pending PR (Within 3 Days)'

                -- Scenario 3: PR created on or before target date
                WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."DocDate", T6."DocDate") <= 3 THEN
                    'Done On Time'

                -- Scenario 4: PR created after target date
                ELSE
                    'Delay by '
                    || TO_VARCHAR(
                        DAYS_BETWEEN(
                            ADD_DAYS(T9."DocDate", 3),
                            T6."DocDate"
                        )
                    )
                    || ' days'
            END                                                 AS "PR_SLA_Status"

        FROM "ORDR" T9

        -- Sales Order Line Items
        INNER JOIN "RDR1" RDR 
            ON T9."DocEntry" = RDR."DocEntry"

        -- PR Reference Document Link (LEFT JOIN ensures SO is never dropped)
        LEFT JOIN "PRQ21" T8 
            ON T8."RefDocNum" = T9."DocNum"
            AND T8."RefObjType" = '17'

        -- PR Header
        LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 
            ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"
            AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'

        -- PR Lines (Matched by Item Code if present, or PR line details)
        LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 
            ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
            AND (T7."ItemCode" = RDR."ItemCode" OR T7."ItemCode" IS NULL)

        -- PR User Details
        LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12 
            ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"

        WHERE 
            T9."CANCELED" = 'N'
            AND (
                T9."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                OR T6."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )

        ORDER BY 
            T9."DocDate",
            T9."DocNum", 
            RDR."LineNum", 
            T6."DocNum";

description: PO to Gate Inward (PO TO Gate Inward with SLA)
sql:
SELECT
            -- PO Reference
            T5."DocEntry" AS "PO DocEntry",
            T5."DocNum" AS "PO DocNum",
            T4."LineNum" AS "PO LineNum",
            T5."DocDate",
            TO_VARCHAR (T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Date",
            TO_VARCHAR (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
            T4."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
            T4."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
            COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) AS "PO Qty",
            -- Gate Inward Details
            GH."DocEntry" AS "Gate DocEntry",
            GH."DocNum" AS "Gate DocNum",
            GL."LineId" AS "Gate LineNum",
            COALESCE(TO_VARCHAR (GH."U_UTL_DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY'), 'Pending') AS "Gate Entry Date",
            COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0) AS "Gate Inward Qty",
            COALESCE(GU."U_NAME", 'N/A') AS "Gate Created By",
            -- ============================================================
            -- Gate SLA: Target Date (PO Due Date) vs Actual Gate Posting Date
            -- ============================================================
            CASE
            -- Case 1: If the item has not arrived at the gate yet
                WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Inward'
                -- Case 2: Arrived on time or early
                WHEN GH."U_UTL_DocDate" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
                -- Case 3: Arrived late
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR (DAYS_BETWEEN (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), GH."U_UTL_DocDate")) || ' days'
            END AS "Gate_SLA_Status"
        FROM
            "POR1" T4
            INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
            -- ================================================================
            -- Purchase Request Link (LEFT JOIN preserves Direct POs)
            -- ================================================================
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL ON GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" = T4."DocEntry"
            AND GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" = T4."LineNum"
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry"
            AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
            LEFT JOIN "OUSR" GU ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
        WHERE
            T5."CANCELED" = 'N' -- Excludes Canceled Purchase Orders
            AND T5."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ? -- Added missing AND keyword here
            -- AND T5."DocStatus" = 'O'           -- Filters for Open Purchase Orders Only
            -- AND T4."LineStatus" = 'O'          -- Ensures individual PO lines are also Open
        ORDER BY
            T5."DocDate",
            T5."DocNum",
            T4."LineNum",
            GH."DocNum";

description: Goods Receipt PO GATE INWARD (GRPO with PO Ref & SLA)
sql:
SELECT
            -- ============================================================
            -- 1. Purchase Order Reference Details
            -- ============================================================
            T5."DocEntry" AS "PO DocEntry",
            T5."DocNum" AS "PO DocNum",
            T4."LineNum" AS "PO LineNum",
            TO_VARCHAR (T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Date",
            TO_VARCHAR (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
            T5."CardCode" AS "Vendor Code",
            T5."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
            T4."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
            T4."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
            COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) AS "PO Qty",
            COALESCE(T4."Price", 0) AS "PO Rate",
            -- ============================================================
            -- 2. Gate Inward Details
            -- ============================================================
            GH."DocEntry" AS "Gate DocEntry",
            GH."DocNum" AS "Gate DocNum",
            GL."LineId" AS "Gate LineNum",
            TO_VARCHAR (GH."U_UTL_DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Gate Date",
            TO_VARCHAR (GH."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "Gate Actual DateTime",
            COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0) AS "Gate Inward Qty",
            GU."U_NAME" AS "Gate Created By",
            -- ============================================================
            -- Gate SLA: As Per PO Delivery Date
            -- ============================================================
            CASE
                WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
                WHEN GH."U_UTL_DocDate" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR (DAYS_BETWEEN (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), GH."U_UTL_DocDate")) || ' days'
            END AS "Gate_SLA_Status",
            -- ============================================================
            -- 3. GRPO Details
            -- ============================================================
            T3."DocEntry" AS "GRPO DocEntry",
            T3."DocNum" AS "GRPO DocNum",
            T2."LineNum" AS "GRPO LineNum",
            TO_VARCHAR (T3."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "GRPO Date",
            TO_VARCHAR (T3."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) AS "GRPO Actual DateTime",
            COALESCE(T2."Quantity", 0) AS "GRPO Qty",
            COALESCE(T2."OpenQty", 0) AS "GRPO Open Qty",
            GRU."U_NAME" AS "GRPO Created By",
            -- ============================================================
            -- GRPO SLA: In 1.5 Hours (90 Mins / 5400 Seconds) after Gate Entry
            -- ============================================================
            CASE
                WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_VARCHAR (
                    ADD_SECONDS (
                        TO_TIMESTAMP (
                            TO_VARCHAR (GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                        ),
                        5400
                    ),
                    'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI'
                )
                ELSE 'Pending Gate Entry'
            END AS "GRPO_Target_DateTime",
            CASE
                WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
                WHEN T3."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
                WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN (
                    TO_TIMESTAMP (
                        TO_VARCHAR (GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                    ),
                    TO_TIMESTAMP (
                        TO_VARCHAR (T3."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                    )
                ) <= 540000000000 THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR (
                    ROUND(
                        (
                            NANO100_BETWEEN (
                                TO_TIMESTAMP (
                                    TO_VARCHAR (GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                                ),
                                TO_TIMESTAMP (
                                    TO_VARCHAR (T3."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD (T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                                )
                            ) - 540000000000
                        ) / 36000000000.0,
                        1
                    )
                ) || ' hrs'
            END AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",
            -- ============================================================
            -- AP Invoice SLA Target: Next Day by 12:00 PM after GRPO Creation
            -- ============================================================
            CASE
                WHEN T3."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_VARCHAR (ADD_DAYS (T3."CreateDate", 1), 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 12:00'
                ELSE 'Pending GRPO'
            END AS "AP_Target_DateTime"
        FROM
            "PDN1" T2
            -- ================================================================
            -- GRPO Header
            -- ================================================================
            INNER JOIN "OPDN" T3 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
            AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
            -- ================================================================
            -- Purchase Order Link (Base Document)
            -- ================================================================
            INNER JOIN "POR1" T4 ON T2."BaseEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
            AND T2."BaseLine" = T4."LineNum"
            AND T2."BaseType" = 22
            INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
            AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
            -- ================================================================
            -- Gate Inward Link (Matched via Base PO Line)
            -- ================================================================
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL ON GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" = T4."DocEntry"
            AND GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" = T4."LineNum"
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry"
            AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
            -- ================================================================
            -- User Lookups
            -- ================================================================
            LEFT JOIN "OUSR" GRU ON T3."UserSign" = GRU."USERID"
            LEFT JOIN "OUSR" GU ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
        WHERE
            T2."BaseType" = 22
            AND T2."ItemCode" IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(T2."ItemCode") <> ''
            AND (
                T5."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                OR GH."U_UTL_DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
                OR T3."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
            )
        ORDER BY
            T3."DocNum",
            T2."LineNum";

description: AP Invoice (with Full Document Chain & AP SLA)
sql:
SELECT
    -- ============================================================
    -- Document Category & Flow Type
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'Service' 
        ELSE 'Item' 
    END                                                 AS "Document Type",
    SRC."Flow_Type"                                     AS "Flow Type",
    SRC."PO_DocEntry"                                   AS "PO DocEntry Ref",
    SRC."PO_LineNum"                                    AS "PO LineNum Ref",
    SRC."GRPO_DocEntry"                                 AS "GRPO DocEntry Ref",
    SRC."GRPO_LineNum"                                  AS "GRPO LineNum Ref",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order Details
    -- ============================================================
    T5."DocNum"                                         AS "PO DocNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PO Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(
        COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"),
        'DD-MM-YYYY'
    )                                                   AS "PO Delivery Date",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate Inward (Items Only)
    -- ============================================================
    GH."DocNum"                                         AS "Gate DocNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(GH."U_UTL_DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')        AS "Gate Date",
    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'N/A (Service Doc)'
        WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GH."U_UTL_DocDate" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
        ELSE
            'Delay by '
            || TO_VARCHAR(
                DAYS_BETWEEN(
                    COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"),
                    GH."U_UTL_DocDate"
                )
            ) || ' days'
    END                                                 AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO Details (Items Only)
    -- ============================================================
    T3."DocNum"                                         AS "GRPO DocNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T3."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "GRPO Date",
    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocType" = 'S' THEN 'N/A (Service Doc)'
        WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL AND T3."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN 'No Gate Entry Found'
        WHEN T3."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' '
                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':'
                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
            ),
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(T3."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' '
                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':'
                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T3."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
            )
        ) <= 540000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay'
    END                                                 AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice Details
    -- ============================================================
    T0."DocEntry"                                       AS "AP DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum"                                         AS "AP DocNum",
    SRC."AP_LineNum"                                    AS "AP LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "AP Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')
        || ' '
        || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2)
        || ':'
        || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
                                                        AS "AP Actual DateTime",
    T0."CardCode"                                       AS "Vendor Code",
    T0."CardName"                                       AS "Vendor Name",
    T0."NumAtCard"                                      AS "Vendor Invoice No",
    SRC."Item_or_Account"                               AS "Item / GL Account",
    SRC."Line_Description"                              AS "Description",
    COALESCE(SRC."Quantity", 0)                         AS "AP Qty",
    COALESCE(SRC."LineTotal", 0)                        AS "Line Amount",
    AU."U_NAME"                                         AS "AP Created By",

    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice SLA (Next Day by 12:00 PM after GRPO / PO)
    -- ============================================================
    TO_VARCHAR(
        ADD_DAYS(
            COALESCE(T3."CreateDate", T5."CreateDate"),
            1
        ),
        'DD-MM-YYYY'
    ) || ' 12:00'                                       AS "AP_Target_DateTime",

    CASE
        WHEN TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' '
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':'
            || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
        ) <= TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_DAYS(
                    COALESCE(T3."CreateDate", T5."CreateDate"),
                    1
                ),
                'YYYY-MM-DD'
            ) || ' 12:00:00'
        ) THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay'
    END                                                 AS "AP_SLA_Status"

FROM
(
    -- Flow 1: Direct PO -> AP Invoice (Both Item and Service)
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN T1_DIR."ItemCode" IS NULL OR TRIM(T1_DIR."ItemCode") = '' THEN 'Direct Service PO to AP'
            ELSE 'Direct Item PO to AP'
        END                 AS "Flow_Type",
        T1_DIR."BaseEntry"  AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T1_DIR."BaseLine"   AS "PO_LineNum",
        NULL                AS "GRPO_DocEntry",
        NULL                AS "GRPO_LineNum",
        T1_DIR."DocEntry"   AS "AP_DocEntry",
        T1_DIR."LineNum"    AS "AP_LineNum",
        COALESCE(T1_DIR."ItemCode", T1_DIR."AcctCode") AS "Item_or_Account",
        T1_DIR."Dscription" AS "Line_Description",
        T1_DIR."Quantity"   AS "Quantity",
        T1_DIR."LineTotal"  AS "LineTotal"
    FROM "PCH1" T1_DIR
    WHERE T1_DIR."BaseType" = 22

    UNION ALL

    -- Flow 2: PO -> GRPO -> AP Invoice (Item only)
    SELECT
        'PO to GRPO to AP'  AS "Flow_Type",
        T2_SUB."BaseEntry"  AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T2_SUB."BaseLine"   AS "PO_LineNum",
        T1_GRPO."BaseEntry" AS "GRPO_DocEntry",
        T1_GRPO."BaseLine"  AS "GRPO_LineNum",
        T1_GRPO."DocEntry"  AS "AP_DocEntry",
        T1_GRPO."LineNum"   AS "AP_LineNum",
        T1_GRPO."ItemCode"  AS "Item_or_Account",
        T1_GRPO."Dscription" AS "Line_Description",
        T1_GRPO."Quantity"  AS "Quantity",
        T1_GRPO."LineTotal" AS "LineTotal"
    FROM "PCH1" T1_GRPO
    INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB
        ON T1_GRPO."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry"
        AND T1_GRPO."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum"
        AND T1_GRPO."BaseType" = 20
    WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
) SRC

INNER JOIN "OPCH" T0 
    ON SRC."AP_DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry" AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

LEFT JOIN "POR1" T4 
    ON SRC."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" AND SRC."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL

    --- TO_VARCHAR(T6."ReqDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PR Required Date",
    COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0)                          AS "PR Qty",
    COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0)                           AS "PR Open Qty",
    T12."U_NAME"                                        AS "PR Created By",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order Details
    -- ============================================================
    T5."DocEntry"                                       AS "PO DocEntry",
    T5."DocNum"                                         AS "PO DocNum",
    T4."LineNum"                                        AS "PO LineNum",

T5."DocDate",
T5."DocDueDate",
    --TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PO Date",
    -- TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDueDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')           AS "PO Delivery Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(
        COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"),
        'DD-MM-YYYY'
    )                                                   AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
    T5."CardCode"                                       AS "Vendor Code",
    T5."CardName"                                       AS "Vendor Name",
    T4."ItemCode"                                       AS "Item Code",
    T4."Dscription"                                     AS "Item Description",
    COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)                          AS "PO Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."OpenQty", 0)                           AS "PO Open Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)                             AS "PO Rate",
    CASE
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END                                                 AS "PO Doc Status",
    T11."U_NAME"                                        AS "PO Created By",

    -- ============================================================
    -- PR to PO SLA (Target: 24 Hours adjusted for shifts)
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T7."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        ELSE 
            TO_VARCHAR(
                CASE 
                    -- Shift Rule: Created after 6:30 PM (1830) -> Target deadline is Day After Tomorrow at 09:30 AM
                    WHEN T6."DocTime" > 1830 THEN
                        ADD_DAYS(
                            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 09:30:00'),
                            2
                        )
                    -- Standard Rule: Target deadline is actual PR time + 24 Hours (1 Day)
                    ELSE
                        ADD_DAYS(
                            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                                TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD')
                                || ' '
                                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2)
                                || ':'
                                || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
                                || ':00'
                            ),
                            1
                        )
                END,
                'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI'
            )
    END                                                 AS "PO_Target_DateTime",

    CASE
        WHEN T7."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            CASE 
                -- If PR after 6:30 PM, SLA countdown base moves to Next Day 9:30 AM
                WHEN T6."DocTime" > 1830 THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T6."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 09:30:00')
                ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
            END,
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 864000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE
            'Delay by '
            || TO_VARCHAR(
                ROUND(
                    (
                        NANO100_BETWEEN(
                            CASE 
                                WHEN T6."DocTime" > 1830 THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T6."CreateDate", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 09:30:00')
                                ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                            END,
                            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                        )
                        - 864000000000
                    ) / CAST(36000000000 AS DECIMAL(18,1)),
                    1
                )
            )
            || ' hrs'
    END                                                 AS "PO_SLA_Status"

FROM "POR1" T4

-- ================================================================
-- Purchase Order Header
-- ================================================================
INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 
    ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry" 
    AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- ================================================================
-- Purchase Request Link (LEFT JOIN preserves Direct POs)
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7
    ON T7."DocEntry" = T4."BaseEntry"
    AND T7."LineNum" = T4."BaseLine"
    AND T4."BaseType" = 1470000113

LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6
    ON T7."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
    AND T6."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- ================================================================
-- User Lookups
-- ================================================================
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T11 
    ON T5."UserSign" = T11."USERID"

LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12
    ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"
WHERE
    (
        T6."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T5."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
    )
ORDER BY 
    T5."DocDate",
    T5."DocNum", 
    T4."LineNum";

SELECT 
        T3."DocDate" AS "Posting Date",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Vendor Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Deliveries",
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
            WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), T3."DocDate") <= 0 
            THEN T0."DocEntry" 
        END) AS "On-Time Deliveries",
        ROUND(
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
                WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), T3."DocDate") <= 0 
                THEN T0."DocEntry" 
            END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry"), 0), 
            2
        ) AS "On-Time Delivery Rate %"
    FROM OPOR T0
    INNER JOIN POR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN PDN1 T2 ON T2."BaseType" = 22 
                    AND T2."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
                    AND T2."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum"
    INNER JOIN OPDN T3 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N' 
        AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T3."DocDate" Between ? AND ?
    GROUP BY 
        T3."DocDate",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName"
    ORDER BY 
        T3."DocDate" DESC, 
        "On-Time Delivery Rate %" ASC;

description: SLA Summary Report (PO, PR, Gate Inward, GRPO, AP Invoice)
sql:
WITH
-- ============================================================
-- Calendar + non-working days (Sundays + holidays from HLD1)
-- ============================================================
CAL AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE(GENERATED_PERIOD_START) AS "d"
    FROM SERIES_GENERATE_DATE('INTERVAL 1 DAY', '2020-01-01', ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, 365))
),
NONWORK AS (
    SELECT C."d"
    FROM CAL C
    WHERE WEEKDAY(C."d") = 6
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM HLD1 H
            WHERE C."d" >= TO_DATE(H."StrDate")
                AND C."d" <= TO_DATE(COALESCE(H."EndDate", H."StrDate"))
        )
),
-- ============================================================
-- PR: creation timestamp + PO target (same time, next WORKING day)
-- ============================================================
PR_T0 AS (
    SELECT
        H."DocEntry"                                                                    AS "DocEntry",
        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD')            AS "D0",
        FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60                    AS "Secs",
        (SELECT MIN(C."d") FROM CAL C
            WHERE C."d" > H."CreateDate"
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" = C."d"))               AS "NextWD"
    FROM "OPRQ" H
    WHERE H."CANCELED" = 'N'
),
PR_T AS (
    SELECT
        X."DocEntry",
        ADD_SECONDS(X."D0", X."Secs")                                                   AS "PR_TS",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(X."NextWD", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), X."Secs") AS "PO_Target_TS"
    FROM PR_T0 X
),
-- ============================================================
-- PO: creation timestamp
-- ============================================================
PO_T AS (
    SELECT
        H."DocEntry"                                                                    AS "DocEntry",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60)       AS "PO_TS"
    FROM "OPOR" H
),
-- ============================================================
-- Gate entries: one row per gate line, numbered per PO line
-- ============================================================
GATE_RAW AS (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50))))                         AS "PO_E",
        LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0')))         AS "PO_N",
        GH."DocEntry"                                                                  AS "G_DocEntry",
        GL."LineId"                                                                    AS "G_Line",
        GH."DocNum"                                                                    AS "G_No",
        GH."U_UTL_DocDate"                                                             AS "G_Date",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(GH."CreateTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(GH."CreateTime", 100) * 60) AS "G_TS",
        COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0)                                                    AS "G_Qty",
        COALESCE(UG."U_NAME", GH."Creator")                                            AS "G_User"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" AND COALESCE(GH."Canceled", 'N') = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" UG ON UG."USERID" = GH."UserSign"
    WHERE GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" IS NOT NULL
),
GATE_D AS (
    SELECT X.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X."PO_E", X."PO_N"
                            ORDER BY X."G_Date", X."G_DocEntry", X."G_Line") AS "RN"
    FROM GATE_RAW X
),
-- ============================================================
-- GRPO line -> AP line -> Payment (these links are real), numbered per PO line
-- ============================================================
CHAIN_RAW AS (
    SELECT
        D2."BaseEntry"   AS "PO_E",
        D2."BaseLine"    AS "PO_N",
        H."DocEntry"     AS "R_DocEntry",
        D2."LineNum"     AS "R_Line",
        H."DocNum"       AS "R_No",
        H."DocDate"      AS "R_Date",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "R_TS",
        D2."Quantity"    AS "R_Qty",
        D2."OpenQty"     AS "R_Open",
        UR."U_NAME"      AS "R_User",
        AP."A_DocEntry", AP."A_Line", AP."A_No", AP."A_Date", AP."A_TS", AP."A_Qty", AP."A_User",
        PY."P_DocEntry", PY."P_No", PY."P_Date"
    FROM "PDN1" D2
    INNER JOIN "OPDN" H ON H."DocEntry" = D2."DocEntry" AND H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" UR ON UR."USERID" = H."UserSign"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            A."BaseEntry"  AS "R_DocEntry",
            A."BaseLine"   AS "R_Line",
            AH."DocEntry"  AS "A_DocEntry",
            A."LineNum"    AS "A_Line",
            AH."DocNum"    AS "A_No",
            AH."DocDate"   AS "A_Date",
            ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(AH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                        FLOOR(AH."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(AH."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "A_TS",
            A."Quantity"   AS "A_Qty",
            UA."U_NAME"    AS "A_User"
        FROM "PCH1" A
        INNER JOIN "OPCH" AH ON AH."DocEntry" = A."DocEntry" AND AH."CANCELED" = 'N'
        LEFT JOIN "OUSR" UA ON UA."USERID" = AH."UserSign"
        WHERE A."BaseType" = 20
    ) AP ON AP."R_DocEntry" = H."DocEntry" AND AP."R_Line" = D2."LineNum"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            PM2."DocEntry" AS "A_DocEntry",
            VP."DocEntry"  AS "P_DocEntry",
            VP."DocNum"    AS "P_No",
            VP."DocDate"   AS "P_Date"
        FROM "VPM2" PM2
        INNER JOIN "OVPM" VP ON VP."DocEntry" = PM2."DocNum" AND VP."Canceled" = 'N'
        WHERE PM2."InvType" = 18
    ) PY ON PY."A_DocEntry" = AP."A_DocEntry"
    WHERE D2."BaseType" = 22
),
CHAIN_D AS (
    SELECT X.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY X."PO_E", X."PO_N"
                            ORDER BY X."R_TS", X."R_DocEntry", X."R_Line",
                                    X."A_TS", X."A_DocEntry", X."P_Date", X."P_DocEntry") AS "RN"
    FROM CHAIN_RAW X
),
CHAIN_T AS (
    SELECT X.*,
        -- AP target: next WORKING day (skips Sundays & holidays) after its GRPO, 12:00
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(
            (SELECT MIN(C."d") FROM CAL C
                WHERE C."d" > TO_DATE(X."R_TS")
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" = C."d")),
            'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 43200)                                                    AS "A_Target_TS",
        -- GRPO target base: latest gate entry on this PO line before the GRPO
        (SELECT MAX(G."G_TS") FROM GATE_D G
        WHERE G."PO_E" = CAST(X."PO_E" AS NVARCHAR(50))
            AND G."PO_N" = CAST(X."PO_N" AS NVARCHAR(50))
            AND G."G_TS" <= X."R_TS")                                                               AS "R_Gate_TS"
    FROM CHAIN_D X
),
-- ============================================================
-- Row spine per PO line: row k = k-th gate + k-th GRPO/AP/Payment chain row
-- ============================================================
SPINE AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(G."PO_E", CAST(C."PO_E" AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS "PO_E",
        COALESCE(G."PO_N", CAST(C."PO_N" AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS "PO_N",
        COALESCE(G."RN", C."RN")                           AS "RN",
        G."G_No", G."G_Date", G."G_Qty", G."G_User",
        C."R_No", C."R_Date", C."R_TS", C."R_Gate_TS", C."R_Qty", C."R_Open", C."R_User",
        C."A_No", C."A_Date", C."A_TS", C."A_Target_TS", C."A_Qty", C."A_User",
        C."P_No", C."P_Date"
    FROM GATE_D G
    FULL OUTER JOIN CHAIN_T C
        ON G."PO_E" = CAST(C."PO_E" AS NVARCHAR(50))
        AND G."PO_N" = CAST(C."PO_N" AS NVARCHAR(50))
        AND G."RN"   = C."RN"
)
SELECT
    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Request Details (OPRQ T6 & PRQ1 T7)
    -- ============================================================
    T6."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PR DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum"                                                   AS "PR_No",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PR Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "PR Actual DateTime",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."ReqDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PR Req Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T6."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END                                                           AS "PR Doc Status",
    T12."U_NAME"                                                  AS "PR User Name",
    T7."LineNum"                                                  AS "PR Line Number",
    COALESCE(T7."ItemCode", T4."ItemCode")                        AS "Item Code",
    COALESCE(T7."Dscription", T4."Dscription")                    AS "Item Description",
    COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0)                                    AS "PR Qty",
    COALESCE(T7."OpenQty", 0)                                     AS "PR Open Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(T7."Quantity", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((T7."Quantity" - T7."OpenQty") / T7."Quantity") * 100, 2)
        ELSE 0 
    END                                                           AS "PR Line Fulfilled Pct",
    T8."RefDocNum"                                                AS "Sales Order No",
    T8."Remark"                                                   AS "Sales Order Remark",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- PR to PO SLA Tracking (Target: 24 hours after PR, skipping Sundays & holidays)
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(PRT."PO_Target_TS", 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')
        ELSE 'Direct PO (No PR)'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Direct PO (No PR)'
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending PO'
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled'
        WHEN POT."PO_TS" <= PRT."PO_Target_TS" THEN 'Good'
        WHEN (SECONDS_BETWEEN(PRT."PO_Target_TS", POT."PO_TS")
              - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                        WHERE N."d" > TO_DATE(PRT."PO_Target_TS")
                            AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(POT."PO_TS"))) <= 0 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((SECONDS_BETWEEN(PRT."PO_Target_TS", POT."PO_TS")
              - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                        WHERE N."d" > TO_DATE(PRT."PO_Target_TS")
                            AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(POT."PO_TS"))) / 3600.0, 1)) || ' hrs'
    END                                                           AS "PO_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order Details (OPOR T5 & POR1 T4)
    -- ============================================================
    T5."DocNum"                                                   AS "PO No",
    T4."LineNum"                                                  AS "PO_LineNum",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PO Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(T5."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T5."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "PO_Actual_DateTime",
    T11."U_NAME"                                                  AS "PO_User_Name",
    TO_VARCHAR(T5."DocDueDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "PO_Delivery_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO_Item_Delivery_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'Open'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Doc_Status",
    T5."U_W_ORDER"                                                AS "PO_W_Order",
    T5."Comments"                                                 AS "PO_Remarks",
    T5."NumAtCard"                                                AS "PO_NumAtCard",
    T5."CardCode"                                                 AS "Vendor_Code",
    T5."CardName"                                                 AS "Vendor_Name",
    COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0)                                    AS "PO_Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."OpenQty", 0)                                     AS "PO_Open_Qty",
    COALESCE(T4."Price", 0)                                       AS "PO_Rate",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Row position inside this PO line (1 = first row; use it to count each PO line once)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(S."RN", 1)                                           AS "Line_Row_No",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate Inward: line totals + THIS row's gate entry
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Count", 0)                            AS "Gate_Count",
    S."G_No"                                                      AS "GateInward_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(S."G_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                          AS "Gate_First_Date",
    S."G_User"                                                    AS "Gate_Created_By",
    S."G_Qty"                                                     AS "Gate_Qty",
    COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Total_Qty", 0)                        AS "Gate_Total_Inward_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Pending'
        WHEN S."G_No" IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE WHEN S."G_Date" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
                -- delay counted in working days (Sundays & holidays removed)
                WHEN (DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), S."G_Date")
                    - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                        WHERE N."d" > COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate")
                            AND N."d" <= S."G_Date")) <= 0 THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
                        DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), S."G_Date")
                        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                            WHERE N."d" > COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate")
                                AND N."d" <= S."G_Date")
                        ) || ' days'
            END
        WHEN COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Count", 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(S."RN", 1) = 1 THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "Gate_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO: line totals + THIS row's GRPO
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0)                            AS "GRPO_Count",
    S."R_No"                                                      AS "GRPO_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(S."R_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                          AS "GRPO_First_Date",
    S."R_User"                                                    AS "GRPO_Created_By",
    S."R_Qty"                                                     AS "GRPO_Qty",
    COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Total_Qty", 0)                        AS "GRPO_Total_Qty",
    S."R_Open"                                                    AS "GRPO_Open_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Pending'
        WHEN S."R_No" IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE WHEN S."R_Gate_TS" IS NULL THEN 'No Gate Entry Before GRPO'
                -- elapsed seconds minus 24h for every Sunday/holiday between gate and GRPO
                WHEN (SECONDS_BETWEEN(S."R_Gate_TS", S."R_TS")
                       - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                                WHERE N."d" >= TO_DATE(S."R_Gate_TS")
                                    AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))) <= 5400 THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((SECONDS_BETWEEN(S."R_Gate_TS", S."R_TS")
                       - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                                WHERE N."d" >= TO_DATE(S."R_Gate_TS")
                                    AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))
                    - 5400) / 3600.0, 1)) || ' hrs'
            END
        WHEN COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Count", 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(S."RN", 1) = 1 THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(GATE_AGG."Gate_Count", 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(S."RN", 1) = 1 THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice: line totals + THIS row's AP invoice (linked to this row's GRPO)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Count", 0)                                AS "AP_Count",
    S."A_No"                                                      AS "AP_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(S."A_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                          AS "AP_First_Date",
    S."A_User"                                                    AS "AP_Created_By",
    S."A_Qty"                                                     AS "AP_Qty",
    COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Total_Qty", 0)                            AS "AP_Total_Qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Pending'
        WHEN S."A_No" IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE WHEN S."A_TS" <= S."A_Target_TS" THEN 'Good'
                -- target is already a working day; remove Sundays/holidays after it
                WHEN (SECONDS_BETWEEN(S."A_Target_TS", S."A_TS")
                       - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                                WHERE N."d" > TO_DATE(S."A_Target_TS")
                                    AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."A_TS"))) <= 0 THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(ROUND((SECONDS_BETWEEN(S."A_Target_TS", S."A_TS")
                       - 86400 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                                WHERE N."d" > TO_DATE(S."A_Target_TS")
                                    AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."A_TS"))) / 3600.0, 1)) || ' hrs'
            END
        WHEN S."R_No" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Pending AP Invoice'
        WHEN COALESCE(GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Count", 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(S."RN", 1) = 1 THEN 'GRPO Required First'
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "AP_SLA_Status",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Outgoing Payment: line total + THIS row's payment (linked to this row's AP invoice)
    -- 30-day term counted in working days (Sundays & holidays excluded)
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(PAY_AGG."Payment_Count", 0)                          AS "Payment_Count",
    S."P_No"                                                      AS "Payment_Numbers",
    TO_VARCHAR(S."P_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                          AS "Payment_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Pending'
        WHEN S."A_No" IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN S."P_No" IS NULL THEN
            CASE WHEN (DAYS_BETWEEN(S."A_Date", CURRENT_DATE)
                    - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                        WHERE N."d" > S."A_Date" AND N."d" <= CURRENT_DATE)) > 30
                THEN 'Overdue Unpaid by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
                        DAYS_BETWEEN(S."A_Date", CURRENT_DATE)
                        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                            WHERE N."d" > S."A_Date" AND N."d" <= CURRENT_DATE)
                        - 30) || ' days'
                ELSE 'Pending Payment (Within 30 Days)'
            END
        WHEN (DAYS_BETWEEN(S."A_Date", S."P_Date")
            - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                WHERE N."d" > S."A_Date" AND N."d" <= S."P_Date")) <= 30 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
                DAYS_BETWEEN(S."A_Date", S."P_Date")
                - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
                    WHERE N."d" > S."A_Date" AND N."d" <= S."P_Date")
