                - 30) || ' days'
    END                                                           AS "Payment_SLA_Status",
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Difference Metrics & Source Type
    -- ============================================================
    (COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) - COALESCE(AP_AGG."AP_Total_Qty", 0)) AS "PO_vs_AP_Quantity_Diff",
    
    CASE 
        WHEN T7."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T4."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN 'PR + PO'
        WHEN T7."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T4."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PR Only (Pending PO)'
        ELSE 'Direct PO (No PR)'
    END                                                           AS "Source_Type",
    
    CASE
        WHEN T5."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Pending'
        WHEN T5."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'O' THEN 'PO Created - Open'
        WHEN T5."DocStatus" = 'C' THEN 'PO Created - Closed'
        ELSE 'PO Pending'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Status_Message",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Working-day differences (excludes Sundays & holidays)
    -- ============================================================
    DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T9."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T6."CreateDate")     AS "SO_PR_Diff_Days",

    DAYS_BETWEEN(T6."CreateDate", T5."CreateDate")
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T6."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T5."CreateDate")     AS "PR_PO_Diff_Days",

    DAYS_BETWEEN(S."R_Date", TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > S."R_Date" AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))     AS "GRPO_Diff_Days",

    DAYS_BETWEEN(T5."CreateDate", TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > T5."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."R_TS"))     AS "PO_GRPO_Diff_Days",

    DAYS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(S."R_TS"), TO_DATE(S."A_TS"))
        - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N
            WHERE N."d" > TO_DATE(S."R_TS") AND N."d" <= TO_DATE(S."A_TS"))     AS "GRPO_AP_Diff_Days"

-- ============================================================
-- BASE: Combine All PR Items and Direct PO Items
-- ============================================================
FROM (
    -- 1. All PR items (with or without PO)
    SELECT 
        PRQ."DocEntry" AS "PR_DocEntry",
        PRQ."LineNum"  AS "PR_LineNum",
        POR."DocEntry" AS "PO_DocEntry",
        POR."LineNum"  AS "PO_LineNum"
    FROM "PRQ1" PRQ
    INNER JOIN "OPRQ" OPR 
        ON OPR."DocEntry" = PRQ."DocEntry" 
        AND OPR."CANCELED" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "POR1" POR 
        ON POR."BaseEntry" = PRQ."DocEntry" 
        AND POR."BaseLine" = PRQ."LineNum" 
        AND POR."BaseType" = 1470000113
    LEFT JOIN "OPOR" OP 
        ON OP."DocEntry" = POR."DocEntry" 
        AND OP."CANCELED" = 'N'

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. Direct PO items (without base PR)
    SELECT 
        NULL           AS "PR_DocEntry",
        NULL           AS "PR_LineNum",
        POR."DocEntry" AS "PO_DocEntry",
        POR."LineNum"  AS "PO_LineNum"
    FROM "POR1" POR
    INNER JOIN "OPOR" OP 
        ON OP."DocEntry" = POR."DocEntry" 
        AND OP."CANCELED" = 'N'
    WHERE POR."BaseType" <> 1470000113 OR POR."BaseType" IS NULL
) BASE_ITEMS

-- Join PR Lines & Header
LEFT JOIN "PRQ1" T7 
    ON T7."DocEntry" = BASE_ITEMS."PR_DocEntry" 
    AND T7."LineNum" = BASE_ITEMS."PR_LineNum"

LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" T6 
    ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"

-- Join PO Lines & Header
LEFT JOIN "POR1" T4 
    ON T4."DocEntry" = BASE_ITEMS."PO_DocEntry" 
    AND T4."LineNum" = BASE_ITEMS."PO_LineNum"

LEFT JOIN "OPOR" T5 
    ON T5."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"

-- PR / PO timestamps and working-day PO target
LEFT JOIN PR_T PRT ON PRT."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN PO_T POT ON POT."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"

-- Sales Order Links
LEFT JOIN "PRQ21" T8 
    ON T6."DocEntry" = T8."DocEntry"

LEFT JOIN "ORDR" T9 
    ON T8."RefDocNum" = T9."DocNum" 
    AND T8."RefObjType" = '17' 
    AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- ============================================================
-- Per-PO-line totals (counts, qty, first/last dates for the date filter)
-- ============================================================
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50)))) AS "PO_DocEntry_Str",
        LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0'))) AS "PO_LineNum_Str",
        COUNT(DISTINCT GH."DocEntry")                 AS "Gate_Count",
        MIN(GH."U_UTL_DocDate")                       AS "Gate_First_Date",
        MAX(GH."U_UTL_DocDate")                       AS "Gate_Last_Date",
        SUM(COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0))              AS "Gate_Total_Qty"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH 
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" 
        AND COALESCE(GH."Canceled", 'N') = 'N'
    WHERE GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY 
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50)))), 
        LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0')))
) GATE_AGG 
    ON GATE_AGG."PO_DocEntry_Str" = CAST(T4."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR) 
    AND GATE_AGG."PO_LineNum_Str" = CAST(T4."LineNum" AS NVARCHAR)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T3_SUB."DocEntry")             AS "GRPO_Count",
        MIN(T3_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "GRPO_First_Date",
        MAX(T3_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "GRPO_Last_Date",
        SUM(COALESCE(T2_SUB."Quantity", 0))           AS "GRPO_Total_Qty"
    FROM "PDN1" T2_SUB
    INNER JOIN "OPDN" T3_SUB 
        ON T2_SUB."DocEntry" = T3_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND T3_SUB."CANCELED" = 'N'
    WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
    GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
) GRPO_AGG 
    ON GRPO_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
    AND GRPO_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0_SUB."DocEntry")             AS "AP_Count",
        MIN(T0_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "AP_First_Date",
        MAX(T0_SUB."DocDate")                         AS "AP_Last_Date",
        SUM(COALESCE(T1_SUB."Quantity", 0))           AS "AP_Total_Qty"
    FROM "PCH1" T1_SUB
    INNER JOIN "OPCH" T0_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."DocEntry" = T0_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND T0_SUB."CANCELED" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseType" = 20
    WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
    GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
) AP_AGG 
    ON AP_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
    AND AP_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                            AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T2_SUB."BaseLine"                             AS "PO_LineNum",
        COUNT(DISTINCT VPM_SUB."DocEntry")            AS "Payment_Count",
        MIN(VPM_SUB."DocDate")                        AS "Payment_First_Date",
        MAX(VPM_SUB."DocDate")                        AS "Payment_Last_Date"
    FROM "VPM2" PM2_SUB
    INNER JOIN "OVPM" VPM_SUB 
        ON VPM_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocNum" 
        AND VPM_SUB."Canceled" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN "PCH1" T1_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND PM2_SUB."InvType" = 18
    INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseType" = 20
    WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
    GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
) PAY_AGG 
    ON PAY_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry" 
    AND PAY_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T4."LineNum"

-- ============================================================
-- One row per document: gate k / GRPO k -> AP -> Payment
-- ============================================================
LEFT JOIN SPINE S
    ON S."PO_E" = CAST(T4."DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(50))
    AND S."PO_N" = CAST(T4."LineNum" AS NVARCHAR(50))

-- User Details
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T11 ON T5."UserSign" = T11."USERID"
LEFT JOIN "OUSR" T12 ON T6."UserSign" = T12."USERID"

WHERE
(
T6."CANCELED" = 'N'
AND T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
)
        AND
    -- 1. Date Filter (Posting Date DocDate across documents)
    (
        T6."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR T5."CreateDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR (GATE_AGG."Gate_First_Date" <= ? AND GATE_AGG."Gate_Last_Date" >= ?)
        OR (GRPO_AGG."GRPO_First_Date" <= ? AND GRPO_AGG."GRPO_Last_Date" >= ?)
        OR (AP_AGG."AP_First_Date" <= ? AND AP_AGG."AP_Last_Date" >= ?)
        OR (PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date" <= ? AND PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date" >= ?)
    )

ORDER BY
    COALESCE(T6."DocNum", T5."DocNum"),
    COALESCE(T7."LineNum", T4."LineNum"),
    COALESCE(S."RN", 1);

description: SLA Follow-up Tree (PR > PO > Gate / GRPO > AP) - one row per document or pending item
sql:
WITH
    -- ============================================================
    -- PO lines: still open, OR have a GRPO line not yet invoiced (date filter applied in PO_L below)
    -- ============================================================
    PO_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        L."DocEntry"   AS "PO_DocEntry",
        L."LineNum"    AS "PO_Line",
        H."DocNum"     AS "PO_No",
        L."ItemCode"   AS "Item_Code",
        L."Dscription" AS "Item_Desc",
        L."Quantity"   AS "Qty",
        L."OpenQty"    AS "Open_Qty",
        L."BaseType", L."BaseEntry", L."BaseLine",
        H."CardCode", H."CardName",
        HP."DocNum"    AS "PR_No",
        HP."DocDate"   AS "PR_DocDate",
        H."DocDate"    AS "PO_DocDate",
        COALESCE(L."ShipDate", H."DocDueDate") AS "Due_Date",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(L."ShipDate", H."DocDueDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 86399) AS "Gate_Target_TS",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "PO_TS",
        U."U_NAME"     AS "PO_Owner"
    FROM "POR1" L
    INNER JOIN "OPOR" H ON H."DocEntry" = L."DocEntry" AND H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "OPRQ" HP ON HP."DocEntry" = L."BaseEntry" AND L."BaseType" = 1470000113
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U  ON U."USERID" = H."UserSign"
    WHERE L."LineStatus" = 'O'
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "PDN1" G
                WHERE G."BaseType" = 22 AND G."BaseEntry" = L."DocEntry" AND G."BaseLine" = L."LineNum"
                    AND G."LineStatus" = 'O')
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- First / last posting date of every document in each PO line's chain
    -- ============================================================
    PO_DATES AS (
    SELECT B."PO_DocEntry", B."PO_Line",
        GA."G_First", GA."G_Last", RA."R_First", RA."R_Last",
        AA."A_First", AA."A_Last", PA."P_First", PA."P_Last"
    FROM PO_BASE B
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50)))) AS "PO_E",
            LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0'))) AS "PO_N",
            MIN(GH."U_UTL_DocDate") AS "G_First", MAX(GH."U_UTL_DocDate") AS "G_Last"
        FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
        INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" AND COALESCE(GH."Canceled", 'N') = 'N'
        WHERE GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50)))),
                LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0')))
    ) GA ON GA."PO_E" = CAST(B."PO_DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(50)) AND GA."PO_N" = CAST(B."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(50))
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT D2."BaseEntry" AS "PO_E", D2."BaseLine" AS "PO_N",
            MIN(D3."DocDate") AS "R_First", MAX(D3."DocDate") AS "R_Last"
        FROM "PDN1" D2
        INNER JOIN "OPDN" D3 ON D3."DocEntry" = D2."DocEntry" AND D3."CANCELED" = 'N'
        WHERE D2."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY D2."BaseEntry", D2."BaseLine"
    ) RA ON RA."PO_E" = B."PO_DocEntry" AND RA."PO_N" = B."PO_Line"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT D2."BaseEntry" AS "PO_E", D2."BaseLine" AS "PO_N",
            MIN(D0."DocDate") AS "A_First", MAX(D0."DocDate") AS "A_Last"
        FROM "PCH1" D1
        INNER JOIN "OPCH" D0 ON D0."DocEntry" = D1."DocEntry" AND D0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        INNER JOIN "PDN1" D2 ON D1."BaseEntry" = D2."DocEntry" AND D1."BaseLine" = D2."LineNum" AND D1."BaseType" = 20
        WHERE D2."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY D2."BaseEntry", D2."BaseLine"
    ) AA ON AA."PO_E" = B."PO_DocEntry" AND AA."PO_N" = B."PO_Line"
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT D2."BaseEntry" AS "PO_E", D2."BaseLine" AS "PO_N",
            MIN(VP."DocDate") AS "P_First", MAX(VP."DocDate") AS "P_Last"
        FROM "VPM2" PM2
        INNER JOIN "OVPM" VP ON VP."DocEntry" = PM2."DocNum" AND VP."Canceled" = 'N'
        INNER JOIN "PCH1" D1 ON D1."DocEntry" = PM2."DocEntry" AND PM2."InvType" = 18
        INNER JOIN "PDN1" D2 ON D1."BaseEntry" = D2."DocEntry" AND D1."BaseLine" = D2."LineNum" AND D1."BaseType" = 20
        WHERE D2."BaseType" = 22
        GROUP BY D2."BaseEntry", D2."BaseLine"
    ) PA ON PA."PO_E" = B."PO_DocEntry" AND PA."PO_N" = B."PO_Line"
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- PO lines in scope = PO_BASE + date filter (same 12 placeholders as QSLA010)
    -- ============================================================
    PO_L AS (
    SELECT B.*
    FROM PO_BASE B
    INNER JOIN PO_DATES D ON D."PO_DocEntry" = B."PO_DocEntry" AND D."PO_Line" = B."PO_Line"
    WHERE
        B."PR_DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR B."PO_DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?
        OR (D."G_First" <= ? AND D."G_Last" >= ?)
        OR (D."R_First" <= ? AND D."R_Last" >= ?)
        OR (D."A_First" <= ? AND D."A_Last" >= ?)
        OR (D."P_First" <= ? AND D."P_Last" >= ?)
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- PR lines in scope: open lines, OR parents of in-scope PO lines
    -- ============================================================
    PR_L AS (
    SELECT
        L."DocEntry"   AS "PR_DocEntry",
        L."LineNum"    AS "PR_Line",
        H."DocNum"     AS "PR_No",
        L."ItemCode"   AS "Item_Code",
        L."Dscription" AS "Item_Desc",
        L."Quantity"   AS "Qty",
        L."OpenQty"    AS "Open_Qty",
        L."LineStatus" AS "Line_Status",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "PR_TS",
        U."U_NAME"     AS "PR_Owner"
    FROM "PRQ1" L
    INNER JOIN "OPRQ" H ON H."DocEntry" = L."DocEntry" AND H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U  ON U."USERID" = H."UserSign"
    WHERE (L."LineStatus" = 'O' AND L."OpenQty" > 0 AND H."DocDate" BETWEEN ? AND ?)
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PO_L P
                WHERE P."BaseType" = 1470000113 AND P."BaseEntry" = L."DocEntry" AND P."BaseLine" = L."LineNum")
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate entries per PO line, with running (FIFO) cumulative qty
    -- ============================================================
    GATE_RAW AS (
    SELECT
        P."PO_DocEntry", P."PO_Line",
        GH."DocEntry" AS "G_DocEntry",
        GL."LineId"   AS "G_Line",
        GH."DocNum"   AS "G_No",
        COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0) AS "G_Qty",
        GH."U_UTL_DocDate" AS "G_DocDate",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(GH."CreateTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(GH."CreateTime", 100) * 60) AS "G_TS",
        COALESCE(UG."U_NAME", GH."Creator") AS "G_Owner"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" AND COALESCE(GH."Canceled", 'N') = 'N'
    INNER JOIN PO_L P
        ON LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" AS NVARCHAR(50)))) = CAST(P."PO_DocEntry" AS NVARCHAR(50))
        AND LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS NVARCHAR(50)), '0'))) = CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(50))
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" UG ON UG."USERID" = GH."UserSign"
    WHERE GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" IS NOT NULL
    ),
    GATE_L AS (
    SELECT X.*,
        SUM(X."G_Qty") OVER (PARTITION BY X."PO_DocEntry", X."PO_Line"
            ORDER BY X."G_TS", X."G_DocEntry", X."G_Line"
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "G_Cum_Qty"
    FROM GATE_RAW X
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO lines per PO line
    -- ============================================================
    GRPO_L AS (
    SELECT
        P."PO_DocEntry", P."PO_Line",
        GR."DocEntry"   AS "R_DocEntry",
        GR."LineNum"    AS "R_Line",
        H."DocNum"      AS "R_No",
        GR."Quantity"   AS "R_Qty",
        GR."OpenQty"    AS "R_OpenQty",
        GR."LineStatus" AS "R_Status",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "R_TS",
        U."U_NAME"      AS "R_Owner"
    FROM "PDN1" GR
    INNER JOIN "OPDN" H ON H."DocEntry" = GR."DocEntry" AND H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN PO_L P
        ON GR."BaseType" = 22 AND GR."BaseEntry" = P."PO_DocEntry" AND GR."BaseLine" = P."PO_Line"
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U ON U."USERID" = H."UserSign"
    ),
    -- GRPO target = latest gate entry before the GRPO + 1.5h ; AP target = next day 12:00 after GRPO
    GRPO_T AS (
    SELECT R.*,
        ADD_SECONDS((SELECT MAX(G."G_TS") FROM GATE_L G
                    WHERE G."PO_DocEntry" = R."PO_DocEntry" AND G."PO_Line" = R."PO_Line"
                        AND G."G_TS" <= R."R_TS"), 5400) AS "R_Target_TS",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(R."R_TS", 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 43200) AS "A_Target_TS"
    FROM GRPO_L R
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- AP invoice lines (real link: AP line -> GRPO line)
    -- ============================================================
    AP_L AS (
    SELECT
        R."PO_DocEntry", R."PO_Line", R."R_DocEntry", R."R_Line", R."A_Target_TS",
        A."DocEntry" AS "A_DocEntry",
        A."LineNum"  AS "A_Line",
        H."DocNum"   AS "A_No",
        A."Quantity" AS "A_Qty",
        ADD_SECONDS(TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(H."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                    FLOOR(H."DocTime" / 100) * 3600 + MOD(H."DocTime", 100) * 60) AS "A_TS",
        U."U_NAME"   AS "A_Owner"
    FROM "PCH1" A
    INNER JOIN "OPCH" H ON H."DocEntry" = A."DocEntry" AND H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN GRPO_T R
        ON A."BaseType" = 20 AND A."BaseEntry" = R."R_DocEntry" AND A."BaseLine" = R."R_Line"
    LEFT JOIN "OUSR" U ON U."USERID" = H."UserSign"
    ),
    
    -- ============================================================
    -- Qty totals per PO line (gate vs GRPO)
    -- ============================================================
    PO_SUM AS (
    SELECT P."PO_DocEntry", P."PO_Line",
        COALESCE(GS."Q", 0) AS "Gate_Qty",
        COALESCE(RS."Q", 0) AS "GRPO_Qty"
    FROM PO_L P
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT "PO_DocEntry", "PO_Line", SUM("G_Qty") AS "Q" FROM GATE_L GROUP BY "PO_DocEntry", "PO_Line") GS
        ON GS."PO_DocEntry" = P."PO_DocEntry" AND GS."PO_Line" = P."PO_Line"
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT "PO_DocEntry", "PO_Line", SUM("R_Qty") AS "Q" FROM GRPO_L GROUP BY "PO_DocEntry", "PO_Line") RS
        ON RS."PO_DocEntry" = P."PO_DocEntry" AND RS."PO_Line" = P."PO_Line"
    ),
    -- first gate entry (oldest) that is not yet covered by GRPO qty (FIFO)
    GATE_UNC AS (
    SELECT G.*, S."Gate_Qty", S."GRPO_Qty",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY G."PO_DocEntry", G."PO_Line"
            ORDER BY G."G_TS", G."G_DocEntry", G."G_Line") AS "RN"
    FROM GATE_L G
    INNER JOIN PO_SUM S ON S."PO_DocEntry" = G."PO_DocEntry" AND S."PO_Line" = G."PO_Line"
    WHERE G."G_Cum_Qty" > S."GRPO_Qty"
    )
    
    SELECT * FROM (
    
    -- ========== PR line (context node) ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PR:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS "Node_Id",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS "Parent_Id",
        CAST('PR' AS NVARCHAR(10))   AS "Stage",
        CAST('DOC' AS NVARCHAR(10))  AS "Node_Kind",
        CAST(R."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "Doc_No",
        CAST(R."PR_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "Line_No",
        R."Item_Code", R."Item_Desc" AS "Item_Description",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS "Vendor_Code",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS "Vendor_Name",
        R."PR_Owner"                 AS "Owner",
        CAST(R."Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6))      AS "Qty",
        CAST(R."Open_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS "Open_Qty",
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6))  AS "Pending_Qty",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20))   AS "Target_DateTime",
        TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Actual_DateTime",
        CAST('INFO' AS NVARCHAR(30)) AS "State",
        CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,1))  AS "Hours_Late",
        CAST(R."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "PR_No",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS "PO_No",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20))   AS "PO_Line_No"
    FROM PR_L R
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== PENDING PO: open PR qty, target PR + 24h ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PEND_PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('PR:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'PO', 'PENDING',
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        R."Item_Code", R."Item_Desc",
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)),
        R."PR_Owner",
        CAST(R."Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(R."Open_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        CASE WHEN ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PENDING_OVERDUE'
            WHEN ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400) <= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 3) THEN 'PENDING_DUE_SOON'
            ELSE 'PENDING_NOT_DUE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(R."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM PR_L R
    WHERE R."Line_Status" = 'O' AND R."Open_Qty" > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== PO line: SLA = created within 24h of PR ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CASE WHEN R."PR_DocEntry" IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST('PR:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."PR_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)) END,
        'PO', 'DOC',
        CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        P."PO_Owner",
        CAST(P."Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(P."Open_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CASE WHEN R."PR_DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'NO_TARGET'
            WHEN P."PO_TS" <= ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400) THEN 'DONE_ON_TIME'
            ELSE 'DONE_LATE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(ADD_SECONDS(R."PR_TS", 86400), P."PO_TS") / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM PO_L P
    LEFT JOIN PR_L R
        ON R."PR_DocEntry" = P."BaseEntry" AND R."PR_Line" = P."BaseLine" AND P."BaseType" = 1470000113
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== PENDING GATE: PO qty not yet gated (nor received), target PO line due date ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PEND_GATE:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'GATE', 'PENDING',
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        P."PO_Owner",
        CAST(P."Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        CAST(P."Qty" - CASE WHEN S."Gate_Qty" >= S."GRPO_Qty" THEN S."Gate_Qty" ELSE S."GRPO_Qty" END AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(P."Gate_Target_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        CASE WHEN P."Gate_Target_TS" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PENDING_OVERDUE'
            WHEN P."Gate_Target_TS" <= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 3) THEN 'PENDING_DUE_SOON'
            ELSE 'PENDING_NOT_DUE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(P."Gate_Target_TS", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM PO_L P
    INNER JOIN PO_SUM S ON S."PO_DocEntry" = P."PO_DocEntry" AND S."PO_Line" = P."PO_Line"
    WHERE P."Open_Qty" > 0
    AND P."Qty" - CASE WHEN S."Gate_Qty" >= S."GRPO_Qty" THEN S."Gate_Qty" ELSE S."GRPO_Qty" END > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== Gate entry: SLA = gate date <= PO line due date ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('GATE:' || TO_VARCHAR(G."G_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(G."G_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'GATE', 'DOC',
        CAST(G."G_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(G."G_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        G."G_Owner",
        CAST(G."G_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(P."Gate_Target_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
        TO_VARCHAR(G."G_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CASE WHEN G."G_DocDate" <= P."Due_Date" THEN 'DONE_ON_TIME' ELSE 'DONE_LATE' END,
        CAST(DAYS_BETWEEN(P."Due_Date", G."G_DocDate") * 24 AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM GATE_L G
    INNER JOIN PO_L P ON P."PO_DocEntry" = G."PO_DocEntry" AND P."PO_Line" = G."PO_Line"
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== PENDING GRPO: gated qty not yet received; target = oldest uncovered gate + 1.5h ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PEND_GRPO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'GRPO', 'PENDING',
        CAST(U."G_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        U."G_Owner",
        CAST(P."Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        CAST(U."Gate_Qty" - U."GRPO_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(U."G_TS", 5400), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        CASE WHEN ADD_SECONDS(U."G_TS", 5400) < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PENDING_OVERDUE'
            WHEN ADD_SECONDS(U."G_TS", 5400) <= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 3) THEN 'PENDING_DUE_SOON'
            ELSE 'PENDING_NOT_DUE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(ADD_SECONDS(U."G_TS", 5400), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM GATE_UNC U
    INNER JOIN PO_L P ON P."PO_DocEntry" = U."PO_DocEntry" AND P."PO_Line" = U."PO_Line"
    WHERE U."RN" = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== GRPO line: SLA = within 1.5h of the latest gate entry before it ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('GRPO:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('PO:' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(P."PO_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'GRPO', 'DOC',
        CAST(R."R_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(R."R_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        R."R_Owner",
        CAST(R."R_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(R."R_OpenQty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(R."R_Target_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        TO_VARCHAR(R."R_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CASE WHEN R."R_Target_TS" IS NULL THEN 'NO_TARGET'
            WHEN R."R_TS" <= R."R_Target_TS" THEN 'DONE_ON_TIME'
            ELSE 'DONE_LATE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(R."R_Target_TS", R."R_TS") / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM GRPO_T R
    INNER JOIN PO_L P ON P."PO_DocEntry" = R."PO_DocEntry" AND P."PO_Line" = R."PO_Line"
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== PENDING AP: GRPO line still open (not invoiced), target next day 12:00 ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('PEND_AP:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('GRPO:' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(R."R_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'AP', 'PENDING',
        CAST(R."R_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(R."R_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        R."R_Owner",
        CAST(R."R_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(R."R_OpenQty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(R."A_Target_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        CASE WHEN R."A_Target_TS" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'PENDING_OVERDUE'
            WHEN R."A_Target_TS" <= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 3) THEN 'PENDING_DUE_SOON'
            ELSE 'PENDING_NOT_DUE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(R."A_Target_TS", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM GRPO_T R
    INNER JOIN PO_L P ON P."PO_DocEntry" = R."PO_DocEntry" AND P."PO_Line" = R."PO_Line"
    WHERE R."R_Status" = 'O' AND R."R_OpenQty" > 0
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- ========== AP invoice line: SLA = next day 12:00 after its GRPO ==========
    SELECT
        CAST('AP:' || TO_VARCHAR(A."A_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(A."A_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        CAST('GRPO:' || TO_VARCHAR(A."R_DocEntry") || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(A."R_Line") AS NVARCHAR(100)),
        'AP', 'DOC',
        CAST(A."A_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(A."A_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20)),
        P."Item_Code", P."Item_Desc",
        P."CardCode", P."CardName",
        A."A_Owner",
        CAST(A."A_Qty" AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)),
        TO_VARCHAR(A."A_Target_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        TO_VARCHAR(A."A_TS", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
        CASE WHEN A."A_TS" <= A."A_Target_TS" THEN 'DONE_ON_TIME' ELSE 'DONE_LATE' END,
        CAST(ROUND(SECONDS_BETWEEN(A."A_Target_TS", A."A_TS") / 3600.0, 1) AS DECIMAL(19,1)),
        CAST(P."PR_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_No" AS NVARCHAR(50)), CAST(P."PO_Line" AS NVARCHAR(20))
    FROM AP_L A
    INNER JOIN PO_L P ON P."PO_DocEntry" = A."PO_DocEntry" AND P."PO_Line" = A."PO_Line"
    
    ) NODES
    ORDER BY COALESCE("PR_No", "PO_No"), "PO_No", "PO_Line_No", "Stage", "Doc_No";

description: SLA Performance & Time Study Dashboard V1
sql:
WITH CAL AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE(GENERATED_PERIOD_START) AS "d"
    FROM SERIES_GENERATE_DATE('INTERVAL 1 DAY', '2020-01-01', ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE, 365))
),
NONWORK AS (
    SELECT C."d"
    FROM CAL C
    WHERE WEEKDAY(C."d") = 6
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM HLD1 H
            WHERE C."d" >= TO_DATE(H."StrDate")
                AND C."d" <= TO_DATE(COALESCE(H."EndDate", H."StrDate"))
        )
),
LINK AS (
    SELECT
        T1."DocEntry" AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T1."LineNum"  AS "PO_LineNum",
        CASE WHEN T1."BaseType" = 1470000113 THEN T1."BaseEntry" END AS "PR_DocEntry",
        CASE WHEN T1."BaseType" = 1470000113 THEN T1."BaseLine"  END AS "PR_LineNum"
    FROM POR1 T1
    INNER JOIN OPOR T0 
        ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
        AND T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        NULL, NULL,
        P1."DocEntry", P1."LineNum"
    FROM PRQ1 P1
    INNER JOIN OPRQ P0 
        ON P0."DocEntry" = P1."DocEntry" 
        AND P0."CANCELED" = 'N'
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM POR1 X1
        INNER JOIN OPOR X0 
            ON X0."DocEntry" = X1."DocEntry" 
            AND X0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        WHERE X1."BaseType"  = 1470000113
            AND X1."BaseEntry" = P1."DocEntry"
            AND X1."BaseLine"  = P1."LineNum"
    )
),
-- PO Sent to Vendor Dispatch Log via OEML
PO_SENT_LOG AS (
    SELECT 
        E."DocEntry"                                             AS "PO_DocEntry",
        COUNT(E."AbsEntry")                                      AS "Sent_Count",
        STRING_AGG(CAST(E."EMailAddr" AS NVARCHAR), ', ')        AS "Sent_Emails",
        MIN(E."SendDate")                                        AS "First_Sent_Date",
        MIN(E."SendTime")                                        AS "First_Sent_Time",
        MAX(E."SendDate")                                        AS "Last_Sent_Date",
        MAX(E."SendTime")                                        AS "Last_Sent_Time"
    FROM OEML E
    WHERE E."ObjType" = '22'
    GROUP BY E."DocEntry"
),
PAY_AGG AS (
    SELECT 
        T2_SUB."BaseEntry"                                      AS "PO_DocEntry",
        T2_SUB."BaseLine"                                       AS "PO_LineNum",
        COUNT(DISTINCT VPM_SUB."DocEntry")                      AS "Payment_Count",
        STRING_AGG(CAST(VPM_SUB."DocNum" AS NVARCHAR), ', ')    AS "Payment_All_No",
        MIN(VPM_SUB."DocDate")                                  AS "Payment_First_Date",
        MAX(VPM_SUB."DocDate")                                  AS "Payment_Last_Date"
    FROM "VPM2" PM2_SUB
    INNER JOIN "OVPM" VPM_SUB 
        ON VPM_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocNum" 
        AND VPM_SUB."Canceled" = 'N'
    INNER JOIN "PCH1" T1_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."DocEntry" = PM2_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND PM2_SUB."InvType" = 18
    INNER JOIN "PDN1" T2_SUB 
        ON T1_SUB."BaseEntry" = T2_SUB."DocEntry" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseLine" = T2_SUB."LineNum" 
        AND T1_SUB."BaseType" = 20
    WHERE T2_SUB."BaseType" = 22
    GROUP BY T2_SUB."BaseEntry", T2_SUB."BaseLine"
)
SELECT
    -- ============================================================
    -- Sales Order Reference & SO to PR SLA Tracking
    -- ============================================================
    T9."DocEntry"                                                 AS "SO_DocEntry",
    T9."DocNum"                                                   AS "SO_No",
    T9."CreateDate"                                               AS "SO_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "SO_Creation_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "SO_Creation_Time",
    TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T9."CreateDate", 3), 'DD-MM-YYYY')        AS "PR_Target_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T9."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_SECONDS(
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(
                        TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || 
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || 
                        SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
                    ),
                    259200
                ),
                'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "PR_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T9."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'No Linked SO'
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending PR'
        WHEN (
            DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate")
            - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T9."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T6."CreateDate")
        ) <= 3 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
            (DAYS_BETWEEN(T9."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate")
            - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T9."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T6."CreateDate")) - 3
        ) || ' working days'
    END                                                           AS "SO_PR_Diff_Days",
    CASE 
        WHEN T9."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            ROUND(
                (
                    NANO100_BETWEEN(
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T9."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T9."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                    )
                    - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T9."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T6."CreateDate")
                ) / 36000000000.0, 
                2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "SO_PR_Diff_Hrs",
    T8."Remark"                                                   AS "Sales_Order_Remark",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Request Details
    -- ============================================================
    T7."ItemCode"                                                 AS "PR_Item_Code",
    T7."Quantity"                                                 AS "PR_Qty",
    T7."OpenQty"                                                  AS "PR_Open_Qty",
    T6."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PR_DocEntry",
    T6."DocNum"                                                   AS "PR_No",
    T6."CreateDate"                                               AS "PR_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "PR_Creation_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "PR_Creation_Time",
    U7."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PR_Creation_User_Name",

    -- ============================================================
    -- PR to PO SLA Tracking (Target: 24h)
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(
                ADD_SECONDS(
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
                    86400
                ), 
                'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'
            )
        ELSE 'Direct PO (No PR)'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Direct PO (No PR)'
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending PO'
        WHEN T0."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'PO Cancelled'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(T6."CreateDate", T0."CreateDate") <= 1 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
            DAYS_BETWEEN(T6."CreateDate", T0."CreateDate")
            - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T6."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T0."CreateDate")
        ) || ' working days'
    END                                                           AS "PR_PO_Diff_Days",
    CASE 
        WHEN T6."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T0."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            ROUND(
                (
                    NANO100_BETWEEN(
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T6."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T6."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                    )
                    - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T6."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T0."CreateDate")
                ) / 36000000000.0, 
                2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "PR_PO_Diff_Hrs",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Purchase Order Details
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(T1."ItemCode",   T7."ItemCode")                      AS "Item_Code",
    COALESCE(T1."Dscription", T7."Dscription")                    AS "Item_Description",
    T1."Quantity"                                                 AS "PO_Qty",
    T1."OpenQty"                                                  AS "PO_Open_Qty",
    T0."DocEntry"                                                 AS "PO_DocEntry",
    T0."DocNum"                                                   AS "PO_No",
    T0."CreateDate"                                               AS "PO_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "PO_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO_Item_Delivery_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T0."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "PO_Creation_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T0."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "PO_Creation_Time",
    U0."U_NAME"                                                   AS "PO_Creation_User_Name",

    -- ============================================================
    -- PO Sent to Vendor Details (OEML)
    -- ============================================================
    TO_VARCHAR(SENT."First_Sent_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')              AS "PO_Sent_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(SENT."First_Sent_Time", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS') AS "PO_Sent_Time",
    CASE 
        WHEN SENT."First_Sent_Date" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(SENT."First_Sent_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' || 
            TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(SENT."First_Sent_Time", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')
        ELSE 'Not Sent / Pending'
    END                                                           AS "PO_Sent_DateTime",
    SENT."Sent_Emails"                                            AS "PO_Sent_Vendor_Email",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Gate Inward Details & SLA Tracking
    -- ============================================================
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 23:59:59'
        ELSE 'PO Not Created'
    END                                                           AS "Gate_Target_DateTime",
    GATE."GateDocEntry"                                           AS "Gate_DocEntry",
    GATE."GateDocNum"                                             AS "Gate_DocNum",
    GATE."GateLineId"                                             AS "Gate_LineNum",
    GATE."GateCreateDate"                                         AS "Gate_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateDocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                  AS "Gate_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(GATE."GateCreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' ' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
        SUBSTRING(LPAD(GATE."GateCreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2)      AS "Gate_Actual_DateTime",
    COALESCE(GATE."GateQty", 0)                                   AS "Gate_Inward_Qty",
    GATE."GateUserName"                                           AS "Gate_Created_By",
    CASE
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Entry'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocDate" <= COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
                DAYS_BETWEEN(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), GATE."GateDocDate")
                - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N 
                    WHERE N."d" > COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate")
                        AND N."d" <= GATE."GateDocDate")
            ) || ' working days'
    END                                                           AS "Gate_SLA_Status",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            ROUND(
                (
                    NANO100_BETWEEN(
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00'),
                        GATE."GateTs"
                    )
                    - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > COALESCE(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate") AND N."d" <= GATE."GateDocDate")
                ) / 36000000000.0, 
                2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "PO_Gate_Diff_Hrs",

    -- ============================================================
    -- GRPO Details & SLA Tracking
    -- ============================================================
    T3."Quantity"                                                 AS "GRPO_Qty",
    T3."OpenQty"                                                  AS "GRPO_Open_Qty",
    T2."DocEntry"                                                 AS "GRPO_DocEntry",
    T2."DocNum"                                                   AS "GRPO_No",
    T2."CreateDate"                                               AS "GRPO_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(T2."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "GRPO_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "GRPO_Creation_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "GRPO_Creation_Time",
    U2."U_NAME"                                                   AS "GRPO_Creation_User_Name",
    CASE 
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            TO_VARCHAR(ADD_SECONDS(GATE."GateTs", 5400), 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')
        ELSE 'Pending Gate Entry'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Gate Entry Required First'
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending GRPO'
        WHEN NANO100_BETWEEN(
            GATE."GateTs",
            TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
        ) <= 54000000000 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(
            ROUND((
                NANO100_BETWEEN(
                    GATE."GateTs",
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                ) - 54000000000) / 36000000000.0, 1
            )
        ) || ' hrs'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_SLA_Status",
    CASE 
        WHEN GATE."GateDocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T2."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            ROUND(
                NANO100_BETWEEN(
                    GATE."GateTs",
                    TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                ) / 36000000000.0, 
                2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "Gate_GRPO_Diff_Hrs",

    -- ============================================================
    -- AP Invoice Details & SLA Tracking
    -- ============================================================
    T5."Quantity"                                                 AS "AP_Qty",
    T5."OpenQty"                                                  AS "AP_Open_Qty",
    T4."DocEntry"                                                 AS "AP_DocEntry",
    T4."DocNum"                                                   AS "AP_No",
    T4."CreateDate"                                               AS "AP_CreateDate",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                        AS "AP_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY')                     AS "AP_Creation_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(TO_TIME(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0')), 'HH:MI:SS')  AS "AP_Creation_Time",
    U4."U_NAME"                                                   AS "AP_Creation_User_Name",
    CASE 
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T2."CreateDate", 1), 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 12:00:00'
        ELSE 'Pending GRPO'
    END                                                           AS "AP_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'GRPO Required First'
        WHEN T4."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending AP Invoice'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(T2."CreateDate", T4."CreateDate") <= 1 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay'
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_AP_Diff_Days",
    CASE 
        WHEN T2."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL AND T4."DocEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN
            ROUND(
                (
                    NANO100_BETWEEN(
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T2."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T2."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'),
                        TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_VARCHAR(T4."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTRING(LPAD(T4."DocTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00')
                    )
                    - 864000000000 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NONWORK N WHERE N."d" > T2."CreateDate" AND N."d" <= T4."CreateDate")
                ) / 36000000000.0, 
                2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "GRPO_AP_Diff_Hrs",

    -- ============================================================
    -- Outgoing Payment Details & SLA Tracking
    -- ============================================================
    COALESCE(PAY_AGG."Payment_Count", 0)                          AS "Payment_Count",
    PAY_AGG."Payment_All_No"                                      AS "Payment_All_No",
    PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date"                                  AS "Payment_First_Date_Raw",
    TO_VARCHAR(PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')        AS "Payment_First_Date",
    TO_VARCHAR(PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date", 'DD-MM-YYYY')         AS "Payment_Last_Date",
    CASE 
        WHEN T4."DocDate" IS NOT NULL THEN TO_VARCHAR(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), 'DD-MM-YYYY') || ' 23:59:59'
        ELSE 'AP Invoice Required First'
    END                                                           AS "Payment_Target_DateTime",
    CASE 
        WHEN T0."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'PO Not Created'
        WHEN T4."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'AP Required First'
        WHEN PAY_AGG."Payment_Count" IS NULL AND DAYS_BETWEEN(T4."DocDate", CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 
            'Overdue Unpaid by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), CURRENT_DATE)) || ' days'
        WHEN PAY_AGG."Payment_Count" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Payment (Within 30 Days)'
        WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(T4."DocDate", PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date") <= 30 THEN 'Good'
        ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR(DAYS_BETWEEN(ADD_DAYS(T4."DocDate", 30), PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date")) || ' days'
    END                                                           AS "Payment_SLA_Status",
    CASE 
        WHEN T4."DocDate" IS NOT NULL AND PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date" IS NOT NULL THEN
            DAYS_BETWEEN(T4."DocDate", PAY_AGG."Payment_Last_Date") * 24
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                           AS "AP_Payment_Diff_Hrs"

FROM LINK L

-- PO side
-- PO side
LEFT JOIN OPOR T0
    ON T0."DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry"
    AND T0."DocStatus" = 'O'

LEFT JOIN POR1 T1
    ON T1."DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry"
    AND T1."LineNum" = L."PO_LineNum"
LEFT JOIN OUSR U0 ON U0."USERID" = T0."UserSign"

-- PO Sent to Vendor (OEML aggregation)
LEFT JOIN PO_SENT_LOG SENT ON SENT."PO_DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry"

-- PR side
LEFT JOIN PRQ1 T7 ON T7."DocEntry" = L."PR_DocEntry" AND T7."LineNum" = L."PR_LineNum"
LEFT JOIN OPRQ T6
    ON T6."DocEntry" = T7."DocEntry"
    AND T6."DocStatus" = 'O'
LEFT JOIN OUSR U7 ON U7."USERID" = T6."UserSign"

-- PR -> SO
LEFT JOIN PRQ21 T8 ON T8."DocEntry" = T6."DocEntry" AND T8."RefObjType" = '17'
LEFT JOIN ORDR T9  ON T9."DocNum" = T8."RefDocNum" AND T9."CANCELED" = 'N'

-- PO -> GRPO -> AP
LEFT JOIN PDN1 T3 ON T3."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry" AND T3."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum" AND T3."BaseType" = 22
LEFT JOIN OPDN T2
    ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
    AND T2."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T2."DocStatus" = 'O'
LEFT JOIN OUSR U2 ON U2."USERID" = T2."UserSign"
LEFT JOIN PCH1 T5 ON T5."BaseEntry" = T3."DocEntry" AND T5."BaseLine" = T3."LineNum" AND T5."BaseType" = 20
LEFT JOIN OPCH T4
    ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
    AND T4."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND T4."DocStatus" = 'O'
LEFT JOIN OUSR U4 ON U4."USERID" = T4."UserSign"

-- Gate Inward (Single entry per PO line)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        GL."U_UTL_BASENTR"                      AS "PO_DocEntry",
        CAST(GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" AS INTEGER)    AS "PO_LineNum",
        GL."DocEntry"                           AS "GateDocEntry",
        GL."LineId"                             AS "GateLineId",
        COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0)             AS "GateQty",
        GH."DocNum"                             AS "GateDocNum",
        GH."U_UTL_DocDate"                      AS "GateDocDate",
        GH."CreateDate"                         AS "GateCreateDate",
        LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0')           AS "GateCreateTime",
        TO_TIMESTAMP(
            TO_VARCHAR(GH."CreateDate", 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 1, 2) || ':' ||
            SUBSTRING(LPAD(GH."CreateTime", 4, '0'), 3, 2) || ':00'
        )                                       AS "GateTs",
        GU."U_NAME"                             AS "GateUserName",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY GL."U_UTL_BASENTR", GL."U_UTL_BASELINE"
            ORDER BY GH."CreateDate", GH."CreateTime"
        )                                       AS "rn"
    FROM "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL
    INNER JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH
        ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry" AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
    LEFT JOIN OUSR GU ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
) GATE
    ON  GATE."PO_DocEntry" = L."PO_DocEntry"
    AND GATE."PO_LineNum"  = L."PO_LineNum"
    AND GATE."rn"          = 1

-- Outgoing Payment Pre-Aggregation
LEFT JOIN PAY_AGG 
    ON PAY_AGG."PO_DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry" 
    AND PAY_AGG."PO_LineNum" = T1."LineNum"

WHERE
(
    (
        T9."CreateDate" >= ?
        AND T9."CreateDate" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
    OR
    (
        T6."CreateDate" >= ?
        AND T6."CreateDate" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
    OR
    (
        T0."CreateDate" >= ?
        AND T0."CreateDate" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
    OR
    (
        T2."CreateDate" >= ?
        AND T2."CreateDate" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
    OR
    (
        T4."CreateDate" >= ?
        AND T4."CreateDate" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
    OR
    (
        PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date" >= ?
        AND PAY_AGG."Payment_First_Date" < ADD_DAYS(?, 1)
    )
)
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(T0."CreateDate", T6."CreateDate") DESC,
    T0."DocNum" DESC;
